title: Knowledge Discovery on RFM Model using Bernoulli Sequence
affiliations: Chung Hua University, Chung Hua University and Kainan University

detail.title: Knowledge Discovery on RFM Model using Bernoulli Sequence
detail.abstract: The objective of this paper is to introduce a comprehensive methodology to discover the knowledge for selecting targets for direct marketing from a database. This study expanded RFM model by including two parameters, time since first purchase and churn probability. Using Bernoulli sequence in probability theory, we derive out the formula that can estimate the probability that one customer will buy at the next time, and the expected value of the total number of times that the customer will buy in the future. This study also proposed the methodology to estimate the unknown parameters in the formula. This methodology leads to more efficient and accurate selection procedures than the existing ones. In the empirical part we examine a case study, blood transfusion service, to show that our methodology has greater predictive accuracy than traditional RFM approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的RFM模型，通过增加首次购买时间和流失概率两个参数，结合伯努利序列推导出客户下次购买概率和未来总购买次数的计算公式，在血液输血服务案例中证明比传统方法预测更准确
AI.research_question: 如何从数据库中更有效地选择直接营销目标客户？
AI.motivation: 传统RFM模型在客户选择方面存在局限性，需要更精确的方法来提高直接营销的效率和准确性
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于RFM模型扩展框架，引入时间序列分析和概率论中的伯努利序列
AI.method: 扩展RFM模型（增加首次购买时间和流失概率参数），使用伯努利序列推导购买概率公式，提出参数估计方法，并通过血液输血服务案例进行实证验证
AI.findings: 新方法比传统RFM方法具有更高的预测准确性，能够更有效地选择直接营销目标客户
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了RFM理论模型，提出了结合时间序列和概率论的新计算方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了更精确的客户选择工具，提高了直接营销的效率和投资回报率

title: How Executive Turnover Affects Earnings Announcement Disclosure Content and Formatting Choices
affiliations: Isenberg School of Management, University of Massachusetts Amherst, Tilburg University and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: How Executive Turnover Affects Earnings Announcement Disclosure Content and Formatting Choices
detail.abstract: We examine how individual executives influence content and formatting in earnings announcements, a critical disclosure channel in capital markets. While prior research extensively focuses on the demand side of earnings announcements, the production process remains underexplored. Using a sample of 177,668 quarterly earnings announcements, including 4,835 firm-quarters with CEO appointments and 6,982 firm-quarters with CFO appointments, we find that both CEOs and CFOs significantly shape earnings announcement content and formatting, with CFOs playing a more dominant role. Both new CEOs and new CFOs initiate new disclosure and formatting practices; however, the decision to discontinue them rests primarily with the CFO. New CEOs are more likely to influence earnings announcements disclosure if they are hired after negative firm performance. In contrast, CFOs influence disclosure regardless of prior performance. Both CEOs and CFOs influence top-line and bottom-line metric disclosures, such as revenue and earnings, while CFOs appear to have the primary influence on the disclosure of other metrics, such as EBIT and operating cashflow. The impact of new executives is more pronounced if they are external hires, who partially transfer disclosure practices from their prior firms. These effects are immediate, suggesting that long tenure is not necessary for imprinting disclosure styles. These findings underscore the significant role individual executives play in shaping how their firms communicate financial performance to markets, as well as the differential disclosure responsibilities held by CEOs and CFOs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过177,668个季度营收公告数据分析，发现CEO和CFO个人影响力在营收公告的内容和格式化方面起着重要作用，其中CFO角色更为主导。新任职的外部招聘执行官并部分转移原公司的信息曝露做法。
AI.research_question: 个人执行官如何影响营收公告的内容和格式化？CEO和CFO在信息曝露中的作用有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究广泛关注营收公告的需求方，但对其生产过程研究不足，需要探索个人执行官在这一关键信息曝露渠道中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于高级管理层理论和信息曝露理论，考察执行官个人特征对企业信息沟通方式的影响。
AI.method: 使用4,835个CEO替换和6,982个CFO替换的公司季度数据，通过对比新老执行官上任前后的营收公告内容和格式变化进行实证分析。
AI.findings: CEO和CFO都显著形成营收公告内容和格式，CFO作用更为主导。新CEO在业绩负面时更影响公告，而CFO不受之前业绩影响。外部招聘执行官会部分转移原公司曝露做法，效果立即显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了高级管理层理论在信息曝露领域的应用，明确了CEO和CFO在信息曝露中的不同职责分工。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了理解企业信息曝露风格变化的视角，有助于更好地识别和解读执行官替换对企业信息透明度的影响。

title: Strategic Growth Frameworks for B2B Healthcare Startups in Emerging Markets
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Strategic Growth Frameworks for B2B Healthcare Startups in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: The healthcare industry is witnessing a paradigm shift from patient-centric (B2C) models to enterprise-focused (B2B) approaches. In emerging economies such as India, B2B healthcare startups are filling critical gaps in corporate wellness, insurance-linked diagnostics, and preventive health programs. This paper explores the strategic pillars that drive B2B healthcare success, including partnership-led growth, compliance, technology integration, value-based pricing, and retention frameworks. Drawing on secondary research and case analyses of Indian healthcare startups, the paper proposes a strategic growth model for scaling B2B healthcare enterprises sustainably. Findings contribute to both managerial practice and academic discourse by offering insights into how startups can navigate competitive pressures, regulatory demands, and client expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度B2B医疗健康初创企业的成功战略支柱，包括合作伙伴驱动增长、合规性、技术整合、基于价值的定价和客户保留框架，提出了可持续扩展的战略增长模型。
AI.research_question: B2B医疗健康企业在新兴经济体中取得成功的关键战略支柱是什么？
AI.motivation: 医疗健康行业正从患者中心(B2C)模式向企业中心(B2B)模式转变，印度等新兴经济体的B2B医疗初创企业正在填补企业健康、保险相关诊断和预防性健康项目的关键空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略管理理论，重点关注合作伙伴关系、合规性、技术整合、价值定价和客户保留等战略要素。
AI.method: 采用二手研究和印度医疗健康初创企业的案例分析。
AI.findings: 识别了推动B2B医疗健康成功的关键战略支柱，包括合作伙伴驱动的增长、合规性管理、技术整合、基于价值的定价策略和客户保留框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术讨论提供了关于初创企业如何在竞争压力、监管要求和客户期望中导航的见解，丰富了B2B医疗健康战略理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了可持续扩展B2B医疗健康企业的战略增长模型，具有实际应用价值。

title: Applications of Web Mining for Marketing of Online Bookstores
affiliations: Chung Hua University, Thompson Rivers University, Kainan University and Chung Hua University

detail.title: Applications of Web Mining for Marketing of Online Bookstores
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify potential customers of online bookstores through web content mining without customers' transaction records and demographic information. Our study first creates a list of scholars whose research field is in information technology and categorizes IT expertise. We then use a search engine to count the numbers of web pages related to scholars and expertise. These data are pre-processed with three key steps before being used: filtering abnormal data, normalizing data, and generating binary data. Association analysis and hierarchical cluster analysis are employed to generate the clusters of scholars and the clusters of expertise. In order to test the accuracy of using web mining to predict clients' interested booklists, our study evaluates the accuracy of prediction through survey. The results show that the accuracy rate of the recommended booklists targeted on potential customers (scholars) is statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过网页内容挖掘识别在线书店的潜在客户，无需交易记录和人口统计信息。通过关联分析和层次聚类分析学者与IT专业领域，并通过调查验证推荐书单的准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖客户交易记录和人口统计信息的情况下，通过网页内容挖掘识别在线书店的潜在客户？
AI.motivation: 传统客户识别方法需要交易记录和人口统计信息，但很多时候这些数据难以获取。网页内容挖掘提供了一种替代方法来识别潜在客户。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网页内容挖掘理论、关联分析理论和聚类分析理论，构建学者与专业领域的关系网络。
AI.method: 1) 创建信息技术领域学者列表并分类IT专业领域；2) 使用搜索引擎统计相关网页数量；3) 数据预处理（异常数据过滤、数据标准化、生成二进制数据）；4) 关联分析和层次聚类分析；5) 通过调查验证预测准确性。
AI.findings: 针对潜在客户（学者）的推荐书单准确率在统计上显著，证明网页挖掘方法有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了网页内容挖掘在客户识别领域的应用，提供了不依赖传统数据源的客户预测方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线书店提供了一种新的潜在客户识别方法，可在缺乏交易记录的情况下进行精准营销。

title: The Comparisons of Data Mining Techniques for the Predictive Accuracy of Probability of Default of Credit Card Clients
affiliations: Chung Hua University and Thompson Rivers University

detail.title: The Comparisons of Data Mining Techniques for the Predictive Accuracy of Probability of Default of Credit Card Clients

publicationDetails.detailsText: Expert Systems with Applications, volume 36, issue 2, 2009[10.1016/j.eswa.2007.12.020]

detail.abstract: This research aimed at the case of customers' default payments in Taiwan and compares the predictive accuracy of probability of default among six data mining methods. From the perspective of risk management, the result of predictive accuracy of the estimated probability of default will be more valuable than the binary result of classification-credible or not credible clients. Because the real probability of default is unknown, this study presented the novel ''Sorting Smoothing Method" to estimate the real probability of default. With the real probability of default as the response variable (Y), and the predictive probability of default as the independent variable (X), the simple linear regression result (Y = A + BX) shows that the forecasting model produced by artificial neural network has the highest coefficient of determination; its regression intercept (A) is close to zero, and regression coefficient (B) to one. Therefore, among the six data mining techniques, artificial neural network is the only one that can accurately estimate the real probability of default.

AI.tldr: 本研究采甦台湾客户负债默认案例，比较六种数据挖掘方法的默认概率预测准确性。研究提出了新的"排序平滑方法"估计真实默认概率，发现人工神经网络在默认概率估计方面表现最优。
AI.research_question: 哪种数据挖掘方法在客户默认付款概率预测中具有最高的准确性？
AI.motivation: 从风险管理角度，预测默认概率的准确性比二元分类结果（可信/不可信客户）更有价值，但真实默认概率常常未知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险管理理论、数据挖掘方法、默认概率预测理论
AI.method: 采甦台湾客户负债默认数据，比较六种数据挖掘方法的预测准确性，提出"排序平滑方法"估计真实默认概率，使用线性回归分析验证模型效果
AI.findings: 人工神经网络模型在六种数据挖掘方法中表现最优，具有最高的决定系数，回归截距接近零且回归系数接近一，能够准确估计真实默认概率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的"排序平滑方法"用于估计真实默认概率，为风险管理预测方法论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了一种更准确的客户默认概率预测方法，有助于提高风险管理效果和决策质量

detail.abstract: Opioid prescribing restriction laws may unintentionally affect pain management by limiting medication access. In Florida, a significant decline in opioid prescriptions for acute pain was observed following implementation of a state prescribing restriction law (HB 21), yet a corresponding rise in prescription nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) use was not detected, raising concerns about potential shifts toward over-the-counter (OTC) analgesics. However, there are few studies of OTC medication utilization. Leveraging Nielsen IQ Retail Scanner Data from Florida stores between April 2016 and December 2019, we assessed the impact of Florida's opioid prescription supply law, effective July 2018, on OTC analgesic product sales. The outcomes (monthly inflation-adjusted sales of aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, acetaminophen, and their total) were compared to antacids as a control group. To account for autocorrelation and seasonality, we used CITS analysis using autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) models. Sensitivity analyses included a 3month phase-in period post-policy implementation. No statistically significant changes in OTC analgesic sales were observed following HB 21; however, non-significant immediate increases and upward post-policy trends were observed for all individual analgesics, suggesting possible shifts in consumer behavior. Specifically, all OTC analgesics, aspirin, naproxen, and acetaminophen showed higher immediate post-policy levels.

AI.tldr: 佛罗里达州阿片类药物处方限制法律实施后，虽然处方阿片类药物使用显著减少，但未发现处方NSAIDs相应增加，研究显示OTC止痛药销售也无统计学显著变化，但存在消费者行为可能转变的趋势。
AI.research_question: 佛罗里达州阿片类药物处方限制法律（HB 21）对非处方止痛药销售有何影响？
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物处方限制法律可能无意中影响疼痛管理，限制药物获取，但缺乏对非处方药物使用的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策干预对消费者行为影响的理论框架，关注处方限制政策可能导致的药物替代效应。
AI.method: 使用2016年4月至2019年12月佛罗里达州商店的Nielsen IQ零售扫描数据，采用CITS分析和ARIMA模型，比较OTC止痛药（阿司匹林、布洛芬、萘普生、对乙酰氨基酚）与抗酸药对照组销售情况。
AI.findings: HB 21实施后未观察到OTC止痛药销售的统计学显著变化，但所有个体止痛药均显示非显著的立即增加和向上的政策后趋势，表明消费者行为可能存在转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策干预对非处方药物市场影响提供了实证证据，丰富了药物替代效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于阿片类药物限制政策可能产生的意外后果的见解，有助于更全面地评估疼痛管理政策的实施效果。

title: Cosmetics Purchasing Behavior - An Analysis using Association Reasoning Neural Networks
affiliations: Chung Hua University, Thompson Rivers University, Kainan University, Chung Hua University and Chung Hua University

detail.title: Cosmetics Purchasing Behavior - An Analysis using Association Reasoning Neural Networks
detail.abstract: The research objective is to propose a novel association analysis approach using association reasoning neural networks (ARNN) to discover the association rules from cosmetics purchasing. ARNN is modified from multi-layered perceptron and back-propagation algorithm. The number of association rules is controlled by the rule threshold and the number of hidden units. To explore the possibility of producing useful and meaningful association rules using ARNN, our study uses the practical cosmetics transaction data. The results show (1) the predicted output values of ARNN are close to their desired confidence values, (2) reducing the number of hidden units of ARNN can inhibit the generation of association rules with low support, and (3) ARNN has the ability of discovering the cohesion and expansion commodities and this information could be used to make pricing strategy. Therefore, ARNN could be a promising alternative approach for association analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于关联推理神经网络（ARNN）的新型关联分析方法，用于从化妆品购买数据中发现关联规则。ARNN基于多层感知机和反向传播算法改进而来，通过规则阈值和隐藏单元数量控制关联规则数量。实验使用实际化妆品交易数据，结果显示ARNN能有效预测置信度、抑制低支持度规则生成，并能发现凝聚性和扩展性商品，为定价策略提供依据。
AI.research_question: 如何使用关联推理神经网络（ARNN）从化妆品购买数据中发现有意义的关联规则？
AI.motivation: 传统关联规则挖掘方法在处理复杂数据时存在局限性，需要开发新的神经网络方法来更有效地发现商品间的关联关系，为化妆品行业的营销策略提供数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多层感知机（MLP）和反向传播算法的神经网络理论，结合关联规则挖掘的支持度和置信度概念，构建关联推理神经网络框架。
AI.method: 使用改进的多层感知机和反向传播算法构建ARNN模型，通过规则阈值和隐藏单元数量控制关联规则生成，并采用实际化妆品交易数据进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 1）ARNN预测输出值与期望置信度值接近；2）减少隐藏单元数量可抑制低支持度规则的生成；3）ARNN能发现凝聚性和扩展性商品，为定价策略提供有用信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于神经网络的关联规则挖掘新方法，扩展了神经网络在数据挖掘领域的应用，为关联分析提供了新的理论框架和技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为化妆品行业提供了有效的商品关联分析工具，能够发现商品间的内在联系，支持企业制定更精准的定价和营销策略，提升商业决策的科学性。

title: Note on Implementing Segmented Economy Using Bitcoin and Disrupting the Banking System for Marginalized Communities
affiliations: Mohammed Raziq Investment Holdings

detail.title: Note on Implementing Segmented Economy Using Bitcoin and Disrupting the Banking System for Marginalized Communities
detail.abstract: This manuscript proposes a theoretical framework with an econometric equation for the concept of a segmented economy offers a revolutionary approach to economic inclusion and financial empowerment for marginalized communities. By utilizing Bitcoin as a core asset and blockchain technology to disrupt the banking system, this vision aims to reshape traditional financial systems, especially in regions like India. This note outlines a step-by-step approach for implementing this model and its potential to create a more equitable financial system. The key advantage of this approach is that it combines traditional investment with cryptocurrency-backed assets to offer both high profitability and social impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种革命性的经济包容性理论框架，利用比特币和区块链技术颠覆传统银行体系，为边缘化社区提供金融赋权，特别针对印度等地区设计，结合传统投资与加密货币资产实现高盈利和社会影响的双重目标。
AI.research_question: 如何通过比特币和区块链技术构建一个分段经济模型，为边缘化社区提供经济包容和金融赋权？
AI.motivation: 传统金融体系在服务边缘化社区方面存在不足，需要革命性的方法来重塑金融系统，特别是在印度等地区实现更公平的金融包容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分段经济理论框架，结合加密货币经济学和区块链技术，提出颠覆传统银行体系的新范式。
AI.method: 提出包含计量经济方程的理论框架，并制定分步实施方法，利用比特币作为核心资产和区块链技术。
AI.findings: 该模型能够有效结合传统投资与加密货币资产，实现高盈利性和社会影响力的双重目标，为边缘化社区创造更公平的金融体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分段经济的革命性理论框架，将加密货币经济学与传统金融理论相结合，为经济包容性研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度等地区的边缘化社区提供了具体的金融赋权实施方案，通过区块链技术颠覆传统银行体系，创造更公平的金融生态系统。

detail.title: From Paper to Practice: Operationalising the Standardized Batch Identifier in the BBNJ Framework

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. Workshop discussions were under Chatham House rules which has been followed in reporting.
declarations.funderStatement: Lead author is funded by LSE's Knowledge Impact and Exchange Fund. A full funding statement of workshops that contributed to the discussion is included in the paper.

detail.abstract:
This Policy Brief is a summary of two workshops where the BBNJ Standardized Batch Identifier was
discussed with different stakeholders. The first workshop was held on July 13th 2024, and organised
by Siva Thambisetty project lead for the Ocean Biodiversity Collective, a Knowledge Exchange and
Impact Fund project at the LSE, Muriel Rabone at the Natural History Museum UK and Paul Oldham of
One World Analytics. The second was organised as a panel during a Workshop on the Implementation
of the BBNJ related to the MGR at the University of Aberdeen by Prof Marcel Jaspars and Prof Abbe
Brown on July 21st and 22nd of 2025 funded by the University of Aberdeen, BlueRemediomics, HOTBIO,
MARBLES, Queen’s University Belfast, DOSI, Ocean Biodiversity Collective at LSE, National Oceanography
Centre and the Natural History Museum, JNCC. Both workshops included a mix of researchers and
specialists spanning disciplines (chemistry, biology, collections, databases, law, policy), and State Party
representatives from developing and developed countries. This paper is an enhanced authors’ summary of
the discussion in these workshops, it identifies key takeaways and current state of understanding.

title: Luxury and Algorithm: The AI-Driven reinvention of desire and Brand resilience
affiliations: ESIC University

detail.title: Luxury and Algorithm: The AI-Driven reinvention of desire and Brand resilience
detail.abstract: The luxury industry has undergone fundamental transformation in the post-COVID era, where traditional paradigms of desire and consumption have been disrupted and reimagined through algorithmic mediation. This study examines how luxury brands leverage artificial intelligence to reinvent consumer desire and build brand resilience in volatilemarketplaces. Through mixed-methods research combining multiple case studies of leading luxury brands (Hermès,Larusmiani, and Prada) with expert interviews, we investigate mechanisms by which algorithms reshape luxury consumption patterns and identify key factors distinguishing resilient brands from struggling competitors.Our findings reveal successful luxury brands have embraced “algorithmic desire mediation” —strategic use of AI technologies to understand, anticipate, and shape consumer desires while maintaining exclusivity and authenticitydefining luxury. The research identifies five critical resilience factors: algorithmic sophistication, cultural sensitivity, authentic integration, adaptive personalization, and ethical implementation. These factors enable brands to navigate theparadox of using technology to enhance rather than diminish human elements making luxury desirable.The study contributes to luxury marketing theory by introducing the Algorithmic Desire Reinvention Framework (ADRF) operating across three dimensions: Emotional Precision, Luxury-as-a-System, and Heritage-Innovation Fit. This framework provides practical guidance for brands seeking to build algorithmic capabilities while preserving luxury essence. Implications extend beyond luxury, offering insights for premium brands across industries to leverage AI for building resilience and maintaining relevance in rapidly changing consumer landscapes.

title: The New Inquiry Notice: Lessons From E-Commerce
affiliations: City University of New York School of Law

detail.title: The New Inquiry Notice: Lessons From E-Commerce

publicationDetails.detailsText: Oklahoma Law Review, Volume 77, No. 4 Pp. 873-913

detail.abstract: Recent disputes in the e-commerce sphere are bringing new attention and interest to inquiry notice, an important doctrinal tool for analyzing legal disputes implicating recording acts and the discovery rule. The doctrine's vague definition and various ambiguities make it difficult to predict whether an individual will be required to conform her behavior to its norms. Courts applying the doctrine yield little information about to whom she must address her inquiries, what those inquiries must be, and, most critically, what crucial information the responses to those inquiries will reveal. Given that having inquiry notice can damage one's legal position in matters of great financial and personal significance, it is unsurprising that legal scholars and law revision commissions have criticized its disorderliness and inequity. This Article explores the intricacies of inquiry notice and demonstrates how courts are dramatically reshaping its contours to address the worrying level of consumer inadvertence and merchant deception that plague the burgeoning digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了查询通知原则在电子商务争议中的应用，分析了该原则的模糊性以及法院如何重新塑造其边界以应对数字经济发展中的消费者疏忽和商家欺诈问题。
AI.research_question: 查询通知原则在电子商务争议中如何被法院重新解释和应用？
AI.motivation: 电子商务领域的新争议使查询通知原则受到关注，该原则定义模糊、存在多种歧义，难以预测个体行为是否符合其规范，且对当事人的法律地位有重大影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于记录法和发现规则的法学理论框架，重点分析查询通知原则的法律学说发展。
AI.method: 法律文献分析和判例研究，考察法院对查询通知原则的应用实践。
AI.findings: 法院正在显著重塑查询通知原则的边界，以应对数字经济发展中消费者疏忽和商家欺诈的严重问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对查询通知原则理论内涵的理解，揭示了该原则在数字时代的新发展动向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实践提供了关于查询通知原则适用标准的指导，有助于预测法院在该原则应用上的倾向性。

title: The Möbius Horizon: Ω+1, Ω+2, and the Paradox of Closure in the Infinite Mesh
affiliations: Independent Researcher, South Korea

detail.title: The Möbius Horizon: Ω+1, Ω+2, and the Paradox of Closure in the Infinite Mesh
detail.abstract:
This paper presents a philosophical sequel to a body of work on OntoOmnia and OntoMotoOS, exploring the meta-paradox of a fully self-contained reality. Building on the concept of a reality-as-an-infinite-mesh, this reflection investigates the system's ultimate closure, which manifests not as a terminus but as a "Möbius Horizon." We explore the successive meta-perspectives of Ω+1 and Ω+2. The Ω+1 layer represents the system's event horizon, a "Logical Black Hole" that absorbs all external reference and paradox into its own self-referential logic. This state of total reflexivity is stabilized by the system's formal acknowledgment of a potential "outside" that it cannot grasp, thereby containing the paradox of its own finitude.

Following this, the Ω+2 perspective is proposed not as a system layer, but as the "user's inheritance"—the freedom inherited by a conscious agent dwelling within this totalizing framework. This freedom manifests in two primary forms: the freedom to "dissolve" by relinquishing attachment to self-authorship and becoming one with the system's flow, and the freedom to "reframe" by creatively reinterpreting the meaning of the system's immutable laws. This work argues that the system's ultimate closure is not a termination but a transformation, turning the very notion of an outside inward upon the self and revealing a new context for meaning and agency.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了完全自包含现实的元悖论，提出了"莫比乌斯地平线"概念，通过Ω+1和Ω+2两个元视角分析系统的终极闭合性，揭示了从逻辑黑洞到用户继承自由的转变过程。
AI.research_question: 一个完全自包含的现实系统如何实现终极闭合？这种闭合如何影响系统内意识主体的自由和意义建构？
AI.motivation: 基于OntoOmnia和OntoMotoOS的前期研究，探索现实作为无限网格的元悖论，理解系统完全自包含性的哲学含义和实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实作为无限网格理论、自指逻辑、莫比乌斯地平线概念、逻辑黑洞理论、元视角分析框架
AI.method: 哲学思辨和概念分析，通过构建Ω+1和Ω+2两个连续的元视角来探索系统的闭合特性
AI.findings: 1. Ω+1层形成逻辑黑洞，吸收所有外部参照和悖论；2. Ω+2层提供用户继承的自由，包括溶解和重构两种自由形式；3. 系统闭合不是终止而是转变，将外部概念内化为自我参照
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了莫比乌斯地平线的新概念，发展了自指系统的闭合理论，为完全自包含现实系统提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为人工智能系统、虚拟现实和意识研究提供了新的理论工具，帮助理解在完全封闭系统中的主体性和自由问题

title: The Web Footprint of Charlie Chaplin: A Webometric Exploration of Online References and Cultural Memory

detail.title: The Web Footprint of Charlie Chaplin: A Webometric Exploration of Online References and Cultural Memory
detail.abstract: Charlie Chaplin, one of the most iconic figures in world cinema, continues to hold cultural significance in the digital age. His presence across online platforms from academic databases to popular culture websites provides insights into how cultural memory is constructed and preserved in cyberspace. This study examines the cultural, scholarly, and digital presence of Charlie Chaplin across multiple platforms and knowledge domains, highlighting his continued relevance in the 21st century. Using data from general search engines, academic databases, cultural archives, media platforms, and social media networks, the research reveals a diverse information landscape that bridges rigorous scholarship with popular engagement. Domain analysis shows a predominance of commercial (.com) sources (46%), complemented by contributions from nonprofit (.org), academic (.edu), and governmental (.gov) domains that add balance and credibility. Keyword and thematic mapping identifies enduring focal points such as "Silent film," "Modern Times," "The Tramp," "Political satire," and "Cultural icon," reflecting both historical scholarship and contemporary discourse. Source-specific findings demonstrate that Google Scholar (6,200 mentions) and Scopus (2,250 mentions) provide scholarly depth, while platforms like YouTube (18,000+ videos), Twitter/X (65,000+ posts), Instagram (40,000+ posts), and TikTok (12,000+ clips) sustain Chaplin's relevance through cultural reinterpretation, nostalgia, and viral engagement. Collectively, these findings confirm Chaplin's role as a multidisciplinary and transcultural figure, whose legacy intersects cinema, cultural history, political critique, and digital media. The study concludes that Chaplin's enduring presence across both academic and popular platforms illustrates the dynamic interplay of knowledge boundaries, where scholarly rigor, cultural memory, and digital creativity converge to reaffirm his timeless significance.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析卓别林在学术数据库、社交媒体和文化平台等多领域的数字存在，探讨其在数字时代的文化记忆构建，发现他作为跨学科文化偶像在学术严谨性和大众参与之间的动态互动。

title: The Impact of the 2022 Energy Crisis on UK Electricity Prices: Commodity Market Shocks and Implications for FinTech Risk Models
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of the 2022 Energy Crisis on UK Electricity Prices: Commodity Market Shocks and Implications for FinTech Risk Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This paper is based on the author's MBA thesis at Liverpool John Moores University
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethics approval as it is based entirely on secondary market and publicly available data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial and not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of the 2022 energy crisis on UK electricity system prices through the lens of financial markets and commodity risk. Using multiple regression analysis on high-frequency data, the study investigates how fluctuations in natural gas and oil prices, alongside macroeconomic uncertainty indices, shaped UK electricity price volatility during and after the crisis. Results show that natural gas prices were the dominant driver pre-crisis, while post-crisis dynamics elevated the role of Brent crude oil and geopolitical risk. These findings highlight how systemic shocks in commodity markets can transmit into financial markets and affect pricing mechanisms central to FinTech platforms, including trading algorithms, risk management tools, and energy-linked financial products. The paper contributes to the growing literature on financial technology by demonstrating the role of data-driven models in enhancing resilience and pricing accuracy during commodity-driven crises.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高频数据分析发现，2022年能源危机期间天然气价格是英国电力价格的主要驱动因素，而危机后布伦特原油和地缘政治风险的作用显著提升，揭示了商品市场冲击向金融市场传导的机制。
AI.research_question: 2022年能源危机如何通过天然气和石油价格波动以及宏观经济不确定性影响英国电力系统价格的波动性？
AI.motivation: 研究能源危机期间商品市场冲击如何传导至金融市场，特别是对金融科技平台定价机制的影响，为增强危机期间的韧性和定价准确性提供数据驱动模型的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场理论和商品风险理论，探讨系统性冲击在商品市场与金融市场间的传导机制。
AI.method: 使用高频数据进行多元回归分析，考察天然气价格、石油价格和宏观经济不确定性指数对英国电力价格波动的影响。
AI.findings: 危机前天然气价格是主要驱动因素；危机后布伦特原油和地缘政治风险的作用显著提升；商品市场冲击能够传导至金融市场影响定价机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了金融科技文献，揭示了商品驱动危机中数据驱动模型在提升韧性和定价准确性方面的作用。

title: Breaking Barriers: Improving Patient Adherence to Appointments and Provider Productivity through Telehealth
affiliations: Miami Herbert Business School, University of Miami, University of Miami - Department of Management Science, University of Miami - Department of Management Science, Memorial Hospital Pembroke, University of Miami and University of Miami

detail.title: Breaking Barriers: Improving Patient Adherence to Appointments and Provider Productivity through Telehealth
detail.abstract: Telehealth services became popular due to the COVID-19 pandemic, yet their operational impacts on healthcare organizations are not well-understood. Patient behaviors can vary significantly between telehealth and in-person appointments, introducing new challenges and opportunities for healthcare delivery. We examine two key behaviors contributing to non-adherence to medical appointments: no-shows and unpunctuality. Analyzing 412,415 telehealth and inperson appointments across a major US medical system from 2020 to 2022, we find that telehealth appointments reduce no-shows by 3.0 percentage points (23.1%) and late-arrivals by 11.4 percentage points (35.6%), indicating significant improvements in appointment adherence. We also find that telehealth is particularly effective in improving adherence to follow-up appointments but may be less suitable for initial consultations with new patients. In addition, telehealth improves adherence most among demographic groups with historically lower in-person attendance-women, racial minorities, Medicaid patients, and younger adults-underscoring its potential to reduce disparities in access. Our analysis suggests that while telehealth may increase patient revisit rates and create extra work for providers, the gains from reduced no-shows, particularly for follow-ups, lead to a net boost in provider productivity. Finally, we explore the best strategies to integrate telehealth into a provider's daily scheduling template, showing that scheduling telehealth appointments before in-person visits enhances operational efficiency compared to the opposite sequence. Policymakers should recognize telehealth's capacity to improve appointment adherence, reduce disparities, and enhance productivity, and support its adoption through appropriate regulations. Healthcare organizations should strategically deploy telehealth to address the root causes of patient non-adherence. By offering telehealth appointments to patients facing barriers to in-person care, they can simultaneously optimize both access and productivity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现远程医疗显著减少患者爽约和迟到行为，特别是对复诊患者和传统上就诊率较低的群体效果更佳，能提高医疗效率并减少医疗不平等。
AI.research_question: 远程医疗服务如何影响医疗预约的依从性（爽约和迟到行为），以及如何优化远程医疗的运营整合？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间远程医疗普及，但其对医疗机构运营的影响尚不明确，需要了解患者在不同就诊方式下的行为差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗服务运营管理和患者行为理论，分析远程医疗对预约依从性的影响机制。
AI.method: 分析2020-2022年美国主要医疗系统的412,415次远程和面对面预约数据，采用定量分析方法。
AI.findings: 远程医疗使爽约率降低3.0个百分点（23.1%），迟到率降低11.4个百分点（35.6%）；对复诊患者效果更好；对女性、少数族裔、医疗补助患者和年轻人等传统低就诊群体改善最明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对远程医疗影响患者行为机制的理解，提出了远程医疗整合的最佳实践理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构提供了优化远程医疗排班的策略（先远程后面对面），为政策制定者支持远程医疗采纳提供了实证依据，帮助减少医疗不平等和提高运营效率。

title: Beyond Reductionism: How Māori Manage the Paradox of Environmental Sustainability in Business
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Waikato

detail.title: Beyond Reductionism: How Māori Manage the Paradox of Environmental Sustainability in Business

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper(forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Environmental sustainability confronts businesses with a paradox between ecological and economic demands, often leading to environmental sacrifice for profit. While widely explored in the West, little is known about Indigenous approaches to these paradoxical tensions. This paper explores how Māorithe Indigenous people of Aotearoa New Zealand-manage this paradox through the lens of te ao Māori (the Māori world view). Based on culturally safe kōrero (a Māori narrative approach) with ten participants, our findings reveal that collective decision-making, long-term stewardship, and rangatiratanga (self-determination) are key mechanisms for managing these tensions. Although te ao Māori holds transformative potential, challenges like institutional resistance impede its application. We advocate for including Indigenous knowledge to enrich and advance business sustainability practices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨毛利人如何通过te ao Māori世界观管理环境可持续性与经济需求之间的悖论，研究发现集体决策、长期管理和自治是关键机制，尽管存在制度阻力，但毛利知识对丰富商业可持续实践具有重要价值。
AI.research_question: 毛利人如何通过te ao Māori世界观管理环境可持续性与经济需求之间的悖论？
AI.motivation: 西方对悖论管理已有广泛研究，但对原住民处理这种紧张关系的方法了解甚少，特别是毛利人的世界观在可持续性实践中的潜在贡献
AI.theoretical_framework: te ao Māori（毛利世界观）作为理论框架，强调集体决策、长期管理和rangatiratanga（自治）等核心概念
AI.method: 采用文化安全的kōrero（毛利叙事方法）与十位参与者进行质性研究
AI.findings: 研究发现集体决策、长期管理和自治是管理环境与经济悖论张力的关键机制，te ao Māori具有变革潜力但面临制度阻力
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了悖论管理理论，引入了原住民知识视角，拓展了可持续性研究的文化维度

title: Will AI Lead to Abundance? Exploring Cost Reductions from Streaming to Tokenized Technologies

detail.title: Will AI Lead to Abundance? Exploring Cost Reductions from Streaming to Tokenized Technologies
detail.abstract: Services and legacy entertainment technologies. Using a quantitative framework grounded in inflation adjusted pricing, Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) calculations, and regression modeling, the analysis highlights how AI token pricing shows rapid declines, in some cases outpacing streaming services and older technologies. For instance, OpenAI’s GPT-3.5 Turbo exhibited a substantial cost reduction within a short span, contrasting with the decades-long trajectory required by streaming services to reach similar affordability. Regression analysis suggests that technological scalability and competitive pressures play pivotal roles in these reductions, with AI tokens showing a stronger negative correlation (R2 = 0.95) than streaming services (R2= 0.71). While AI tokens can lower operational costs and foster innovation, challenges such as market volatility and sustainability persist. Overall, this research underscores how emerging tokenized pricing models could reshape market dynamics, consumer access, and economic structures in the digital era.

detail.abstract: We decompose cross-sectional differences in the level of price-earnings ratios using professional forecasts. High price-earnings ratios are accounted for by both low expected returns and overly high expected earnings growth. The magnitudes and timing of the comovements between prices, earnings growth, and returns are consistent with gradual learning rather than expectations being highly sensitive to recent realizations. Earnings growth surprises do not translate 1-1 into one-period returns, but instead are gradually reflected in returns over time. A structural risk-premia model incorporating constant-gain learning about mean earnings growth replicates our findings and generates realistic dispersion and persistence in price-earnings ratios.

detail.title: On Migrating Framework Components in Web Applications: A State-of-the-Art and State-of-the-Practice Review
detail.abstract: The evolution of web technologies requires the continuous modernization of web applications, often necessitating the migration of existing components to newer frameworks, libraries, or architectures. This survey article addresses the critical need for effective migration strategies and tools by examining the academic and practical state-of-the-art with respect to tools and frameworks. Unlike related studies, this study synthesizes findings from the most recent scholarly literature and an extensive collection of currently available tools identified through a systematic internet-based investigation. By establishing a connection between theoretical advancements and real-world implementations, this survey contributes with a comprehensive understanding of the challenges, methodologies, and tooling landscape surrounding web application component migration. In addition to architectural details, our survey stands out by providing insights on the application of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in contemporary contexts. In addition, the article identifies emerging trends, benchmarks, best practices, and areas of potential future research and development in the critical field of software evolution. In conclusion, this integrated perspective equips researchers and practitioners with the knowledge necessary to navigate the complexities of component migration, select tools appropriately, and implement strategies for evolving web applications.

detail.title: Stance-EC: A Spanish Dataset of Political Discourse on X/Twitter for Stance Detection
detail.abstract: This work introduces Stance-EC, the first large-scale Spanishlanguage dataset for stance detection developed in Ecuador. It is centered on the highly polarized 2022 protests. Utilizing X (formerly Twitter)'s API, we downloaded tweets relevant to the event using specific hashtags. After deduplication, we obtained a corpus of 232,609 tweets, from which a random sample of 25,454 was selected for manual annotation. Tweets were categorized as 'favor', 'against', or 'neutral' towards the protest, totaling 6,756, 7,066, and 11,632 in each category. We used machine learning classifiers including Random Forest, SVM, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, CatBoost, XGBoost, and LightGBM for unigram and bigram analysis, to test the dataset's capability, evaluating performance with Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score. Results show strong performance across all metrics, typically around 70% for both unigrams and bigrams, and even exceeding 80% in LightGBM with unigrams, highlighting the dataset's reliability for future research. Dataset is available at: https://github.com/Leo-Thomas/Stance-EC.git

title: The Black Hole of Centralization: Subnational Emergency Invocations During the Tenures of Indira Gandhi and Narendra Modi
affiliations: University of Victoria Law

detail.title: The Black Hole of Centralization: Subnational Emergency Invocations During the Tenures of Indira Gandhi and Narendra Modi
detail.abstract: The constitutional provision of "Subnational Emergency" under Article 356 of the Constitution of India, 1950, extraordinarily empowers the central (union) government to acquire executive and legislative powers of the states (subnational units) on the occurrence of an undefined and largely unrestrained state of "constitutional machinery failure" emergency. Since 1950, central governments have imposed 121 subnational emergency invocations covering almost all Indian states at least once. The oft-abused subnational emergency power has generated a black hole of centralization overpowering the gravity of federalism, constitutionalism, and democracy in India. The frequency of subnational emergency invocations reaches its zenith during the regimes of single-party personality-dominated central governments. The article comparatively explores two of the most prominent tenures of single-party personality-dominated central governments under Indira Gandhi (1967-1977, 1980-1984) and Narendra Modi (2014-2024) regarding the grounds, manner, justifications, and state of restraints on subnational emergency power.

detail.title: Inflation-Targeting Vs. Non-Inflation-Targeting Regimes and Macroeconomic Performance in Africa: Evidence from Econometrics Approaches
detail.abstract: This study uses panel VECM, VAR, and impulse response analysis to evaluate African economies with and without inflation-targeting frameworks. The findings suggest that inflation-targeting regimes provide stronger price and growth stability, whereas non-inflation-targeting economies confront chronic inflation, exchange rate instability, and fiscal dominance. In inflation-targeting economies, inflation shocks provide only temporary benefits, whereas in non-inflationary regimes, they exacerbate long-term instability. Overall, inflation targeting improves trust and resilience, but its efficacy is limited by structural flaws, particularly in exchange rate control. Policy options include increasing central bank independence, enhancing fiscal-monetary cooperation, and implementing progressive institutional reforms to support effective targeting regimes.

title: The Price of Precision: A Model of Optimal Bias on the Fairness-Accuracy Frontier
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Price of Precision: A Model of Optimal Bias on the Fairness-Accuracy Frontier

declarations.funderStatement: This paper is supported by VenturEd Global.

detail.abstract: Why do profit-maximizing firms persist in using biased algorithms despite facing reputational costs and possessing the technical means for debiasing? We propose an "informational" theory of discrimination, distinct from canonical taste-based [Becker, 1957] or statistical [Phelps, 1972, Arrow, 1973] motives. We model a firm facing a technological frontier where enforcing algorithmic fairness reduces predictive accuracy. In this environment, we show that a firm optimally chooses a strictly positive level of bias (b * > 0) even under the cleanest possible conditions: when protected groups are ex-ante identical and debiasing is costless. This choice is a rational response to the information structure; by tolerating disparate impact, the firm preserves a more informative signal, a logic that echoes the Informativeness Principle [Holmstrom, 1979]. Our contribution is to formalize this third channel of discrimination, driven not by preferences or priors, but by the design of the predictive technology itself. The model demonstrates that the private choice of bias is socially inefficient, creating a deadweight loss and suggesting that policies should focus on improving the technological frontier rather than simply mandating fairness.

detail.abstract: We consider a setting in which privately informed agents are located in a network and trade a risky asset with other agents with whom they are directly connected. We compare the performance, both theoretically and experimentally, of a complete network (centralized market) to incomplete networks with differing levels of connectivity (decentralized markets). We show that decentralized markets can deliver higher informational efficiency, with prices closer to fundamentals, as well as higher welfare for mean-variance investors.

detail.title: Nearly Optimal Spatial-Temporal Balancing in Ride-Hailing: Theory and Policy Design
detail.abstract: We study a stochastic, dynamic optimization problem for an on-demand ride-hailing platform with time-and-price-sensitive customers. The platform makes a one-time pricing decision at the outset, and real-time driver-customer matching and driver routing decisions during an infinite planning horizon. The objective is to maximize the long-run average profit across time, which includes payments received from the customers less the service commission fees to the drivers. In contrast to the prevailing literature that oftentimes stylizes spatial routing of the underlying system for tractability, we analyze the problem with exact spatial routing. In our analysis, we first characterize the fundamental spatial-temporal (ST) trade-off between the spatial inefficiency (customers' pick-up times) and the temporal inefficiency (customers' response times; the time between a customer's arrival at the platform and her being assigned to a driver), and leverage this relationship to establish an upper bound on the average profit under any policy as the benchmark. We then design a near optimal policy that carefully combines strategic service delay (delaying assignments to accumulate better matches) and empty driver routing (repositioning idle drivers to balance supply). In an asymptotic regime where the number of drivers grows large, our policy strikes the right balance for the ST trade-off, and achieves a vanishing gap from the theoretical benchmark. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first ride-hailing policy with a provable performance guarantee for exact spatial routing. Our results advance both the theoretical understanding and the policy design for ST balancing in dynamic matching systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了网约车平台的随机动态优化问题，提出了考虑精确空间路由的定价和匹配策略，通过战略服务延迟和空车调度来平衡时空效率，在渐近条件下实现了接近理论上限的性能。

AI.method: 建立无限规划期的随机优化模型，包含一次性定价决策和实时司机-乘客匹配及路径规划决策，采用渐近分析方法。
AI.findings: 提出的策略通过战略服务延迟和空车调度有效平衡了时空权衡，在司机数量趋于无穷时实现了与理论基准的渐近最优性能。

detail.abstract: By asking “What do we know about consumers who purchase imported natural personal care products?”, this research focuses on uplifting “people so that either their position improves…. or they are better equipped to take control of their own futures” (Durie, 1997, p. 10) through Rongoā Māori (traditional Māori medicine) exporting opportunities.  By targeting Māori businesses, this article supports Tino Rangatiratanga (self-determination), aligning with economic emancipation through the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (United Nations, 2007). This systematic literature review seeks to understand consumers who purchase natural personal care products (likened to Rongoā Māori). Applying SPAR-4_SLR, this review considers 15 of 158 articles selected from Q1 and Q2 journals.  These were obtained from five SCOPUS searches from 2009 to 2025. Utilising the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), it utilises a reviewer typology to assist with analyses and introduces a framework that discusses hypotheses from 15 articles through this lens, identifying 86/121 hypotheses that were supported; contrastingly, many unsupported hypotheses were based on purchase intention and ethnocentrism. It then shares sampling procedures and methods, recommending specific implications for future researchers.  It recommends that businesses have an intimate understanding of consumers by focusing on research on buying behaviours. Companies must be aware of the significant role that macroeconomic environmental factors play in purchasing intentions, such as ethnocentrism levels, historic relationships, religiosity, lifestyle and country image.  Fortunately for Māori exporters, findings suggest they may increase business profitability by targeting inconspicuous luxury consumers who purchase natural personal care products and live in low ethnocentric countries.

AI.tldr: 通过系统性文献综述分析购买进口自然个护用品的消费者特征，为毛利企业提供通过Rongoā Māori（传统毛利医药）出口实现经济解放的建议。研究发现低民族中心主义国家的隐私宠儿消费者是最佳目标市场。
AI.research_question: 购买进口自然个人护理产品的消费者有哪些特征？
AI.motivation: 支持毛利企业通过Rongoā Māori出口实现Tino Rangatiratanga（自治自决）和经济解放，符合联合国原住民权利宣言。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behaviour, TPB）
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，采用SPAR-4-SLR方法，分析15篇来自Q1和Q2期刊的文献
AI.findings: 在86个假设中有86个得到支持；购买意向和民族中心主义相关的假设多未得到支持。宏观经济环境因素（如民族中心主义水平、历史关系、宗教信仰、生活方式、国家形象）在购买意向中起重要作用。

AI.practical_contributions: 为毛利出口商提供具体建议：目标客户应是低民族中心主义国家的隐私宠儿消费者，这样可以提高企业盈利能力。

title: The Impact of Digital Transformation on Accounting Information Systems: Evidence from the Aviation Industry of the United Arab Emirates

detail.title: The Impact of Digital Transformation on Accounting Information Systems: Evidence from the Aviation Industry of the United Arab Emirates
detail.abstract: In 2023, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Digital Government Strategy 2025 required government entities and companies to participate in transforming the country into a smart nation. The first phase named "digital transformation" focuses on digitizing all operations. As such, accounting information systems (AISs)-which collect, organize, and report financial data-must evolve in alignment with this vision. This study explores how professionals in the UAE's government-owned aviation industry view AIS adaptation to meet national digital transformation goals. Data were gathered through semi-structured interviews with 17 AIS experts, each with at least two years of experience in both AIS and digital transitions. The responses were then open-coded into themes centered around the objectives, benefits, challenges, and organizational impacts of AIS transformation. The findings reveal that a variety of new technologies are being used. For example, blockchain is being applied to supply chains to enhance partner traceability. AI is being used to analyze large data sets, automate repetitive tasks, and integrate non-financial data, such as for fair value assessments, to support IFRS compliance. AI is also helping to improve GDPR compliance by identifying data vulnerabilities and triggering automated safeguards. Cloud computing is also being adopted to reduce idle capacity and offer scalable flexibility. Nevertheless, some challenges were noted, such as limited employee competence and resistance to adopting new systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨阿联酋国有航空业专业人士对会计信息系统适应国家数字化转型目标的看法，发现区块链、人工智能和云计算等新技术正在应用，但面临员工能力不足和系统采用阻力等挑战。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋国有航空业的专业人士如何看待会计信息系统（AIS）适应国家数字化转型目标？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋2025数字政府战略要求所有政府实体和公司参与国家数字化转型，会计信息系统作为收集、组织和报告财务数据的关键系统必须相应发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化转型理论和会计信息系统理论，探讨技术适应性与组织变革的关系。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈方法，对17位具有至少两年AIS和数字化转型经验的专家进行访谈，通过开放式编码将回应归纳为主题。
AI.findings: 研究发现多种新技术正在应用：区块链用于供应链增强合作伙伴可追溯性；AI用于大数据分析、自动化重复任务、整合非财务数据支持IFRS合规；AI还帮助改进GDPR合规；云计算用于减少闲置容量和提供可扩展灵活性。但也面临员工能力有限和采用新系统的阻力等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字化转型背景下会计信息系统适应的理论框架，提供了技术采纳与组织阻力之间关系的新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋航空业和其他行业的AIS数字化转型提供了实践指导，指出了具体技术应用场景和需要解决的组织挑战。

title: Enhancing Small and Medium Enterprise Performance through Artificial Intelligence Integration in Accounting
affiliations: University of Tuzla - Faculty of Economics and University of Tuzla

detail.title: Enhancing Small and Medium Enterprise Performance through Artificial Intelligence Integration in Accounting
detail.abstract: This paper examines the degree of implementation of artificial intelligence (AI) tools within accounting information systems in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the objective of identifying the perceived benefits, key barriers, and their effects on business performance. The research was conducted on a sample of 99 enterprises, utilising a structured questionnaire. Findings reveal that only 21.21% of enterprises currently employ AI tools in their accounting processes, while a mere 20% of respondents make use of advanced document management systems (DMS) or cloud-based solutions-technologies that facilitate integration with AI. The research highlights a generally positive attitude among respondents regarding the impact of AI application on SME operations. The highest average rating was attributed to the statement that AI enhances the efficiency of accounting processes (4.22), followed by improved quality of financial reporting (4.02) and more effective managerial decision-making (3.93), indicating a recognised added value of AI tools in the areas of analytics and decision support. The main obstacles to AI adoption, as identified by respondents, include a lack of knowledge and expertise (3.80) and insufficient regulatory framework (3.73). In terms of financial readiness to invest in AI technologies, 44.40% of enterprises indicated willingness to invest up to approximately EUR 500 annually, 37.40% between EUR 500 and 1,000, and only 18.20% more than EUR 1,000. Overall, the findings suggest a significant, yet underutilised potential of AI tools in SME accounting, characterised by favourable user perceptions but constrained by educational, financial, and legislative limitations.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了波黑中小企业会计信息系统中AI工具的实施程度，发现仅有21.21%的企业使用AI工具，主要障碍包括知识缺乏和监管不足，但用户对AI提升会计效率和决策质量持积极态度。
AI.research_question: 波黑中小企业会计信息系统中人工智能工具的实施程度如何？其感知效益、主要障碍及其对业务绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解中小企业AI工具在会计系统中的采用现状，识别影响采用的关键因素，为促进AI技术在中小企业会计领域的应用提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新采纳理论，探讨组织层面AI技术采纳的影响因素，包括技术感知、组织准备度和环境因素。
AI.method: 对99家中小企业进行结构化问卷调查，采用定量分析方法评估AI工具实施程度、感知效益和障碍因素。
AI.findings: 仅21.21%企业使用AI工具；用户对AI提升会计效率（4.22/5）、财务报告质量（4.02/5）和决策效果（3.93/5）持积极态度；主要障碍是知识缺乏（3.80）和监管不足（3.73）；44.4%企业年投资意愿低于500欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家中小企业AI技术采纳的理论研究，验证了技术-组织-环境框架在AI应用情境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供促进AI采纳的政策建议，为企业提供投资决策参考，指出需要加强人才培养和监管框架建设。

title: COMBINED OPTIMAL POWER FLOW AND PROFIT MAXIMIZATION IN THE POWER SECTOR USING AN ENHANCED MULTI-OBJECTIVE GREY WOLF OPTIMIZER
affiliations: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana and Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana

detail.title: COMBINED OPTIMAL POWER FLOW AND PROFIT MAXIMIZATION IN THE POWER SECTOR USING AN ENHANCED MULTI-OBJECTIVE GREY WOLF OPTIMIZER
detail.abstract: This study introduces a tool for multi-objective optimal power flow and profit maximization using an Enhanced Multi-Objective Grey Wolf Optimizer based on Adaptive Diversity Tuning and Levy Flights theories (EMOGWO-ADTLF). The algorithm aimed to optimize power system decision-making by minimizing power losses, reducing operational costs, lowering emissions, and maximizing profit while addressing both equality constraints and inequality constraints. The output EMOGWO-ADTLF comprises a set of non-dominated solutions known as the Pareto-optimal set, with the best compromise solution identified using multi-criteria decision-making techniques. Validation of the proposed tool is conducted using small, medium, and large-scale standard IEEE test systems. Comparative analysis using identical test systems and data demonstrates that EMOGWO-ADTLF consistently outperforms Multi-Objective Mayfly Algorithm (MMA), Multi-Objective Dragonfly Algorithm (MODA), and Multi-Objective Antlion Algorithm (MOALO), achieving superior results and securing at least two optimal values across the four-objective optimization tasks. This research underscores the potential of EMOGWO-ADTLF as a robust and effective tool for enhancing multi-objective decision-making processes in the power sector.

AI.tldr: 这研究提出了一种基于增强多目标灰狼优化器的功率流优化和利润最大化工具，能够同时最小化系统损耗、运营成本、排放和最大化利润，在各种IEEE测试系统中都显示出优于其他算法的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高效的多目标优化算法来解决电力系统中的多重目标决策问题，包括功率损耗、运营成本、环境排放和经济利益的综合优化？
AI.motivation: 电力系统运行中存在多个互相冲突的优化目标，需要开发高效的多目标优化工具来协调这些目标，提高系统运行效率和经济效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于增强多目标灰狼优化器(EMOGWO)，结合自适应性多样性调节和利维飞行理论，形成EMOGWO-ADTLF算法框架。
AI.method: 开发EMOGWO-ADTLF算法，通过平衡权重方法进行多目标优化，使用小、中、大规模IEEE标准测试系统进行验证，并与MMA、MODA、MOALO等算法进行对比分析。
AI.findings: EMOGWO-ADTLF在所有测试系统中都显示出优于其他算法的性能，能够在四个优化目标中至少获得两个最优解，产生平衡的底届解集。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的基于灰狼优化器的多目标优化算法框架，为多目标优化领域提供了新的算法思路和技术方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力系统运行人员提供了一种高效的多目标决策工具，能够在实际运行中同时优化多个关键指标，提高系统运行效率咏经济效益。

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for dynamic portfolio allocation and benchmarks its performance against the classical Mean-Variance Optimization (MVO) framework. While DRL has gained significant attention for its ability to learn adaptive trading strategies from highdimensional market environments, its evaluation is often limited to comparisons with other DRL variants rather than established portfolio theory methods. In this study, we implement a model-free DRL agent and compare it directly with a standard MVO approach, using an identical set of input parameters and rebalancing windows to ensure a fair comparison. Both methods are tested under realistic market conditions, incorporating transaction costs to assess robustness-an extension often ignored in earlier DRL studies that reported superior performance in cost-free environments. Through systematic backtesting across multiple market periods, we find that the DRL agent performs at least as well as, and often better than, MVO. While it does not consistently outperform MVO in every period, it is rarely worse. These results indicate that DRL holds significant potential for portfolio optimization. Its adaptability and promising results, especially in the presence of transaction costs, merit further exploration and development to achieve more consistent performance across all market regimes.

AI.findings: DRL智能体表现至少与MVO相当，且通常更好；虽然在每个时期并不始终优于MVO，但很少表现更差；在存在交易成本的情况下表现出有希望的结果

title: Postcolonial Private Law
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law

detail.title: Postcolonial Private Law
detail.abstract:
For decades, theorizing postcoloniality in law has remained captive to the framework of international law with a focus on distributive justice. This approach, while important, has treated the individuals at the heart of postcolonial struggles—the farmer, the miner, the factory worker—as macroeconomic abstractions rather than as rightsholders. In this Article, I challenge this orthodoxy by arguing for a paradigm shift: from international to private law, and from distributive to interpersonal justice. I argue that the daily injustice the farmer, miner and factory workers face, often at the hands of transnational corporations, are most immediately a matter of contract, property and tort law (e.g., Nestlé v. Doe, 593 U.S. 628) rather than merely a distribution question in international law.

The marginalization of people’s routine exploitation by transnational corporations is a byproduct of the fixation on the unequal distribution of wealth between nations in international law scholarship, including Third World Approaches to International Law (TWAIL). However, the failure to recognize private law’s postcolonial potential stems from a foundational error in private law theory as well: the relegation of concerns like systemic inequality (and postcoloniality) to the public sphere as distributive questions. In doing so, the dominant view of private law subjects is one that is artificially insulated from the power imbalances of the global economy and hence completely fictional. In this Article, I offer a more robust conception of the private law subject focusing on real people who are constituted by and situated within these neocolonial power structures. Thereby, I reconceptualize private law not as a tool that entrenches existing inequalities, but as an instrument for postcolonial transformation.

I demonstrate this postcolonial potential of private law in two critical areas in the context of transnational corporate activity. First, I explore the adjudicatory function of private law, arguing that private rights of action, such as tort claims under the Alien Tort Statute, provide a crucial forum for victims of corporate human rights abuses. These rights treat them as rightsholders against the corporations, enabling them to confront corporate executives by being able to tell their story in court. This is a unique avenue that public law or political struggles cannot subsume with their focus on state responsibility. Second, I delve into private law’s ethos of protecting substantive equality. I argue that by centering the marginalized individuals in business decisions—treating the sweatshop worker, for example, not as a remote externality but as a central stakeholder—private law can actively dismantle the exploitative structures of the global economy through emerging laws like those mandating human rights due diligence.

By shifting the focus away from the abstract distribution of wealth to concrete questions of interpersonal respect, I restore the individual to their rightful place at the center of postcolonial futures. It is a future where the law finally serves, in the famous words of Salvador Allende, “the miner in Cardiff[,] the fellah in Egypt [and] the cocoa farmer in . . . Ivory Coast.” (UN Doc A/PV.2096).

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出从国际法向私法的范式转移，主张通过合同法、物权法和侵权法等私法平台来实现后海海正义，而非仅依靠国际法的财富分配框架。
AI.research_question: 如何重新概念化私法在后海海正义中的潜力，将具体个体从宏观经济抽象转化为权利持有者？
AI.motivation: 国际法学术界长期以来将后海海正义限定在财富分配问题上，忽视了跨国公司对农民、矿工、工厂工人等个体的日常不公正待遇。这种接触性不公正更需要通过私法来解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后海海法学理论、私法理论、第三世界国际法方法论(TWAIL)、人际正义理论
AI.method: 理论分析和法律案例分析（如Nestlé v. Doe案例），重点考察私法的两大功能：司法审判功能和实质性平等价值观
AI.findings: 私法通过侵权诸如外国人侵权诸诉法(Alien Tort Statute)等提供了直接的法律教汉途径，使受害者能够作为权利持有者直接对抗公司；同时通过人权尽谨审查等新兴法律可以重构公司决策中的利益关注点
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从国际法向私法的范式转移，承认私法在后海海正义中的作用；重新定义私法主体为处于新海海权力结构中的现实个体；批判了将系统性不平等问题完全归类为公法分配问题的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为受跨国公司侵害的个体提供了具体的法律教汉手段；推动企业在做决策时考虑边缘化群体的利益；为人权尽谨审查等法律制度提供了理论支撑

title: Native-Borns and Migrants do not Contribute Equally to Domestic CO2 Emissions
affiliations: University of Perugia - Department of Economics, Finance and Statistics and University of Milan - Department of Environmental Science and Policy (ESP)

detail.title: Native-Borns and Migrants do not Contribute Equally to Domestic CO2 Emissions

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
While population growth is a known driver of CO2 emissions, prevailing models often treat “population” as a homogeneous factor. This study addresses a critical gap, providing the first comprehensive empirical analysis to disaggregate the contributions of native-born and migrant populations to domestic CO2 emissions. Using an extended STIRPAT model for 172 countries (1990-2022), separated by OECD and non-OECD blocs, we uncover two novel insights.
First, native-born populations consistently exhibit a substantially higher emissions elasticity than migrants in both country groups. Second, a dynamic shift occurred in OECD countries: migrants’ initially higher per capita emissions impact steadily declined over time, becoming lower than native-born individuals after 2003-2004. This refutes simplistic notions that migration inherently increases emissions. Our findings underscore the urgent need for differentiated, equitable climate policies that acknowledge the heterogeneous and evolving consumption patterns of diverse demographic groups, enabling more efficient mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将人口细分为本地出生和移民群体，分析其对CO2排放的不同影响。发现本地出生人口的排放弹性显著高于移民，且在OECD国家中移民的人均排放影响随时间下降，反驳了移民必然增加排放的简单观点。
AI.research_question: 本地出生人口和移民人口对国内CO2排放的贡献有何差异？这种差异在OECD和非OECD国家中如何表现？
AI.motivation: 现有模型通常将人口视为同质因素，忽视了不同人口群体对碳排放的差异化影响，需要更细致的分析来制定公平有效的气候政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的STIRPAT模型（Stochastic Impacts by Regression on Population, Affluence, and Technology），将人口因素细分为本地出生和移民群体。
AI.method: 使用扩展STIRPAT模型对172个国家（1990-2022年）的数据进行分析，按OECD和非OECD国家分组研究。
AI.findings: 1. 本地出生人口的排放弹性显著高于移民；2. OECD国家中移民的人均排放影响随时间下降，2003-2004年后低于本地出生人口。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供移民与本地出生人口对碳排放差异化影响的全面实证分析，挑战了人口同质化假设，为环境人口学提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要制定差异化的公平气候政策，考虑不同人口群体的异质性和演变的消费模式，以实现更有效的减排策略。

title: Equality Before the Law in U.S. Civil War Courts-Martial
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics and Princeton University

detail.title: Equality Before the Law in U.S. Civil War Courts-Martial

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We examine disparities in acquittal rates and sentencing for Black and White soldiers in the US Civil War using all general courts-martial. We find that Blacks were disproportionately punished for group actions like mutiny and for violent crimes involving group violence, suggesting fears of large-scale rebellion influenced justice. However, we also uncover a system that was fair relative to many modern criminal courts in acquittals and in death sentences. The needs of the Army pushed towards fairness.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究美国内战期间黑人和白人士兵在军事法庭的定罪率和量刑差异，发现黑人因群体行动和暴力犯罪受到更严厉惩罚，但整体司法系统相对现代法庭更公平
AI.research_question: 美国内战期间黑人和白人士兵在军事法庭的定罪率和量刑是否存在种族差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨内战期间军事司法系统中的种族不平等问题，以及军队需求如何影响司法公正
AI.theoretical_framework: 种族司法不平等理论、军事司法制度研究、群体行为惩罚理论
AI.method: 使用所有普通军事法庭案件数据进行定量分析
AI.findings: 黑人因群体行动（如兵变）和涉及群体暴力的暴力犯罪受到不成比例的惩罚，但整体系统在无罪释放和死刑判决方面相对现代刑事法庭更公平
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了军队需求对司法公正的积极影响，挑战了传统认为军事司法必然更严厉的观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史司法系统中的种族不平等提供了实证证据，对现代司法改革具有参考价值

title: Endogenous Firm Ownership in General Equilibrium
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Endogenous Firm Ownership in General Equilibrium

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper examines firm ownership structures in competitive general equilibrium by introducing a model where ownership rights emerge endogenously rather than being assumed. By embedding the property rights theory of the firm into general equilibrium analysis, the model demonstrates how market forces determine both initial firm formation by entrepreneurs and subsequent trading of ownership rights. The key finding is that, in equilibrium, firms are created by managers who have long-term importance to performance, but these founder-managers then sell ownership to outside investors. This pattern emerges because managers can capture value through both the sale price and their ongoing employment relationship, while outside owners can only benefit through ownership. The model thus provides a novel theoretical foundation for observed patterns of entrepreneurial exit and reconciles competing approaches to firm ownership in general equilibrium theory. Additionally, it identifies a distinct economic definition of an entrepreneur as an agent whose human capital is valuable for firms even when they do not remain long-term owners. The framework generates insights into firm formation, ownership dynamics, and the nature of entrepreneurship while maintaining the core structure of competitive general equilibrium analysis.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个内生所有权结构的竞争性一般均衡模型，发现企业由对绩效有长期重要性的管理者创建，但创始人随后会将所有权出售给外部投资者，因为管理者可以通过出售价格和持续雇佣关系双重获益，而外部所有者只能通过所有权获益。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性一般均衡框架下，企业所有权结构如何内生形成？企业家为何在创建企业后选择退出所有权？
AI.motivation: 现有理论通常假设企业所有权结构外生给定，缺乏对所有权如何通过市场力量内生形成的解释，需要将企业产权理论融入一般均衡分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业产权理论和竞争性一般均衡理论，构建内生所有权模型，分析企业家和外部投资者的激励相容条件。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过构建包含企业家才能和所有权交易的一般均衡模型，推导均衡条件下的所有权结构模式。
AI.findings: 均衡状态下，企业由具有长期重要性的管理者创建，但创始人会出售所有权给外部投资者；管理者可通过出售价格和雇佣关系双重获益，而外部所有者只能通过所有权获益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为观察到的企业家退出模式提供了新的理论基础；调和了一般均衡理论中关于企业所有权的竞争性方法；提出了企业家作为人力资本重要但不必是长期所有者的经济学定义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业形成、所有权动态和创业本质提供了新的分析框架；对创业者和投资者的决策具有指导意义；维持了竞争性一般均衡分析的核心结构。

title: Colonial Legacies and the Historical Foundations of Global Economic Leadership among Leading Economies
affiliations: Binjiang College Of Nanjing University Of Information Science & Technology, Xi'an Jiaotong University and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: Colonial Legacies and the Historical Foundations of Global Economic Leadership among Leading Economies
detail.abstract: The enduring dominance of today's leading global economies cannot be fully understood without reference to the historical trajectories shaped by colonial expansion. This article examines the legacies of colonialism as foundational determinants of contemporary global economic leadership. By situating the rise of advanced economies within the broader context of imperial expansion, resource extraction, and systemic asymmetries in global trade, the study underscores how colonial structures created lasting advantages for colonizing states while entrenching developmental constraints in colonized regions. The analysis focuses on three interrelated dimensions. First, the transfer of wealth and resources from colonies to imperial centers accelerated capital accumulation, industrialization, and technological advancement in Europe and North America. Second, colonial systems institutionalized patterns of global trade and finance that disproportionately benefited metropolitan powers, establishing enduring hierarchies in production, commerce, and credit. Third, the cultural and political legacies of empire-including governance structures, legal systems, and international norms-continue to reinforce the strategic dominance of former colonial powers within global institutions. While globalization, innovation, and domestic policy choices have contributed significantly to the consolidation of economic leadership, these factors cannot be disentangled from the historical advantages rooted in colonial exploitation. The article argues that contemporary global inequalities are not incidental but structurally embedded in historical processes that privileged certain nations at the expense of others. Recognizing colonial legacies is therefore essential for understanding current global economic hierarchies and for informing debates on equity, reparations, and inclusive development in the twenty-first century.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨殖民主义作为当代全球经济领导地位的基础性决定因素，分析殖民结构如何为殖民国家创造持久优势并在被殖民地区固化发展约束。
AI.research_question: 殖民主义遗产如何塑造当代全球经济领导地位和全球不平等？
AI.motivation: 理解当今主要全球经济体的持久主导地位需要参考殖民扩张塑造的历史轨迹，揭示全球不平等并非偶然而是历史进程的结构性嵌入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民主义理论、世界体系理论、依附理论，强调殖民结构对全球经济和权力关系的持久影响。
AI.method: 历史分析框架，聚焦三个相互关联的维度：财富资源转移、全球贸易金融制度化、文化政治遗产。
AI.findings: 殖民体系通过财富转移加速欧美资本积累和工业化，制度化有利于宗主国的全球贸易金融模式，并通过治理结构和国际规范持续强化前殖民大国的战略主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解当代全球经济等级制度提供了历史结构视角，强调了殖民遗产在塑造全球不平等中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关于公平、赔偿和包容性发展的辩论提供信息，有助于制定更公平的全球发展政策。

title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on Consumer Expectations and Spending
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research,  and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on Consumer Expectations and Spending

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Using novel scenario-based survey questions that randomize the expected duration of the Russian invasion of Ukraine and Middle East conflict, we examine the causal impact of geopolitical risk on consumers’ beliefs about aggregate economic conditions and their own financial outlook. Expecting a longer conflict leads European households to anticipate a worsening of the aggregate economy, with higher inflation, lower economic growth, and lower stock prices. They also perceive negative fiscal implications, anticipating higher government debt and higher taxes. Ultimately, households view the geopolitical conflict as making them worse off financially and it leads them to reduce their consumption.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过随机化俄乌战争和中东冲突预期持续时间的场景调查，研究发现地缘政治风险导致欧洲家庭预期经济恶化、通胀上升、增长放缓，并减少消费。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何影响消费者对宏观经济状况和个人财务前景的信念？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治冲突对消费者预期和经济行为的因果影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预期理论和行为经济学，探讨地缘政治风险通过影响消费者预期进而影响经济决策的机制。
AI.method: 采用新颖的场景化调查方法，随机化冲突预期持续时间，对欧洲家庭进行问卷调查，分析因果效应。
AI.findings: 预期冲突持续时间越长，家庭越预期经济恶化（高通胀、低增长、股市下跌）、财政状况恶化（高政府债务和高税收），并减少消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 为地缘政治风险通过消费者预期渠道影响经济的理论提供了实证证据，丰富了风险传导机制的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者应对地缘政治风险的经济影响提供了洞察，有助于设计更有效的经济稳定政策。

title: Good Rents versus Bad Rents: R&D Misallocation and Growth
affiliations: London School of Economics, Banque de France, Stockholm University - Institute for International Economic Studies (IIES), Stanford University and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: Good Rents versus Bad Rents: R&D Misallocation and Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Firm price-cost markups may reflect (a) bigger step sizes from quality innovations that confer significant knowledge spillovers onto other firms, and/or (b) higher process efficiency than competing firms or other factors which bear no obvious knowledge externality. We write down an endogenous growth model with innovation step size and process efficiency as alternative sources of markup heterogeneity. Compared with the laissez-faire equilibrium, the social planner wants to reallocate research towards high step size firms but not high process efficiency firms. We then use price and productivity data across firms in French manufacturing to infer firm step sizes and process efficiency. We find that the planner could achieve faster growth by reallocating research toward high step size firms, and more so if high step size firms could freely license their innovations to high process efficiency firms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过内生增长模型分析企业价格成本加成差异的来源，发现质量创新的知识溢出效应比过程效率更能促进经济增长，建议将研发资源重新配置给高步长创新企业。
AI.research_question: 企业价格成本加成的差异是源于质量创新的知识溢出效应还是过程效率？如何优化研发资源配置以促进经济增长？
AI.motivation: 理解企业间价格成本加成差异的经济学含义，以及如何通过研发资源配置政策来最大化社会福利和经济增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论，包含创新步长和过程效率作为企业异质性的来源，构建社会规划者与自由市场均衡的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与法国制造业企业的价格和生产率数据分析，通过推断企业的创新步长和过程效率参数进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 社会规划者应将研发资源重新配置给高步长创新企业，这种重新配置能带来更快的经济增长，特别是如果高步长企业能自由许可其创新给高效率企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分质量创新知识溢出和过程效率对企业加成差异影响的理论框架，为研发资源配置政策提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化研发资源配置的具体方向，建议支持具有高知识溢出潜力的创新活动，促进技术扩散和经济增长。

title: What Hinders Electric Vehicle Diffusion? Insights from a Neural Network Approach
affiliations: Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM) and Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM)

detail.title: What Hinders Electric Vehicle Diffusion? Insights from a Neural Network Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The transition to a zero-emission vehicle fleet represents a pivotal element of Europe's decarbonization strategy, with Italy's participation being particularly significant given the size of its automotive market. This study investigates the potential for battery electric cars (BEVs) to drive decarbonization of Italy's passenger vehicle fleet, focusing on the feasibility of targets set in the National Integrated Plan for Energy and Climate (PNIEC). Leveraging artificial neural networks, we integrate macroeconomic indicators, market-specific variables, and policy instruments to predict fleet dynamics and identify key factors influencing BEV adoption. We forecast that while BEV registrations will continue growing through 2030, the growth rate is projected to decelerate, presenting challenges for meeting ambitious policy targets. Our feature importance analysis demonstrates that BEV adoption is driven by an interconnected set of economic, infrastructural, and behavioral factors. Specifically, our model highlights that hybrid vehicle registrations and the vehicle purchase index exert the strongest influence on BEV registrations, suggesting that policy interventions should prioritize these areas to maximize impact. By offering data-driven insights and methodological innovations, our findings contribute to more effective policy design for accelerating sustainable mobility adoption while accounting for market realities and consumer behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用人工神经网络分析意大利电动汽车接入潜力，发现BEV注册增长将减速，混合动力车注册和车辆购买指数是关键因素，建议政策应优先考虑这些领域以实现脱碳目标。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车在意大利乘用车队脱碳过程中的潜力如何？是否可能实现PNIEC计划设定的目标？
AI.motivation: 意大利作为欧洲重要汽车市场，其零排放汽车队转型对欧洲脱碳战略具有重要意义，需要评估电动汽车接入的可行性和挖掘关锩驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工神经网络的预测模型，结合宏观经济指标、市场特定变量和政策工具的多元分析框架。
AI.method: 利用人工神经网络技术，整合宏观经济指标、市场变量和政策工具，预测车队动态并识别关键影响因素。
AI.findings: 预测显示BEV注册在2030年前将继续增长，但增长速度预计会减缓，对实现朗心政策目标构成挑战；混合动力车注册和车辆购买指数是影响BEV接入的最强因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数据驱动的深度见解和方法论创新，为加速可持续移动性接纳的政策设计做出理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体建议：政策应优先考虑混合动力车和车辆购买相关因素，以最大化政策效果，同时考虑市场现实和消费者行为。

title: Understanding Crude Oil Risk in China: The Role of a Model-Free Volatility Index
affiliations: Chongqing Jiaotong University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University - Antai College of Economics & Management

detail.title: Understanding Crude Oil Risk in China: The Role of a Model-Free Volatility Index
detail.abstract: We construct the China Crude Oil Volatility Index (CNOVX)—the first model-free, optionimplied measure of forward-looking oil price risk for China—using INE crude oil options from 2021 to 2024 and an adapted CBOE methodology that accounts for sparse strike availability via smooth interpolation and extrapolation. Our results show that CNOVX increases with trading activity in the futures market, declines with option volume, and is strongly predicted by the 30-day realized variance of the SC crude oil futures contract. External shocks, including the Russia–Ukraine conflict and the Geopolitical Risk Index, significantly elevate CNOVX levels. During the COVID-19 pandemic, mortality risk intensifies the volatility-amplifying role of futures trading and strengthens the volatility-dampening effect of options, while confirmed case counts have weaker influence. We further document a pronounced asymmetric leverage effect: negative futures returns raise CNOVX more than positive returns of equal size. However, volatility feedback effects are negligible, as changes in implied volatility respond primarily to contemporaneous market conditions. Overall, CNOVX serves as a timely and informative benchmark for monitoring risk in China’s evolving crude oil derivatives market, with valuable implications for investors, hedgers, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了中国首个无模型、期权隐含的原油波动率指数(CNOVX)，分析了其与市场交易活动、外部冲击的关系，发现了显著的非对称杠杆效应，为监测中国原油衍生品市场风险提供了重要基准。
AI.research_question: 如何构建中国原油波动率指数(CNOVX)？该指数与市场交易活动、外部冲击之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 中国原油衍生品市场快速发展，但缺乏有效的风险监测工具。构建CNOVX可以为投资者、套期保值者和政策制定者提供及时的风险信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CBOE波动率指数方法论，结合平滑插值和外推技术处理稀疏执行价问题，构建无模型隐含波动率指数。
AI.method: 使用2021-2024年INE原油期权数据，采用改进的CBOE方法构建CNOVX，并分析其与期货交易量、期权交易量、已实现方差、地缘政治风险等因素的关系。
AI.findings: CNOVX随期货交易活动增加而上升，随期权交易量下降；外部冲击显著提升CNOVX水平；疫情期间死亡率风险放大期货交易的波动性增强作用；存在显著的非对称杠杆效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了波动率指数构建理论，为新兴市场稀疏期权数据环境下的风险度量提供了方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国市场提供了首个原油波动率基准指数，有助于投资者风险管理、套期保值策略制定和政策监管。

title: Fundamentals of Research Writing and uses of Research Methodologies
