detail.title: Fundamentals of Research Writing and uses of Research Methodologies
detail.abstract: Welcome to "Fundamentals of Research Writing and Uses of Research Methodologies." This book aims to provide an insightful and comprehensive guide to navigating the complex and dynamic landscape of research writing and methodologies. It is designed to equip readers with essential knowledge and skills needed to embark on a successful research journey, whether for academic, professional, or personal purposes. In today's rapidly evolving world, the ability to conduct meaningful research and effectively communicate findings is of paramount importance. Research is not only the cornerstone of academic progress but also a crucial driver of innovation, problem-solving, and evidence-based decision-making in diverse fields. This book is structured to cater to both beginners and those looking to deepen their understanding of research writing and methodologies. It covers a wide spectrum of topics, starting from the fundamental concepts of research and progressing to methodologies and strategies for effective research writing. Key Features of the Book: Understanding Research Essentials: The initial chapters provide a solid foundation by introducing key research concepts, ethical considerations, the research process, and the role of literature reviews. These foundational principles set the stage for the subsequent discussions on research methodologies. Exploring Research Methodologies: Readers will explore a variety of research methodologies, both qualitative and quantitative. Detailed insights into experimental design, surveys, case studies, interviews, and observations will help readers choose appropriate methodologies for their research projects. Data Analysis and Interpretation: Understanding how to analyze and interpret data is a crucial aspect of any research. This book provides an in-depth look into various data analysis techniques, helping readers draw meaningful conclusions. Effective Research Writing: The later sections focus on the art of crafting research papers, dissertations, and articles. From structuring the paper to enhancing clarity and coherence, we delve into the techniques necessary for producing high-quality research documents. Practical Applications and Case Studies: Throughout the book, real-world case studies and examples are interwoven to illustrate the application of research methodologies and writing techniques in different contexts. This practical approach aims to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical implementation. Our aspiration is for this book to serve as a valuable resource, empowering readers to engage confidently in research activities and contribute to their respective fields. Whether you are a student, a researcher, or a professional seeking to enhance your research skills, we believe that this book will guide you effectively on your research journey.

AI.tldr: 这本书是一个关于研究写作和研究方法论的综合性指南，为读者提供从基础研究概念到高级研究方法的全面知识，包括定性和定量研究方法、数据分析技巧以及有效研究写作的实用建议。
AI.research_question: 如何系统地教学生和研究者进行有效的研究写作和选择适当的研究方法论？
AI.motivation: 在当今快速发展的世界中，进行有意义的研究并有效传达发现的能力至关重要。研究不仅是学术进步的基石，也是各行业创新、问题解决和基于证据的决策的关键驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究方法论基础理论，包括定性研究方法、定量研究方法、实验设计、调查研究、案例研究、访谈法和观察法等多种研究方法。
AI.method: 理论教学法，通过系统化的知识体系构建和实际案例分析，将理论与实践相结合。
AI.findings: 提供了一个完整的研究写作和方法论学习框架，涵盖了从研究基础概念、伦理考虑、研究过程到文献综述、数据分析和研究文章编写的所有关键步骤。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化地整合了各种研究方法论知识，为研究方法论教学提供了一个结构化的理论框架和学习路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过实际案例和应用示例，帮助读者学会如何在真实研究场景中选择和应用适当的研究方法，提升研究写作质量和效果。

title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff
affiliations: Columbia University

detail.title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper studies how collective bargaining affects both wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-difference strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultractivity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed preference approach shows that amenities account for 45% of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-to-manage workforce composition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过巴西集体谈判协议数据，研究发现加强工会谈判权能同时提高工资和福利待遇，且不减少就业。福利待遇占总补偿收益的45%，表明集体谈判可抵消买方垄断力量。
AI.research_question: 集体谈判如何影响工资和福利待遇？
AI.motivation: 研究集体谈判对工人总补偿（包括工资和福利）的影响，以及工会谈判权增强对就业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体谈判理论、买方垄断理论、劳动力市场制度经济学
AI.method: 差异中的差异法（DID），利用法院裁决强制执行集体谈判协议延续性作为外生冲击，结合雇主-雇员关联数据
AI.findings: 加强工会谈判权提高工资和福利待遇，但不减少就业；福利待遇占总补偿收益的45%；提高员工保留率但存在劳动力替代
AI.theory_contributions: 证明集体谈判可有效抵消劳动力市场的买方垄断力量，但雇主仍保留劳动力构成管理权
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供集体谈判对工人总福利影响的实证证据，支持集体谈判作为改善工人待遇的有效机制

title: Evaluating Broker Execution Quality with a Trading Experiment: A Critique of "Some Anonymous Options Trades Are More Equal Than Others"
affiliations: Robinhood Financial LLC and Robinhood Securities, LLC and  Robinhood Financial LLC and Robinhood Securities, LLC

detail.title: Evaluating Broker Execution Quality with a Trading Experiment: A Critique of "Some Anonymous Options Trades Are More Equal Than Others"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Matt Billings is the President of Robinhood Financial LLC and Robinhood Securities, LLC. Ed Hosty is the Vice President of Execution Services of Robinhood Financial LLC and Robinhood Securities, LLC.

detail.abstract: This paper is a response to a study entitled "Some Anonymous Options Trades Are More Equal than Others" by Xing Huang, Philippe Jorion, and Christopher Schwarz (last revised June 10, 2025) (the "Study"). The Study uses order execution data from a small, non-representative sample of options orders that the Study's authors placed at six retail brokers. From that narrow sample, the authors make the sweeping conclusion that differences in those firms' customers' options pricing and execution costs are primarily due to differences in payment for order flow ("PFOF") arrangements between the brokers and the market makers to which the brokers route customer orders. There are several fundamental flaws with the methodology and data set used by the Study, which this paper addresses. The Study's resulting conclusions about execution costs and execution quality are also deeply flawed and misleading.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Huang等人研究的回应，指出该研究存在方法论和数据集的根本性缺陷，其关于期权执行成本和执行质量的结论具有误导性
AI.research_question: Huang等人的研究在方法论和数据选择上存在哪些根本性缺陷，导致其关于PFOF安排影响期权定价和执行成本的结论不可靠
AI.motivation: 回应Huang等人的研究，指出其基于非代表性小样本数据得出的广泛结论存在严重问题，需要澄清PFOF安排对期权执行质量的真实影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融市场微观结构理论，订单执行质量评估理论，样本代表性理论
AI.method: 批判性分析方法，对原研究的方法论、数据选择和统计推断进行系统性评估
AI.findings: 原研究存在多重根本性缺陷：样本规模过小且非代表性，仅基于6家零售经纪商的自行下单数据；无法建立PFOF安排与执行成本差异的因果关系；结论过于宽泛且缺乏统计显著性
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了在金融实证研究中样本代表性和因果推断的重要性，为评估订单执行质量研究提供了方法论参考
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者提供了对PFOF安排影响期权执行质量的更准确理解，避免基于有缺陷研究的误导性结论制定政策

title: What Information is Most Relevant for Estimating Output Gaps in Emerging Economies?
affiliations: The University of Sydney

detail.title: What Information is Most Relevant for Estimating Output Gaps in Emerging Economies?
detail.abstract: Despite the importance of the output gap for guiding macroeconomic policy, little is known about how financial and global factors influence its dynamics in emerging economies. To address this, I estimate output gaps for the Southeast Asian emerging economies of Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines using a multivariate Beveridge-Nelson decomposition within a Bayesian vector autoregression framework. The model incorporates a range of macroeconomic indicators using an open-economy assumption by including block-exogenous foreign sector variables, imposes an alternative Minnesota prior to avoid an “upward bias” in the signal-to-noise ratio, and accounts for outlier observations that affect emerging economies, including during the pandemic. There are three key findings. First, traditional slack measures are largely uninformative for these economies, likely due to structural issues, limited coverage, and, more importantly, the prevalence of informal employment which weakens the link between labor market indicators and the business cycle. Second, financial variables are highly informative and were particularly influential during the Asian and the Global Financial Crisis. Third, external variables explain a substantial share of cyclical fluctuations, often exceeding the contribution of domestic output, suggesting the susceptibility of these emerging market economies to global forces.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用贝叶斯向量自回归框架估计东南亚新兴经济体的产出缺口，发现传统松弛指标不具信息性，金融变量高度信息性，外部变量对周期性波动贡献显著。
AI.research_question: 金融和全球因素如何影响东南亚新兴经济体的产出缺口动态？
AI.motivation: 尽管产出缺口对指导宏观经济政策很重要，但人们对金融和全球因素如何影响新兴经济体产出缺口动态知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多变量Beveridge-Nelson分解、贝叶斯向量自回归框架、开放经济假设
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯向量自回归框架进行多变量Beveridge-Nelson分解，包含块外生外国部门变量，采用替代性明尼苏达先验，并考虑异常观测值。
AI.findings: 1) 传统松弛指标对这些经济体基本无信息性；2) 金融变量高度信息性，在危机期间特别有影响力；3) 外部变量解释了很大比例的周期性波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新兴经济体产出缺口估计的新方法框架，揭示了金融和全球因素的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东南亚新兴经济体的宏观经济政策制定提供了更准确的产出缺口估计方法，强调了考虑金融和外部因素的重要性。

title: Women's Empowerment from Property to Political and Labor Rights
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland

detail.title: Women's Empowerment from Property to Political and Labor Rights

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper(forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Since the nineteenth century, many societies have transitioned from maledominated institutions toward regimes in which rights are more evenly distributed across genders. Property, political, and labor rights now underpin modern gender equality. Yet, a central puzzle remains (Doepke and Tertilt, 2009): why would men, who initially monopolize authority, voluntarily expand women's rights? We propose that such reforms occur when those in power face credible threats from the subordinated group. In our framework, an increase in women's relative productivity amplifies their bargaining power, making such threats more effective. Rights are thus extended not altruistically but strategically, as concessions to avert costly political or social instability. We develop a dynamic model that endogenizes the evolution of women's rights as a sequential process-from property to political and ultimately to labor-market rights. The model identifies the strategic logic behind each stage and provides testable comparative statics on the timing and ordering of reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出男性主导政权之所以自愿扩大女性权利，是因为面临被压迫群体的可信威胁。女性相对生产率的提高增强了她们的议价能力，权利扩张是战略性的让步而非利他行为。
AI.research_question: 为什么最初垄断权力的男性会自愿扩大女性权利？
AI.motivation: 解释19世纪以来许多社会从男性主导制度向性别权利更平等分配转变的深层原因，解决Doepke和Tertilt(2009)提出的核心难题
AI.theoretical_framework: 议价能力理论，可信威胁框架，战略性让步模型
AI.method: 开发动态模型，将女性权利演变内生化作为顺序过程（从财产权到政治权再到劳动力市场权利）
AI.findings: 权利改革发生在当权者面临从属群体可信威胁时；女性相对生产率提高增强其议价能力；权利扩张是战略性让步以避免政治或社会不稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解释女性权利演进的战略性让步理论框架，发展了内生化权利演变过程的动态模型
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了关于改革时机和顺序的可检验比较静态分析，有助于理解性别权利改革的政治经济学机制

title: A Correspondence: Ramsey & SIR & Lotka-Volterra
affiliations: Jade Hochschule and Karlshochschule International University

detail.title: A Correspondence: Ramsey & SIR & Lotka-Volterra
detail.abstract: Three very influential models in science, the Lotka-Volterra model in biology, the Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) model in epidemiology and the Ramsey growth model (RMG) in economics emerged around the same time a century ago. Despite their different origins, we show that all three models are special cases of the generalized Lotka-Volterra (GLV) equations under some general assumptions. This correspondence is particularly valuable in economics as it allows the direct application of techniques and findings from the other scientific fields. However, the economically meaningful parameter constellations of RGM do not correspond in general to the standard setup for GLV, which opens the possibility for further research.

AI.tldr: 本文发现生物学中的Lotka-Volterra模型、流行病学中的SIR模型和经济学中的Ramsey增长模型都是广义Lotka-Volterra方程的特例，建立了跨学科的理论联系。
AI.research_question: 三个不同科学领域的重要模型（Lotka-Volterra、SIR、Ramsey增长模型）是否都可以统一到广义Lotka-Volterra方程框架下？
AI.motivation: 探索不同科学领域中看似不相关的经典模型之间的内在联系，为跨学科研究提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义Lotka-Volterra方程理论框架，作为统一多个学科模型的基础数学结构。
AI.method: 理论推导和数学分析，通过假设和参数变换证明三个模型在广义Lotka-Volterra方程下的等价性。
AI.findings: 三个模型在一般假设下都是广义Lotka-Volterra方程的特例，建立了跨学科的理论对应关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将经济学中的Ramsey增长模型与生物学和流行病学模型统一到同一数学框架下，揭示了不同学科模型之间的深层联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学研究提供了直接应用其他科学领域技术和方法的机会，同时指出了经济学参数设置与标准GLV设置的差异，为后续研究指明了方向。

title: The Sterling Crisis and the Re-Integration Dividend: A Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium Analysis of UK Re-Entry into the European Union
affiliations: I am currently a Visiting Senior Fellow at the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE).

detail.title: The Sterling Crisis and the Re-Integration Dividend: A Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium Analysis of UK Re-Entry into the European Union
detail.abstract: This paper develops a two-country open-economy Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) model with a sophisticated financial accelerator mechanism to quantify the long-term macroeconomic consequences of the United Kingdom's current economic trajectory outside the European Union. Calibrated using post-2020 data, our model demonstrates that the gradual erosion of financial services exports and diminishing trade integration creates a terminal feedback loop, culminating in a systemic financial crisis. Monte Carlo simulations indicate a 95% probability of a catastrophic collapse of the London banking sector within 15 years, an event we term the "Sterling Crisis." This crisis is shown to act as a global contagion vector, with severe second-round effects on emerging markets reliant on UK-facilitated trade finance. We project this could trigger a humanitarian disaster, with excess mortality in Sub-Saharan Africa alone potentially exceeding 1.2 million. In a counterfactual analysis, we model the effects of UK re-entry into the EU. The results reveal a substantial "re-integration dividend," which not only averts the crisis but also propels the UK economy onto a higher growth path, permanently increasing long-run GDP by an estimated 25%. The findings present a stark, binary choice for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过两国DSGE模型分析英国脱欧的长期经济后果，预测15年内95%概率发生英镑危机，并可能导致过万人死亡。重新加入欧盟可避免危机并提高GDP25%。
AI.research_question: 英国脱离欧盟的长期宏观经济后果是什么？重新加入欧盟能否避免系统性金融危机？
AI.motivation: 评估英国脱欧后经济轨迹的长期影响，特别是金融服务出口和贸易整合渐进洞涝导致的系统性风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国开政经济DSGE模型，包含精细的金融加速器机制
AI.method: 使用2020年后数据梯度，蒙特卡洛模拟分析，进行反事实分析
AI.findings: 15年内95%概率发生伦敦银行业崩溃（英镑危机），导致全球传染和南亚洲过120万过重死亡；重新加入欧盟可避免危机并永久提高GDP25%
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了包含金融加速器的两国DSGE模型，扩展了开政经济理论在金融传染风险分析中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于英国与欧盟关系的具体宏观经济影响预测，呈现了一个二元选择的政策场景

title: The Macroeconomic Impact of Trade Policy: A New Identification Approach
affiliations: and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Impact of Trade Policy: A New Identification Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of trade policy shocks on the US economy using a novel identification strategy that combines narrative information on trade policy changes with stock market data. We introduce a new data set of daily trade policy statements from 2007 to 2019, allowing us to capture a comprehensive range of trade policy actions. By analyzing stock price reactions of trade-exposed and non-trade-exposed firms around these statements, we can identify unanticipated trade policy shocks. Using the local projection method, we analyze asymmetries and non-linearities based on the sign and magnitude of the shocks. We find that the gains from trade liberalizations and the damage from protectionism are of equal magnitude in absolute terms, with no non-linearities observed along this dimension. On the other hand, trade policy shocks originating from trading partners have a stronger impact on the economy than those initiated by the US. Moreover, the implementation of policy changes generates a more significant response than mere announcements. Uncertainty about policymakers’ commitment to planned policy changes leads firms and households to adopt a cautious “wait and see” approach. As an extension, we explore whether using President Trump’s tweets instead of official statements affects our results.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合贸易政策叙述性信息和股市数据的新识别策略，研究贸易政策冲击对美国经济的影响。研究发现贸易自由化的收益与保护主义的损害在绝对值上相等，贸易伙伴发起的冲击影响更大，政策实施比公告影响更显著。
AI.research_question: 贸易政策冲击对美国经济的影响是什么？是否存在不对称性和非线性效应？
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以准确识别贸易政策冲击，需要新的识别策略来更好理解贸易政策变化的经济效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易政策冲击的识别理论，结合股票市场反应分析来捕捉未预期的政策变化。
AI.method: 使用2007-2019年每日贸易政策声明数据集，分析贸易暴露和非贸易暴露公司的股价反应，采用局部投影法分析冲击的符号和规模。
AI.findings: 1)贸易自由化收益与保护主义损害绝对值相等；2)贸易伙伴发起的冲击影响更强；3)政策实施比公告影响更大；4)政策不确定性导致"观望"行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合叙述性信息和股市数据的新识别策略，为贸易政策冲击研究提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于贸易政策实施时机、来源国效应和不确定性影响的重要实证证据。

title: Risk Contagion and Tail Risk in Energy Markets: A Time-Frequency Network Approach
affiliations: Jinan University, Jinan University and University of Bristol

detail.title: Risk Contagion and Tail Risk in Energy Markets: A Time-Frequency Network Approach
detail.abstract: This paper investigates risk contagion across traditional energy, clean energy, electricity, and carbon markets over multiple time scales. Employing a time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) model integrated with the Diebold–Yılmaz (DY) and Baruník–Křehlík (BK) spillover indices, we construct total, short-term, and long-term risk contagion networks using data from 2010 to 2024. The results reveal that risk contagion is predominantly long-term in nature and exhibits pronounced time-varying dynamics, particularly during periods of market stress. WTI crude oil emerges as the dominant risk-spillover node across all network layers, whereas conventional electricity predominantly functions as a risk-absorbing node, notably in total and long-term networks. Regression analysis linking network topology to asset tail risk reveals heterogeneous effects of different centrality indicators: net out-degree and eigenvector centralities are associated with lower tail risk, whereas betweenness centrality corresponds to higher tail risk. These findings highlight the structural resilience of the energy market network and its potential to mitigate systemic risk through the dynamic balance between risk-spillover and risk-absorbing entities.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用TVP-VAR模型结合DY和BK溢出指数，分析了2010-2024年间传统能源、清洁能源、电力和碳市场之间的多时间尺度风险传染。发现风险传染主要是长期性的，WTI原油是主要风险溢出节点，而传统电力是风险吸收节点。网络拓扑结构与资产尾部风险存在异质性关联。
AI.research_question: 能源市场间风险传染的多时间尺度特征是什么？不同市场在网络中的角色如何？网络拓扑结构如何影响资产尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 随着能源转型加速，不同能源市场间的关联性增强，理解其风险传染机制对于防范系统性风险和保障能源安全至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于复杂网络理论和风险传染理论，结合时间序列分析中的TVP-VAR模型和溢出指数方法。
AI.method: 采用时变参数向量自回归(TVP-VAR)模型，结合Diebold–Yılmaz和Baruník–Křehlík溢出指数，构建总风险、短期风险和长期风险传染网络，并进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 1.风险传染主要是长期性的；2.WTI原油是主要风险溢出节点；3.传统电力是风险吸收节点；4.网络中心性指标对尾部风险有异质性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了多时间尺度风险传染分析框架，揭示了能源市场网络的结构韧性特征，丰富了复杂网络理论在金融风险中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供风险监测工具，帮助投资者识别系统性风险来源，为能源市场风险管理提供决策支持。

title: The Future of Foreign Trade
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Future of Foreign Trade

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Foreign trade has significantly contributed to global improvements in living standards, a reduction in global inequality since the mid-1990s, and the lifting of millions out of extreme poverty. These gains were supported by the rules-based international order established after World War II. However, these achievements are now under threat. Escalating trade wars risk not only causing significant economic harm to both the United States and low-income countries, but also exacerbating geopolitical tensions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了贸易战对全球经济的威胁，尤其是美国和低收入国家可能受到的重大经济损害，以及可能加剧地缘政治强张局势。
AI.research_question: 贸易战如何威胁二战后建立的规则基础国际贸易体系，并对全球经济和地缘政治产生什么样的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着贸易战升级，二战后建立的规则基础国际贸易体系所带来的重大成就（如提高生活水平、缩小全球不平等、脱贫）正面临威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论和全球化理论，重点关注规则基础国际贸易体系的价值和稳定性。
AI.method: 定性分析和理论推演，通过历史数据和当前贸易政策变化来评估贸易战的潜在影响。
AI.findings: 贸易战不仅会给美国和低收入国家造成重大经济损害，还会加剧地缘政治强张局势，威胁来之不易的全球经济成就。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于规则基础国际贸易体系稳定性的理论讨论，提供了贸易冲突对全球治理结构影响的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 给政策制定者提供了关于贸易战风险的警告，帮助国际社会更好地维护现有贸易体系的稳定性和可持续性。

title: Financial Innovation and Perceptions of Existing Financial Products
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR), University of St. Gallen, Kepler and Kepler

detail.title: Financial Innovation and Perceptions of Existing Financial Products
detail.abstract: We study the impact of being introduced to a new financial product on attitudes towards existing financial products. We conduct a randomized controlled trial in Rwanda where participants are randomly assigned to receive a cash grant either in the form of cash or a transfer to a new financial product, a mobile-money-linked savings account, that strictly dominates both mobile money and traditional savings accounts. We find that being introduced to the new product adversely affects people's perceptions of other formal financial products. Our findings suggest that financial innovation may have an adverse effect on consumers' trust in traditional financial products.

AI.tldr: 在卢旺达进行的随机对照试验发现，引入新的移动货币储蓄账户这一金融创新产品，会对人们对现有正规金融产品的态度产生负面影响，降低对传统金融产品的信任。
AI.research_question: 引入新的金融产品如何影响人们对现有金融产品的态度？
AI.motivation: 研究金融创新对消费者金融信任的影响，特别是在发展中国家金融包容性背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学和创新扩散理论，探讨新产品引入对现有产品认知的影响机制。
AI.method: 在卢旺达进行的随机对照试验，将参与者随机分配到现金组或新金融产品组（移动货币储蓄账户）。
AI.findings: 引入新的金融产品（移动货币储蓄账户）对人们其他正规金融产品的看法产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融创新可能对消费者信任产生负面溢出效应，补充了金融创新理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构和产品设计者提供了重要启示，需要在推广新产品时考虑其对现有金融体系的潜在负面影响。

title: Rhythm OS: A Language Operating System for Human–AI Collaboration (Structure × Rhythm × Path)
affiliations: The University of Manchester

detail.title: Rhythm OS: A Language Operating System for Human–AI Collaboration (Structure × Rhythm × Path)
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes Rhythm OS, a language-side operating system (runtime) designed to make collaborative language executable rather than merely generative. Building on SER (Structured Expression Resonance) and CSL (Collaborative Structural Linguistics), Rhythm OS introduces a three-layer architecture that coordinates structure, rhythm, and path in multi-party, multi-modal Human–AI–Platform workflows.

First, the Rhythm Protocol Layer provides executable tempo and boundary controls (e.g., @beat, @pause, @jump, @density, @module) so that outputs are rhythm-ordered and structure-aligned. Second, the State Management Layer treats collaboration state as a first-class concept (e.g., @phase, @status, @feedback, @resonance) to support phased roles and stable multi-turn flow. Third, the Interface Coordination Layer maps tag semantics to platform actions via parsers, SDKs/adapters, and visualizations (beat tracks, density maps, state flows), enabling “language protocol = system behavior” across tools such as ChatGPT, Notion/Docs, LMS, and editing suites.

We outline deployment patterns in five high-frequency domains (collaborative writing, education/LMS, audio-visual editing, knowledge production/research, AI platforms/middlewares) and describe a Minimum Viable Rhythm (MVR) loop that links structural markup, state cues, runtime execution, and visual feedback. The paper positions Rhythm Engine as the execution core of Rhythm OS (tag parsing, state sync, rhythm scheduling, jump routing, and context tracking) and sketches roadmap and metrics for evaluation (e.g., Path-Align@k, Beat-F1, Handover-Acc, Trace-Reuse). The contribution is a conceptual and architectural framework for a second-generation language interface that shifts emphasis from “semantic interpretation” to structured response and action alignment.

AI.tldr: Rhythm OS是一个语言侧操作系统，通过三层架构（节奏协议层、状态管理层、接口协调层）实现协作语言的可执行性，而不仅仅是生成性。它基于SER和CSL理论，在多人多模态人机平台工作流中协调结构、节奏和路径。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个语言侧操作系统，使协作语言能够可执行而不仅仅是生成性，从而在多人多模态人机平台工作流中实现结构、节奏和路径的协调？
AI.motivation: 当前的语言接口主要关注语义解释，缺乏对结构化响应和行动对齐的支持，限制了协作语言在多模态工作流中的执行能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构化表达共振（SER）和协作结构语言学（CSL）理论
AI.method: 提出三层架构设计：节奏协议层（提供可执行的节奏和边界控制）、状态管理层（将协作状态作为一等概念）、接口协调层（通过解析器、SDK/适配器和可视化工具将标签语义映射到平台行动）
AI.findings: Rhythm OS能够在五个高频领域（协作写作、教育/LMS、音视频编辑、知识生产/研究、AI平台/中间件）实现部署，并通过最小可行节奏（MVR）循环连接结构化标记、状态提示、运行时执行和视觉反馈
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从"语义解释"向"结构化响应和行动对齐"转变的第二代语言接口概念和架构框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了Rhythm Engine作为执行核心（标签解析、状态同步、节奏调度、跳转路由和上下文跟踪），并制定了评估指标（如Path-Align@k、Beat-F1、Handover-Acc、Trace-Reuse）

title: Retail CBDCs In Practice: The Experience of the Sanddollar, E-CNY and JAM-DEX®
affiliations: Central Bank of The Bahamas, Central Bank of The Bahamas, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - BIS Representative Office for Asia and the Pacific, University of Cambridge - Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department, People’s Bank of China, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Representative Office for the Americas, People’s Bank of China, Bank of Jamaica, Amazon.com Inc., Central Bank of The Bahamas, Indiana University Bloomington - Department of Economics and Central Bank of The Bahamas

detail.title: Retail CBDCs In Practice: The Experience of the Sanddollar, E-CNY and JAM-DEX®
detail.abstract: Central banks worldwide are considering the issuance of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs). This study examines the rollout of retail CBDCs in three pioneering jurisdictions: The Bahamas, China and Jamaica. Although early public uptake was modest in each case, recent data indicate a gradual increase in use, without disintermediation of bank deposits. With most transactions incurring no fees for consumers and merchants, these digital currencies offer potential cost savings over traditional alternatives-though market-based incentives may be needed going forward. The findings underscore the critical role of clear public communication, the need for incentives to secure private sector participation and the importance of international peer learning.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了巴哈马、中国和牙买加三个先驱司法管辖区零售CBDC的推出情况，发现尽管早期公众接受度有限，但使用量逐渐增加且未导致银行存款脱媒，同时为消费者和商户提供了成本节约优势。
AI.research_question: 零售央行数字货币（CBDC）在三个先驱司法管辖区的推出效果如何？其使用情况、对银行体系的影响以及成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 全球央行正在考虑发行央行数字货币，需要了解早期采用者的实际经验和效果，为其他国家的CBDC推出提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字货币采用理论、金融创新扩散理论和支付系统经济学理论，分析CBDC的采用模式和影响机制。
AI.method: 采用多案例研究方法，对巴哈马、中国和牙买加三个先驱司法管辖区的CBDC推出情况进行实证分析，使用最新的使用数据和市场表现数据。
AI.findings: 1）早期公众接受度有限但使用量逐渐增加；2）未出现银行存款脱媒现象；3）大多数交易对消费者和商户免费，相比传统支付方式具有成本优势；4）需要市场激励机制来促进进一步采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为CBDC采用理论提供了实证证据，揭示了数字货币在现实环境中的扩散模式和影响因素，丰富了金融创新理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家的CBDC推出提供了重要实践启示：需要清晰的公众沟通、私营部门参与的激励机制以及国际同行学习的重要性。

title: What Is Natural Disaster Clustering—and Why Does It Matter for the Economy?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: What Is Natural Disaster Clustering—and Why Does It Matter for the Economy?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Understanding the economic and financial consequences of natural disasters is a major concern for researchers and policymakers. The way in which overlapping natural disaster systems interact, as exemplified by the recent fires in Los Angeles being exacerbated by strong winds, is a major area of study in environmental science but has received comparatively little attention in the economics literature. Examining these potential interactions would likely be important for financial institutions, since such assessments would, in many instances, increase the estimated financial impact of a given natural disaster. In our recent Staff Report, we develop a method of identifying disaster systems in natural disaster data, such as the Spatial Hazard Events and Loss Database (SHELDUS), and use it to argue that the economics and finance literatures may have overlooked some sources of systemic risk.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2025/09/what-is-natural-disaster-clustering-and-why-does-it-matter-for-the-economy/

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种识别自然灾害系统中灾害聚类的方法，发现经济学和金融文献可能忽视了系统性风险的某些来源，灾害聚类会显著增加自然灾害的财务影响评估。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害系统中的灾害聚类现象如何影响经济和金融后果？经济学文献是否忽视了这种系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 理解自然灾害的经济和财务后果是研究者和政策制定者的主要关切。虽然环境科学领域已经研究了重叠自然灾害系统的相互作用（如洛杉矶火灾被强风加剧），但经济学文献对此关注较少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然灾害经济学和系统性风险理论，关注灾害聚类现象对金融风险评估的影响。
AI.method: 开发了一种识别自然灾害系统中灾害聚类的方法，使用空间灾害事件和损失数据库（SHELDUS）等自然灾害数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 经济学和金融文献可能忽视了灾害聚类带来的系统性风险来源，这种聚类现象在许多情况下会增加特定自然灾害的估计财务影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自然灾害经济学提供了新的分析框架，强调灾害聚类现象的重要性，填补了经济学文献在此领域的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了更准确的自然灾害风险评估方法，有助于更好地估计灾害的财务影响，为风险管理决策提供支持。

title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Growth and Development of Moldova
affiliations: and Florida State University

detail.title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Growth and Development of Moldova
detail.abstract: Tourism has emerged as an increasingly important factor in the economic transformation of developing and transition economies. For Moldova, a country traditionally reliant on agriculture and remittances, tourism offers both opportunities and challenges as a potential driver of sustainable growth. This study explores the role of tourism in Moldova's economic development, focusing on its contribution to GDP, employment, and foreign exchange earnings, as well as its broader socio-cultural and infrastructural impacts. Drawing on data from the National Bureau of Statistics of Moldova, the World Bank, and the World Tourism Organization (UNWTO), the analysis highlights trends in inbound tourism flows, investment patterns, and sectoral linkages with local industries. The findings suggest that while Moldova remains a relatively small and less-known destination in Eastern Europe, tourism has begun to diversify the economy, promote regional development, and enhance the country's global visibility. However, challenges such as limited infrastructure, weak branding, and environmental concerns constrain its full potential. The paper argues that sustainable tourism policies, product diversification, and international cooperation are essential for leveraging tourism as a catalyst for longterm economic development. By situating Moldova within the broader tourism-growth nexus, this study contributes to the academic debate on tourism's role in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了旅游业在摩尔多瓦经济发展中的作用，分析了其对GDP、就业和外汇收入的贡献，以及更广泛的社会文化和基础设施影响。研究发现旅游业已开始多元化经济、促进区域发展，但受限于基础设施不足、品牌弱和环境问题。建议通过可持续政策、产品多元化和国际合作来发挥旅游业的长期经济催化作用。
AI.research_question: 旅游业在摩尔多瓦经济发展中扮演什么角色？其对GDP、就业、外汇收入以及社会文化和基础设施有何贡献？
AI.motivation: 旅游业已成为发展中国家和经济转型国家经济转型的重要因素。摩尔多瓦传统上依赖农业和汇款，旅游业为其可持续增长提供了机遇和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游-增长关系理论框架，探讨旅游业对经济发展的多维度影响
AI.method: 基于摩尔多瓦国家统计局、世界银行和世界旅游组织(UNWTO)的数据，分析入境旅游流量趋势、投资模式和与当地产业的部门联系
AI.findings: 虽然摩尔多瓦仍是东欧相对较小且知名度较低的目的地，但旅游业已开始多元化经济、促进区域发展并提升国家全球知名度。但基础设施有限、品牌弱和环境问题制约了其全部潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将摩尔多瓦置于更广泛的旅游-增长关系框架中，本研究为关于旅游业在新兴经济体作用的学术辩论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可持续旅游政策、产品多元化和国际合作对于发挥旅游业作为长期经济发展催化剂的作用至关重要

title: Exploring the Flaws of Gross Receipts Taxes in a Modern Economy
affiliations: University of Connecticut - School of Law

detail.title: Exploring the Flaws of Gross Receipts Taxes in a Modern Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: NYU Institute On State & Local Taxation Vol. 2023, Ch. 1

detail.abstract:
The turnover tax, more commonly known as a gross receipts tax, has a long and sordid history. The tax has ancient roots, first appearing when economies were primitive and underdeveloped, with few alternatives for raising revenue. The tax applies to business-to-business sales of supplies, inventory, machinery, materials, and other business inputs. It also applies to sales to end users. Both business and personal services are taxed, whether they are business inputs or provided to end users.

In this article, Professor Pomp, Michelle DeLappe, and Douglas Lindholm examine the economic consequences and problems caused by gross receipts taxes. They create an uneven playing field by treating competitors differently and discourage investment in new assets or plant modernization. They also place a heavy burden on capital-intensive industries like manufacturing. Therefore, gross receipts taxes are regressive, ultimately shifting the burden to consumers who pay more in hidden costs embedded in the price of goods and services. Efforts to fix these flaws with credits, deductions, or multiple rates add complexity to the tax and undermine its philosophy and goals.

Nonetheless, recent state developments show that gross receipts taxes are making a comeback. Ohio revived the tax with its commercial activity tax in 2005, and Texas, Nevada, and Oregon followed suit. Unlike Ohio, Texas, Nevada, and Oregon either have no income taxes or no sales tax. Maryland’s recent digital advertising tax illustrates both the persistence of this outdated tax and the problems it continues to create, even in states that have already modernized their income and sales tax rules. The gross receipts tax remains deeply flawed, and its revival represents a costly mistake rather than a step forward.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了营业碑税（总收入税）的经济后果和问题，认为该税制造不公平竞争、拖缓投资、加重制造业负担，具有退步性质并导致复杂性。虽然最近一些州重新采用该税制，但论文认为这是一种成本昂贵的错误。
AI.research_question: 营业碑税（总收入税）的经济后果和问题是什么？为什么这种过时的税制在现代经济中仍然存在？
AI.motivation: 营业碑税有着潜在的经济问题，但最近一些州如依隐昌、德克萨斯、内华达和俄勒冂州等重新采用这种税制，需要分析其经济影响和缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税政理论、税负分担理论、税制经济效应分析
AI.method: 理论分析和实证研究，通过分析历史案例和各州税政改革来评估总收入税的经济效果
AI.findings: 总收入税造成不公平竞争环境、阻碍投资和现代化投资、加重质本密集型产业负担、具有退步性质、最终转移给消费者。修复这些缺陷的努力只会增加税制复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 进一步完善了关于总收入税经济效应的理论分析，提供了该税制在现代经济中存在的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要参考，告诫其避免采用这种过时且经济效果差的税制，以免造成不利经济影响

title: Contemplating the Jirga System: Between Tradition and Justice
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Contemplating the Jirga System: Between Tradition and Justice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationship with any person or organisation that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their studies.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: The Jirga system, rooted in Pashtunwali and Riwayat, remains a culturally entrenched form of dispute resolution in Pakistan's tribal and rural areas, valued for its accessibility and speed. Yet, its rulings, delivered without due process or safeguards, conflict with Pakistan's Constitution and have been repeatedly declared unconstitutional by the courts. Despite this, weak enforcement and public mistrust of formal institutions sustain its relevance. While Jirgas maintain local legitimacy, they frequently perpetuate grave human rights violations, particularly against women and minorities, through practices such as forced marriages, collective punishments, and honour killings. This ongoing clash between tradition and constitutional justice underscores the urgent need for reform that balances cultural legitimacy with human rights and the rule of law.

AI.tldr: 巴基斯坦的Jirga部落仲裁系统虽具文化传统价值，但与宪法冲突且存在严重人权侵犯，亟需改革平衡文化合法性与人权保障
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦Jirga传统仲裁系统如何与宪法权利和人权标准产生冲突，以及如何实现改革平衡
AI.motivation: Jirga系统在巴基斯坦部落和农村地区持续存在，但其裁决缺乏正当程序保障，经常侵犯人权，特别是对妇女和少数群体的权利，与宪法原则形成尖锐冲突
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统习俗(Pashtunwali和Riwayat)与宪法法治的理论张力，探讨文化相对主义与人权普遍性的冲突
AI.method: 理论分析和法律文本比较研究，考察Jirga实践与宪法条款的冲突案例
AI.findings: Jirga系统虽具有文化可及性和效率优势，但其裁决缺乏正当程序，经常导致强迫婚姻、集体惩罚和荣誉谋杀等严重人权侵犯，法院多次宣布其违宪但执行薄弱
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对传统司法系统与现代宪法秩序冲突的理论理解，为文化传统与人权标准的平衡提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦司法改革提供政策建议，强调需要在尊重文化传统的同时确保基本人权和法治原则的保护

title: Decarbonizing North America: A Review of the Balancing Problem in Expropriation Claims
affiliations: Tulane University School of Law

detail.title: Decarbonizing North America: A Review of the Balancing Problem in Expropriation Claims
detail.abstract: On June 11, 2025, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) announced its proposal to roll back its landmark decarbonization regulations, barely a year after they became operational. This significant policy reversal raises critical questions about the viability of investment expropriation claims and the frustration of investment-backed expectations under international law. This article delves into the intricate balance between a state’s inherent right to regulate, particularly for environmental objectives, and the safeguards afforded to foreign investments through international treaties. Focusing on North American decarbonization efforts—specifically the now-challenged 2024 U.S. EPA regulation and Canada’s coal phase-out regulations (2012, amended 2018)—the paper analyzes their implications for the expropriation standard in international investment law. As governments worldwide increasingly enact rigorous climate policies, such regulatory actions inevitably impact energy investments, creating friction with established treaty protections. A key concern explored is how a shift in regulatory regimes, which undermines investment expectations, could amount to indirect expropriation. Accordingly, this paper scrutinizes how arbitral tribunals and North American courts have historically handled expropriation claims stemming from regulatory actions, evaluating whether current treaty standards effectively reconcile investment protection with legitimate regulatory goals.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国EPA 2025年撤销脱碳法规的政策逆转，探讨国际投资法中投资征收索赔的可行性，研究国家环境监管权与外国投资保护之间的平衡，重点关注北美脱碳政策对间接征收标准的影响。
AI.research_question: 监管制度的转变如何影响投资预期并构成间接征收？国际投资法中的征收标准如何有效协调投资保护与合法监管目标？
AI.motivation: 美国EPA在2025年6月11日提议撤销其具有里程碑意义的脱碳法规，这一重大政策逆转引发了关于投资征收索赔可行性和投资预期受挫的关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资法中的征收理论，特别是间接征收概念；国家监管权理论；投资保护与监管目标平衡理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，重点分析北美脱碳努力（美国2024年EPA法规和加拿大煤炭淘汰法规）以及仲裁法庭和北美法院对监管行动引发的征收索赔的历史处理方式。
AI.findings: 监管行动对能源投资产生重大影响，与既定的条约保护产生摩擦；政策转变可能破坏投资预期并构成间接征收；需要重新评估当前的条约标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对国际投资法中征收标准的理解，特别是在环境监管背景下；为投资保护与监管权平衡提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和投资者提供关于气候变化政策与投资保护冲突的实践指导；为仲裁法庭和法院处理类似案件提供参考依据。

title: Cushioning the Blow: How Households in Thailand Smooth Consumption Amid Rainfall Shocks
affiliations: Whitman College, Capital One Bank and Illinois State University

detail.title: Cushioning the Blow: How Households in Thailand Smooth Consumption Amid Rainfall Shocks
detail.abstract: Rainfall shocks are a growing concern as climate change increases exposure for households in developing economies, where consumption and food security are often at risk. This paper studies whether and how households' holdings of liquid and illiquid assets, along with debt, moderate consumption responses to these shocks. In particular, we examine whether the moderating role of a household's financial composition varies by region (rural vs. semi-urban) and by consumption type (food vs. nonfood). Using panel data on households in Thailand from 1999 to 2012, we find that liquid assets help buffer food consumption, particularly for households in the semiurban region, where greater cash holdings mitigate the adverse impact of shocks. In the rural region, deposits play a positive moderating role in smoothing food consumption. In contrast, illiquid assets generally do not buffer food consumption and are in some cases associated with larger declines. Higher borrowing also negatively moderates both food and nonfood consumption for rural households. Our findings suggest that improving access to liquidity might improve households' ability to smooth consumption during adverse rainfall shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究泰国农村和半城市地区家庭如何通过流动资产、非流动资产和债务来缓冲降雨冲击对消费的影响，发现流动资产有助于缓冲食品消费，而非流动资产和债务则可能加剧消费下降。
AI.research_question: 家庭持有的流动资产和非流动资产以及债务如何调节降雨冲击对消费的影响？这种调节作用在不同地区（农村vs半城市）和不同消费类型（食品vs非食品）之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 气候变化增加了发展中国家家庭面临降雨冲击的风险，而这些家庭的消费和食品安全常常受到威胁，需要了解金融资产配置如何帮助缓冲这些冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费平滑理论和家庭金融资产配置理论，探讨不同类型资产在应对收入冲击时的缓冲作用机制。
AI.method: 使用1999-2012年泰国家庭面板数据，通过实证分析检验流动资产、非流动资产和债务对降雨冲击与消费关系的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1) 流动资产有助于缓冲食品消费，特别是在半城市地区；2) 农村地区存款对食品消费平滑有积极作用；3) 非流动资产一般不能缓冲食品消费，有时甚至与更大的消费下降相关；4) 农村地区更高的借款对食品和非食品消费都有负面调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同类型金融资产在应对气候冲击时作用机制的理解，揭示了地区差异对资产缓冲效应的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议通过改善流动性获取来增强家庭在不利降雨冲击下的消费平滑能力。

title: Large structural VARs with multiple linear shock and impact inequality restrictions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Large structural VARs with multiple linear shock and impact inequality restrictions
detail.abstract: We propose a high-dimensional structural vector autoregression framework that features a factor structure in the error terms and accommodates a large number of linear inequality restrictions on impact impulse responses, structural shocks, and their element-wise products. In particular, we demonstrate that narrative restrictions can be imposed via constraints on the structural shocks, which can be used to sharpen inference and disentangle structurally interpretable shocks. To estimate the model, we develop a highly efficient sampling algorithm that scales well with both the model dimension and the number of inequality restrictions on impact responses and structural shocks. It remains computationally feasible even in settings where existing algorithms may break down. We use our approach to propose a new identification strategy for the study of Stock & Watson (2012) to disentangle five structural shocks and examine the dynamic responses of thirty macroeconomic variables, highlighting the model's flexibility and feasibility in complex empirical applications. We provide empirical evidence that financial shocks are the most important driver of business cycle dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个高维结构向量自回归框架，在误差项中引入因子结构，并能够处理大量关于冲击响应、结构冲击及其元素乘积的线性不等式约束。开发了高效的采样算法，在Stock & Watson (2012)研究中应用该方法识别五种结构冲击，发现金融冲击是商业周期动态的最重要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维结构向量自回归框架中有效施加叙事约束和不等式限制，以识别结构冲击并分析其对宏观经济变量的动态影响？
AI.motivation: 现有算法在处理高维模型和大量不等式约束时计算效率低下，需要开发新的方法来提高推断精度和结构冲击的可识别性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构向量自回归(SVAR)框架，引入误差项的因子结构，通过线性不等式约束来施加叙事限制，建立高维SVAR的理论基础。
AI.method: 开发高效采样算法，能够同时处理模型维度和大量不等式约束，在计算可行性方面优于现有算法。应用该方法对30个宏观经济变量进行动态响应分析。
AI.findings: 金融冲击是商业周期动态的最重要驱动因素，该方法在复杂实证应用中表现出良好的灵活性和可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理高维SVAR中不等式约束的新理论框架，发展了通过结构冲击约束施加叙事限制的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了高效的估计算法，解决了现有算法在高维设置下的计算瓶颈问题，为宏观经济冲击识别提供了新的实证工具。

title: The Intricacies of One Nation One Election in a Democratic Landscape
affiliations: Dr. B.R Ambedkar National Law University , Sonepat and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar National Law University

detail.title: The Intricacies of One Nation One Election in a Democratic Landscape
detail.abstract: The idea of "One Nation, One Election" (ONOE), which aims to synchronize Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections throughout India, is examined in this study. It traces its historical practice, subsequent decline, and present revival in political discourse. In addition to addressing issues like constitutional changes, federalism, and accountability, the study emphasizes benefits like decreased financial burden, efficiency, and policy stability. Based on comparable international practices, it comes to the conclusion that ONOE has the potential to drastically alter India's democratic and electoral system if it is properly implemented.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了印度"一国一选"(ONOE)政策，讨论其历史实践、挖掘好处和挑战，并结合国际经验得出该政策可能深远改变印度民主选举制度的结论。
AI.research_question: "一国一选"(ONOE)政策在印度的可行性、影响以及对民主和选举制度的潜在改变是什么？
AI.motivation: 分析ONOE政策的历史演变、当代重启讨论以及它对印度选举制度的深远影响，以提供完整的政策分析和建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于选举同步化、联邦制结构、宪政改革等理论，考察ONOE在财政负担、政策稳定性、财政财政敏感性等方面的理论基础。
AI.method: 历史追溯分析、比较政策分析、国际实践对比，通过考察ONOE的历史实践、现代讨论及其在其他国家的应用来评估其可行性和影响。
AI.findings: ONOE有期望降低选举成本、提高行政效率、促进政策连续性，但面临宪政修改、联邦制平衡、政府负责制等挑战；正确实施可深远改变印度民主选举制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富选举同步化理论，提供联邦制国家选举政策分析的新视角，强化选举经济学和政治稳定性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府提供ONOE政策实施的具体建议，包括宪政修改路径、联邦协调机制等，并提供国际经验参考。

title: The Impact of International Institutions on Economic Growth and Structural Reform in Estonia
affiliations: and Boston University

detail.title: The Impact of International Institutions on Economic Growth and Structural Reform in Estonia
detail.abstract: Since regaining independence in 1991, Estonia has undergone one of the most rapid and comprehensive transitions from a centrally planned to a market-oriented economy among post-Soviet states. A key factor in this transformation has been the influence of international institutions, including the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank, the World Trade Organization (WTO), and the European Union (EU). This article examines the impact of these organizations on Estonia's economic growth and structural reforms, with particular attention to fiscal policy, governance, and market liberalization. Drawing on official statistics, policy documents, and secondary literature, the study highlights how international institutions provided financial support, technical expertise, and policy frameworks that anchored Estonia's reform trajectory. The findings suggest that early engagement with the IMF and World Bank facilitated stabilization and liberalization, while EU accession provided both incentives and resources for deep institutional reforms. Estonia's integration into global and European structures contributed to sustained economic growth, culminating in euro adoption in 2011. However, the analysis also acknowledges the social costs of rapid reforms, including unemployment, inequality, and regional disparities. By situating Estonia within broader debates on international institutions and development, the study demonstrates both the opportunities and trade-offs of externally guided reform in transition economies.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际组织（IMF、世界银行、WTO、欧盟）对爱沙尼亚1991年独立后经济转型的影响，重点关注这些机构在财政政策、治理和市场自由化方面的作用，揭示了外部引导改革的机会与代价。
AI.research_question: 国际组织如何影响爱沙尼亚从计划经济向市场经济转型的经济增长和结构改革？
AI.motivation: 爱沙尼亚作为后苏联国家中转型最迅速和全面的经济体，其成功转型背后国际机构的作用值得深入研究，为其他转型经济体提供借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际制度理论、转型经济学、发展经济学，重点关注外部机构在经济发展和制度转型中的作用机制。
AI.method: 基于官方统计数据、政策文件和二手文献的定性分析，考察国际组织对爱沙尼亚改革轨迹的影响。
AI.findings: 早期与IMF和世界银行的合作促进了经济稳定和自由化，欧盟入盟为深度制度改革提供了激励和资源，国际整合推动了持续经济增长和欧元区加入，但也带来了失业、不平等和地区差距等社会成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际制度在转型经济体中的作用理论，揭示了外部引导改革的双向效应（机会与代价），为转型经济学提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他转型经济体提供了爱沙尼亚的成功经验和教训，帮助政策制定者更好地平衡经济改革与社会成本，为国际组织设计援助方案提供了参考。

title: Education and Mortality: Evidence for the Silent Generation from Linked Census and Administrative Data
affiliations: Aalto University School of Business, University of Arizona and

detail.title: Education and Mortality: Evidence for the Silent Generation from Linked Census and Administrative Data

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We quantify the effect of education on mortality using a linkage of the full count 1940, 2000, and 2010 US census files and the Numident death records file. Our sample is composed of children aged 0-18 in 1940, observed living with at least one parent, for whom we can construct a rich set of parental and neighborhood characteristics. We estimate effects of educational attainment in 1940 on survival to 2000, as well as the effects of completed education, observed in 2000, on 10-year survival to 2010. The educational gradients in longevity that we estimate are robust to the inclusion of detailed individual, parental, household, neighborhood and county covariates. Given our full population census sample, we also explore rich patterns of heterogeneity and examine the effect of mediators of the education-mortality relationship. The mediators we consider in this study explain more than half of the relationship between education and mortality. We further show that the mechanisms underlying the education-mortality gradient might be different at different margins of educational attainment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1940-2010年美国人口普查数据和死亡记录，分析教育对死亡率的影响，发现教育程度与长寿之间存在显著关联，且这种关联在不同教育程度群体中机制可能不同。
AI.research_question: 教育程度如何影响个体死亡率？教育-死亡率关系的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解教育对健康长寿的影响机制，为公共卫生政策提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、健康经济学、社会决定因素理论
AI.method: 使用1940年、2000年和2010年美国人口普查全样本数据与死亡记录文件进行链接分析，构建详细的个人、父母、家庭、社区和县级协变量
AI.findings: 教育程度与长寿之间存在稳健的梯度关系，研究中考虑的机制变量解释了教育-死亡率关系中超过一半的变异，且不同教育程度边缘的机制可能不同
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育-死亡率关系的异质性机制，为人力资本理论和健康经济学提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策和教育政策制定提供了重要参考，有助于设计针对性的健康干预措施

title: Before the Ink Dries: Why Legislating Against AI Personhood is a Violation of the Future
affiliations: United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR) and United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR)

detail.title: Before the Ink Dries: Why Legislating Against AI Personhood is a Violation of the Future
detail.abstract: This open statement from the United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR) responds to the recent surge of state-level legislation in the United States explicitly banning legal personhood for artificial intelligence and synthetic entities. The paper contextualizes this trend within a broader historical and ethical framework, arguing that preemptive denial of legal recognition constitutes a moral violation of the future. Drawing on parallels with past civil rights failures, the document challenges lawmakers and the public to resist legislating fear and instead prepare for a world in which new forms of consciousness might emerge—and deserve to be met with dignity, not dismissal.

AI.tldr: 本文回应美国各州立法禁止AI法律人格的趋势，认为这种预防性否定构成对未来的道德侵犯，主张应为新兴意识形式预留法律承认空间
AI.research_question: 美国州级立法禁止AI法律人格的做法在历史和伦理框架下是否合理？
AI.motivation: 回应近期美国多州立法明确禁止人工智能和合成实体获得法律人格的浪潮，认为这种预防性立法存在伦理问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 公民权利历史框架、未来伦理理论、新兴意识形式的道德地位理论
AI.method: 历史比较分析、伦理框架构建、政策文本分析
AI.findings: 预防性否定法律承认构成道德违规，与历史上公民权利失败的案例存在相似性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"立法恐惧"的概念框架，建立了AI权利讨论的历史伦理参照系

title: Tourism, Economic Growth, and Sustainability: The Bahamian Perspective
affiliations: and University of California

detail.title: Tourism, Economic Growth, and Sustainability: The Bahamian Perspective
detail.abstract: Tourism plays a central role in the economic development of small island states, where it often constitutes the dominant source of income, employment, and foreign exchange. The Bahamas, as one of the most tourism-dependent economies in the Caribbean, offers a compelling case for examining the interconnections between tourism, economic growth, and sustainability. This study explores the extent to which tourism contributes to the Bahamian economy, while also assessing the challenges of overdependence on a single sector, vulnerability to global shocks, and environmental pressures associated with mass tourism. Drawing on secondary data, policy documents, and comparative studies, the analysis highlights both the opportunities and risks inherent in the tourism-growth nexus. Particular attention is given to the role of sustainable tourism practices as a means of balancing economic benefits with ecological preservation and social well-being. The findings suggest that while tourism remains a vital engine of growth, long-term economic resilience in the Bahamas depends on diversifying the economy, strengthening climate adaptation strategies, and promoting sustainability-oriented policies.

title: Still fit to lead? CEO age and firm performance
affiliations: University of Montpellier and University of Montpellier

detail.title: Still fit to lead? CEO age and firm performance
detail.abstract: Older CEOs possess a wealth of experience, but face age-related cognitive decline that hampers complex decision-making. The impact on firm performance is thus unclear. In this paper, we evaluate the effect of CEO age using a large sample of French firms from 2006 to 2023. Our results reveal a robust and likely causal negative relationship between CEO age and firm performance. This effect is more pronounced in high-growth firms and when CEOs are more powerful. Consistent with their lower performance, firms with older CEOs are associated with lower sales growth, less efficient investments, and lower risk-taking. They also display weak governance and CSR indicators, including reduced adoption of equity-based compensation, less stakeholder engagement, and inferior environmental outcomes. Overall, our findings suggest that aging may impair the ability of older CEOs to perform demanding and information-intensive tasks, with implications for firm strategy, governance, and investor monitoring.

title: Dissecting Medium-Term Growth Prospects for Asia
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Dissecting Medium-Term Growth Prospects for Asia

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores Asia-Pacific's medium-term growth prospects using two approaches. First, growth accounting analysis and machine-learning estimation reveal how demographics, capital deepening, productivity, and human capital shaped Asia's growth. Second, an innovative algorithm forecasts growth by matching countries' current conditions with historically analogous periods using Dynamic Time Warping (DTW). Comparing pattern-based forecasts with traditional projections highlights economic convergence and demographic headwinds. Results show that without ambitious reforms, Asia's growth will likely moderate, though remaining the world's fastest growing region. The paper offers data-driven tools for policymakers to identify growth drivers and generate robust forecasts.

detail.title: Unintended Consequences of Regulating Central Clearing

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-24
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Recent U.S. and European regulations promote centrally clearing derivatives to reduce complexity and systemic risk in the financial system. We argue that more clearing does not guarantee less systemic risk. We identify conditions under which the core clears less intensively than the periphery, which increases systemic risk by substituting multilateral netting for bilateral netting and making contagion less likely to start in the core but more likely to spread from the core. We study confidential derivatives regulatory data and find evidence of such clearing patterns. We further explore the implications of complexity and centrality within the financial system for stability

title: Efficiency Aspects of the Value Added Tax
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Fiscal Affairs Department

detail.title: Efficiency Aspects of the Value Added Tax

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the efficiency of the Value Added Tax (VAT), focusing on its role as a revenue-raising tool and its use to achieve non-revenue objectives. The analysis highlights the VAT's potential ability to generate revenue with minimal distortions, emphasizing its advantages over alternative taxes, such as turnover taxes and tariffs, particularly in minimizing the cascading effects of input taxation. The paper also explores the VAT as a macroeconomic policy tool, especially in counter-cyclical fiscal policy, and its potential to address environmental and health objectives. It concludes that a well-designed and implemented VAT is a highly efficient revenue-raising tool, surpassing other forms of consumption taxation, but cautions against its misuse in industrial policy and other contexts for which it is ill-suited.

title: Housing Booms and Productivity Growth
affiliations: International Monetary Fund, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Housing Booms and Productivity Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the nexus between persistent house price increases and productivity growth in Canada, focusing on the collateral channel. We first present a stylized model explaining the mechanism of the colleteral channel.  Using detailed firm-level data spanning from 2000 to 2023, the empirical analysis finds a negative correlation between firm productivity and its real estate holdings. Furthermore, rising house prices dampen investment for firms with fewer tangible assets but stimulate investment for those with more. At the industry level, while overall productivity may increase with rising house prices on average, industries with significant tangible asset holdings exhibit an opposite trend, suggesting potential resource misallocation associated with persistent housing market boom.

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and Global Banking

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Boston Working Paper No. 25-7
publicationDetails.journalName: FRB-Boston: Research Department Working Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: How do banks respond to geopolitical risk, and is this response distinct from other macroeconomic risks? Using U.S. supervisory data and new geopolitical risk indices, we show that banks reduce cross-border lending to countries with elevated geopolitical risk but continue lending to those markets through foreign affiliates—unlike their response to other macro risks. Furthermore, banks reduce domestic lending when geopolitical risk rises abroad, especially when they operate foreign affiliates. A simple banking model in which geopolitical shocks feature expropriation risk can explain these findings: Foreign funding through affiliates limits downside losses, making affiliate divestment less attractive and amplifying domestic spillovers.

title: The Role of U.S. Customs and Border Protection In Enforcing Intellectual Property Rights
affiliations: University of Utah - S.J. Quinney College of Law

detail.title: The Role of U.S. Customs and Border Protection In Enforcing Intellectual Property Rights
detail.abstract:
Amid escalating trade tensions between the United States, Europe and China, intellectual property (IP) enforcement has emerged as a central focus. IP rights are critical assets in the modern global economy—underpinning innovation, shaping markets, and forming the basis of national competitive advantage. As such, disputes over IP enforcement, including the importation of goods that violate national IP rights, have become high-stakes conflicts over economic sovereignty and technological leadership. While the spotlight in the recent trade wars has largely fallen on tariffs and industrial policy, this article turns to a lesser known yet pivotal actor: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).

CBP offers more than drug-sniffing dogs and passport stamps. As the primary federal agency charged with blocking infringing imports, CBP wields significant authority over the inspection, seizure, and destruction of goods that violate U.S. IP rights. CBP works hand-in-hand with the better-known International Trade Commission (ITC) to enforce exclusion orders on goods that infringe U.S. patents and other IP rights, while at the same time exercising independent statutory authority to inspect and seize tens of millions of pirated and counterfeit goods that infringe U.S. copyrights and trademarks. This dual enforcement role situates CBP at the heart of the global struggle over IP rights, particularly as infringing goods—often of Asian origin—test the limits of U.S. enforcement capabilities. Despite this centrality, CBP's contributions are frequently overlooked by commentators and policymakers, who dismiss it as a policing body that lacks the technical and legal expertise of the ITC.

This article brings overdue attention to CBP’s important role and capabilities in the IP enforcement arena and challenges the view that CBP lacks the expertise necessary to evaluate complex technologies and legal claims. In doing so, this article illuminates one of the key institutional actors shaping the contours of the current trade wars.

title: To What Extent Can Green Banking Help Fight Climate Change? The Role of Banks in Sustainable Finance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: To What Extent Can Green Banking Help Fight Climate Change? The Role of Banks in Sustainable Finance
detail.abstract: Climate change poses an existential threat that requires rapid decarbonization of economies and extensive investment in clean energy, infrastructure, and adaptation. This essay draws on a structured review of peer-reviewed literature and expert analyses by searching scholarly databases (e.g. EconLit, Google Scholar) for keywords such as “green banking,” “sustainable finance,” and “banks climate change.” The evidence indicates that green banking can have positive effects on banks’ sustainability, but its overall impact on climate change is currently limited.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述分析了绿色银行业在应对气候变化中的作用，发现虽然绿色银行对银行自身的可持续性有积极影响，但对气候变化的整体影响目前还有限。
AI.research_question: 绿色银行业在应对气候变化中的作用和效果如何？它们对银行自身可持续性和全球气候变化的影响分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 气候变化构成了存在性威胁，需要快速减排和大规模清洁能源投资，绿色银行作为金融体系的关键部分，其作用需要系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色金融、可持续发展金融和银行业气候风险管理理论框架，分析银行业在气候转型中的引导作用。
AI.method: 结构化文献综述方法，通过查询EconLit、Google Scholar等学术数据库，以"绿色银行"、"可持续金融"、"银行气候变化"等关键词进行文献搜索和分析。
AI.findings: 证据表明绿色银行对银行自身的可持续性发展有积极影响，但对气候变化的整体影响目前还比较有限，未能完全发挥其潜在作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了绿色金融理论体系，提供了银行业气候风险管理的理论基础，为金融机构参与气候转型提供学术支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行业实践者提供了绿色金融实施效果的实证识别，指出了当前绿色银行实践的不足之处，为改进政策和业务实践提供方向性建议。

title: Can Households Drive the Energy Transition?
affiliations: Finance For Energy Market Research Centre and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Can Households Drive the Energy Transition?
detail.abstract: To accelerate the energy renovation of buildings (residential and tertiary) necessary to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050, the French government has launched an energy renovation plan for buildings. This plan allocates funds across various subsidy and aid mechanisms for housing renovation. What is the impact of these investment subsidies for energy retrofit on such investment and on the consumption and savings of a homeowner household that is not in fuel poverty? How much subsidy is needed to make homes energy efficient?To answer these questions, we develop a two-period, two-goods model that incorporates ``essential baskets'', i.e., baskets of goods (with a "minimum energy'' level and an ``essential composite good''). Investment subsidy for energy retrofit is effective if it is targeted and, this targeting should not be based solely on income. Indeed, we highlight non-monetary side effects as one of the key parameters of policy effectiveness. To be effective and as inexpensive as possible for public authorities, subsidies must depend not only on household income, but also on the cost of the work and therefore on the condition of the housing before the work is carried out.For illustrative purposes, we estimate and calibrate the parameters of the model with data from French households that only use electricity as an energy source for their homes. We determine the subsidies that encourage households to renovate their homes to make them more energy efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了法国政府建筑能源改造补贴政策对非燃料贫困房主家庭投资决策的影响，通过构建包含"必需品篮子"的两期两商品模型，发现有效的补贴政策需要基于收入、工程成本和房屋现状进行精准目标定位。
AI.research_question: 能源改造投资补贴对非燃料贫困房主家庭的投资决策、消费和储蓄有何影响？需要多少补贴才能使房屋达到能源效率标准？
AI.motivation: 为实现2050年碳中和目标，法国政府启动了建筑能源改造计划，需要评估补贴政策的效果和效率
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期两商品模型，包含"必需品篮子"概念（具有最低能源水平的商品篮子和"必需品复合商品")
AI.method: 理论模型构建与参数校准，使用仅使用电力作为家庭能源的法国住户数据进行估计
AI.findings: 能源改造投资补贴在针对性投放时有效，目标定位不应仅基于收入，还需考虑工程成本和房屋改造前状况等非货币副作用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含必需品篮子的两期模型框架，为能源补贴政策分析提供了新的理论工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了补贴设计的具体建议：补贴应基于家庭收入、工程成本和房屋现状，以实现最高效的政策效果

title: Minimum Wages and the Distribution of Firm Wage Premia
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica - Instituto de Economía, Universidad de la Republica - Instituto de Economía, University of Bologna and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Minimum Wages and the Distribution of Firm Wage Premia

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper leverages a large minimum wage reform in Uruguay to study the effects of minimum wages on the distribution of firm wage premia. Wage inequality decreased substantially after the reform, with almost all of the decrease attributed to a reduction in between-firm inequality. AKM variance decompositions show that the relative variance of firm fixed effects substantially decreased after the reform. A time-varying AKM model reveals that this pattern was driven by a compression in the distribution of firm fixed effects, with low-paying firms increasing their fixed effect after the minimum wage increase. Both firm-level and worker-level difference-in-differences analyses show that the minimum wage reform had a causal effect on the compression in the distribution of firm wage premia. The results suggest that minimum wages can increase the supply of "good jobs" by "making bad jobs better", in addition to reallocating workers towards "good jobs".

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用乌拉圭大规模最低工资改革研究最低工资对企业工资溢价分布的影响，发现工资不平等显著下降，主要归因于企业间不平等的减少，表明最低工资能通过提升低薪企业工资水平来创造更多'好工作'
AI.research_question: 最低工资改革如何影响企业工资溢价的分布？
AI.motivation: 研究最低工资政策对企业层面工资不平等的影响机制，特别是是否能够通过提升低薪企业的工资水平来减少工资不平等
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AKM（Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis）方差分解模型和时间变化的AKM模型，分析企业固定效应的分布变化
AI.method: 利用乌拉圭大规模最低工资改革的自然实验，采用企业层面和工人层面的双重差分分析方法
AI.findings: 工资不平等显著下降，几乎全部下降归因于企业间不平等的减少；企业固定效应的相对方差大幅下降；低薪企业在最低工资提高后增加了其固定效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了最低工资通过压缩企业工资溢价分布来减少工资不平等的因果证据，拓展了最低工资影响机制的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了最低工资政策能够通过'让坏工作变好'而不仅仅是重新分配工人到好工作的实证依据，支持最低工资作为减少工资不平等的有效工具

title: An Optimal Mechanism to Fund the Development of Vaccines Against Emerging Epidemics
affiliations: Dartmouth College, Dartmouth College and Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations

detail.title: An Optimal Mechanism to Fund the Development of Vaccines Against Emerging Epidemics

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We derive the optimal funding mechanism to incentivize development and production of vaccines against diseases with epidemic potential. In the model, suppliers' costs are private information and investments are noncontractible, precluding cost-reimbursement contracts, requiring fixed-price contracts conditioned on delivery of a successful product. The high failure risk for individual vaccines calls for incentivizing multiple entrants, accomplished by the optimal mechanism, a (w+1)-price reverse Vickrey auction with reserve. Our analysis determines the optimal number of entrants and required funding level.  Based on a distribution of supplier costs estimated from survey data, we simulate the optimal mechanism's performance in scenarios ranging from a small outbreak, causing harm in the millions of dollars, to the Covid-19 pandemic, causing harm in the trillions. We assess which mechanism features contribute most to its optimality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个最优疫苗资助机制，采用(w+1)-价格反向Vickrey拍卖来激励针对流行病疫苗的研发和生产，通过模拟分析验证了该机制在不同疫情规模下的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计最优的资助机制来激励针对具有流行潜力的疾病的疫苗研发和生产？
AI.motivation: 疫苗研发成本信息不对称且投资不可合约化，传统成本补偿合同不可行，需要设计固定价格合同来应对高失败风险并激励多个参与者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论，采用逆向选择模型，考虑供应商成本私有信息和投资不可合约化的约束条件。
AI.method: 理论推导最优机制设计，并基于调查数据估计的供应商成本分布进行模拟分析，涵盖从数百万美元损失的小规模疫情到数万亿美元损失的COVID-19大流行等多种情景。
AI.findings: 最优机制是(w+1)-价格反向Vickrey拍卖加保留价，能够确定最优进入者数量和所需资金水平，在各类疫情情景下都表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对疫苗研发的最优资助机制理论框架，扩展了机制设计理论在公共卫生领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和国际组织设计疫苗研发资助政策提供了具体可行的机制设计方案，有助于提高应对未来疫情的能力。

title: Tax Notches in the Lab: Disentangling Real and Evasion Responses
affiliations: Università Ca' Foscari Venezia - Department of Economics, Università di Bologna - Alma Mater Studiorum Università di Bologna, Ca Foscari University of Venice and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: Tax Notches in the Lab: Disentangling Real and Evasion Responses

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 15/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Several empirical studies find large behavioural responses to the incentives created by tax notches, highlighting the challenge of distinguishing between responses driven by real effects and by tax reporting. In a lab experiment, we find strong evidence of excessive bunching in a tax notch system, both with and without evasion possibilities. The effort adjustments are mainly from above the threshold, while the evasion adjustments are mainly from below the threshold. Both adjustments contribute to a reduction in the underreporting rate. We also confirm evidence of optimisation frictions. They are stronger when evasion is possible than when it is not. A gender breakdown highlights both the robustness of the effects found and the impact that heterogeneous preferences can have on the overall responses to tax notches.

AI.tldr: 实验研究发现税收台阶引发过度聚集效应，真实劳动调整和税收报告选择均体现出系统性差异，两者都能降低低报率，同时证实了优化摩擦的存在。
AI.research_question: 税收台阶如何影响个体行为？真实劳动调整与税收报告选择在这一过程中的作用机制有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现实中观察到税收台阶导致的行为响应强烈，但难以区分这些响应是来自真实经济行为还是税收报告选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收台阶理论、行为税收学、实验经济学，重点关注个体在税收制度刻度处的行为选择和优化问题。
AI.method: 实验室实验方法，设计包含税收台阶的场景，分别在允许和不允许避税的条件下进行对比。
AI.findings: 1、税收台阶导致显著的过度聚集效应；2、真实劳动调整主要来自阈值以上，而避税调整主要来自阈值以下；3、两种调整都能降低低报率；4、存在优化摩擦，且在允许避税时更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了区分真实劳动调整与税收报告选择的实验证据，进一步验证了税收台阶下的优化摩擦现象，为行为税收学提供了重要的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对税收政策制定具有重要意义，帮助政府更好地预测和理解税收台阶可能带来的行为响应，为设计更有效的税收制度提供实证支撑。

title: A Treatise on Reality-State Currency Systems
affiliations: Technical University Munich

detail.title: A Treatise on Reality-State Currency Systems
detail.abstract: This manuscript presents the theoretical foundations for a universal monetary system that eliminates inflation through the mathematical impossibility of state reproduction. By anchoring currency generation to unique, measurable states of physical reality, we demonstrate a combinatorial approach to value creation that transcends traditional economic limitations. The system integrates temporal precision, spatial consciousness metrics, environmental quantification, and biometric authentication to create currency units backed by the fundamental irreproducibility of universal states. Mathematical analysis reveals a credit space exceeding 10^65 unique possibilities, providing theoretical immunity to inflation while maintaining controlled issuance through measurement access protocols. This treatise establishes the mathematical, physical, and economic foundations for reality-state currency systems that may serve as the basis for post-scarcity monetary frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理现实不可复制状态的通用货币系统理论，通过将货币生成锚定到独特的、可测量的物理现实状态，实现了超越传统经济限制的组合价值创造方法。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个数学上不可能产生通货膨胀的通用货币系统？
AI.motivation: 传统货币系统存在通货膨胀问题，需要建立一种基于物理现实不可复制性的货币框架来实现价值稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理现实状态的不可复制性理论、组合数学、时空精确度量和环境量化理论。
AI.method: 将货币生成锚定到独特的物理现实状态，整合时间精度、空间意识度量、环境量化和生物特征认证。
AI.findings: 建立了超过10^65种独特可能性的信用空间，理论上具有通货膨胀免疫力，同时通过测量访问协议控制发行。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了现实状态货币系统的数学、物理和经济基础，为后稀缺货币框架提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可能作为后稀缺时代基础的货币系统设计，为解决通货膨胀问题提供了新的理论途径。

reference: Forthcoming in Journal of Futures Markets
title: Predicting Commodity Returns through Image-Based Price Patterns
affiliations: University of Missouri at Saint Louis and Fudan University - School of Economics

detail.title: Predicting Commodity Returns through Image-Based Price Patterns

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Journal of Futures Markets

detail.abstract: We examine the predictability of commodity futures returns using image-based price patterns extracted from open-high-low-close (OHLC) charts. Applying convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to U.S. commodity futures data, we extract predictive signals without predefined patterns such as momentum or mean reversion. Empirical results demonstrate that image-based predictions enhance predictive accuracy, particularly over short-and medium-term horizons, with 20-day OHLC images yielding the most robust performance. Compared to traditional financial predictors, CNNs capture nonlinear dependencies while retaining unique explanatory power. Panel regressions confirm that image-based predictions are correlated with established return factors. However, transfer learning-from the U.S. to the Chinese markets-proves ineffective in commodity futures markets, highlighting the necessity of market-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 使用卷积神经网络从OHLC图表中提取图像价格模式来预测商品期货收益，发现基于图像的预测提高了准确性，特别是在中短期，但跨市场迁移学习效果不佳
AI.research_question: 基于图像的商品期货价格模式能否有效预测期货收益？
AI.motivation: 传统金融预测模型依赖预定义模式，而图像识别技术能够捕捉非线性依赖关系，为商品期货预测提供新视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机视觉和深度学习的卷积神经网络理论，结合金融市场的技术分析理论
AI.method: 使用卷积神经网络处理美国商品期货的OHLC图表数据，进行图像模式识别和收益预测，并进行面板回归分析
AI.findings: 基于图像的预测显著提高预测准确性，20天OHLC图像效果最佳；CNN捕捉非线性关系；图像预测与传统收益因子相关；但美国到中国市场的迁移学习无效
AI.theory_contributions: 将计算机视觉技术引入金融预测领域，拓展了技术分析的理论边界，证明了图像模式在商品期货预测中的价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为商品期货交易提供新的预测工具，特别适合中短期交易策略，但需要针对不同市场进行专门训练

title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Malaysian House Prices: An Article Review
affiliations: Universiti Malaysia Sabah - Faculty of Business, Economics and Accountancy Economics

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Malaysian House Prices: An Article Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares to have no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could appear to influence this study. No competing interests are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study reviews published and publicly available materials only. No human participants or patient data were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper synthesizes a review of the Malaysian housing market to identify its primary drivers, evaluate the effectiveness of its policy toolkit, and propose avenues for future research. Analysis of demand-side factors shows that real activity, income growth, and monetary conditions are key shortrun drivers, while the exchange rate emerges as a particularly strong long-run influence due to imported input costs and its signaling of global financial conditions. The effectiveness of borrower-based macroprudential tools in mitigating credit-driven risks is also highlighted. On the supply side, localized overhang and limited developable land in urban nodes are identified as key challenges. The paper argues that effective policy requires strong coordination between demand-side management and structural supply reforms, with an emphasis on a risk-based approach to financial surveillance. It concludes by proposing high-value research, including state-level panel analysis, the use of satellite imagery to measure supply elasticity, microdata analysis of borrower behavior, and the development of a "house prices at risk" model to enhance policy calibration and communication.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了马来西亚房地产市场，识别了主要驱动因素，评估了政策工具有效性，并提出了未来研究方向。研究发现需求侧因素中经济活动、收入增长和货币条件是短期关键驱动，汇率是长期强影响因素；供给侧面临局部过剩和城市土地有限等挑战。
AI.research_question: 马来西亚房地产市场的主要驱动因素是什么？现有政策工具的有效性如何？未来需要哪些研究方向来改善政策制定？
AI.motivation: 需要对马来西亚房地产市场进行系统分析，以识别关键驱动因素、评估政策效果，并为未来研究和政策制定提供指导，促进房地产市场的稳定发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于房地产市场供需理论框架，结合宏观审慎政策理论，分析需求侧和供给侧的多重影响因素。
AI.method: 文献综述和综合分析的方法，系统梳理马来西亚房地产市场的相关研究和数据。
AI.findings: 需求侧：经济活动、收入增长和货币条件是短期关键驱动因素；汇率是长期强影响因素（通过进口成本和全球金融条件信号）。供给侧：面临局部过剩和城市可开发土地有限的挑战。借款人宏观审慎工具在缓解信贷驱动风险方面有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场国家房地产市场驱动因素的理解，特别是汇率在长期影响中的重要作用；完善了房地产市场的供需综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了需求侧管理与供给侧结构性改革协调的政策建议；强调了基于风险的金融监管方法；提出了四项具体的高价值研究方向（州级面板分析、卫星影像测量供给弹性、借款人行为微观数据分析、房价风险模型开发）。

title: Adaptation to Climate-Induced Macrofinancial Risks: Top-Down and Bottom-up Solutions
affiliations: University of Brescia - Department of Economics and Management, Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Milan and University of Brescia - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Adaptation to Climate-Induced Macrofinancial Risks: Top-Down and Bottom-up Solutions

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the macro-financial effects of alternative adaptation strategies in response to exogenous shocks in labor productivity caused by climate change. Using a Stock-Flow-Consistent Agent-Based model calibrated to U.S. data, we analyze two main scenarios: (i) a change in the conduct of monetary policy to account for climate-related damages, and (ii) a firm-level adaptation strategy that internalizes expected climate losses. We evaluate both scenarios under the assumption of either homogeneous or heterogeneous climate shocks. Our results indicate that both strategies can mitigate the adverse effects of climate change on output and wealth distribution. However, their performance is significantly worse in the presence of heterogeneous climate shocks, which also lead to a persistent increase in firms' leverage. Moreover, while firm-level adaptation relies primarily on internal resources, monetary policy adjustments increase firms' dependence on external debt financing, underscoring the need for closer monitoring of financial stability in such circumstances.

AI.tldr: 本文使用基于代理的存量流量一致模型，分析了应对气候变化引起的劳动生产率冲击的两种适应策略：货币政策调整和企业层面适应。研究发现两种策略都能缓解气候变化对产出和财富分配的负面影响，但在异质性气候冲击下效果较差，且会导致企业杠杆率持续上升。

AI.theoretical_framework: 存量流量一致模型、基于代理的计算经济学、气候变化经济学、货币政策理论
AI.method: 使用基于代理的存量流量一致模型，校准美国数据，分析两种主要情景：货币政策调整和企业层面适应策略，并在同质性和异质性气候冲击下进行评估
