title: Recurring-Payment Sensitivity in Household Borrowing
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Recurring-Payment Sensitivity in Household Borrowing

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-22
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides evidence of payment sensitivity in household borrowing decisions: Mortgage borrowers respond to the size of the recurring payment as opposed to discounted total loan costs when choosing between loan options. I develop a test for payment sensitivity that exploits differences in predicted bunching at kinks and notches generated by mortgage insurance requirements. I find that borrowing is substantially more responsive to nominal recurring payments than to the net present value of total costs. To rationalize the result, outside borrowing costs would have to be implausibly high, exceeding 40% a year. Payment sensitivity is the most likely explanation for observed borrowing choices as alternatives require implausible non-mortgage borrowing costs or household preferences. I develop a dynamic consumption-savings model and show that underlying preferences can generate the observed payment sensitivity only if borrowers initially have a high marginal utility of cash-on-hand that coincidentally and sharply falls by more than 50% in a narrow time window after loan origination. Payment sensitivity has important implications for regulation and policy. Lenders can manipulate loan features and shroud increases in total costs from payment sensitive borrowers, even while keeping fixed or even decreasing recurring payments. This type of shrouding could enable excessive borrowing and attenuate the transmission of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现抵押贷款借款人对定期还款金额（而非贷款总成本）更为敏感，这种支付敏感性可能导致借款人被误导并过度借贷，影响货币政策传导。

title: International Spillovers of Conventional versus Unconventional U.S. Monetary Policy
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: International Spillovers of Conventional versus Unconventional U.S. Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the international spillovers of conventional and unconventional U.S. monetary policy for a diverse set of 44 countries. A two-stage empirical approach is considered, first using country-specific structural vector autoregressions to isolate U.S. monetary policy shocks and estimate their dynamic effects on other economies. In the second stage, cross-country regressions are used to identify the structural characteristics that drive the heterogeneity in these spillovers. The results reveal a clear dichotomy: conventional U.S. monetary policy spills over primarily through trade-related channels, with its impact shaped by a country’s participation in global value chains. In contrast, unconventional policy is transmitted mainly through financial channels, with a country’s degree of financial openness being the most critical determinant of its vulnerability. While conventional U.S. monetary policy tightening typically causes currencies to appreciate, unconventional tightening leads to widespread depreciation. It is implied that the specific tool used by the Federal Reserve determines the primary channel of its international transmission, and financial openness significantly reduces monetary policy autonomy in the face of unconventional U.S. monetary policy shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国常规和非常规货币政策对44个国家的国际溢出效应，发现常规政策主要通过贸易渠道传播，而非常规政策主要通过金融渠道传播，金融开放度是决定溢出效应异质性的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 美国常规和非常规货币政策如何通过不同渠道对其他国家产生国际溢出效应？哪些结构性特征决定了这些溢出效应的异质性？
AI.motivation: 理解美国货币政策变化对全球经济的传导机制，特别是区分常规和非常规政策的不同溢出渠道，有助于各国制定更有效的应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际货币政策传导理论，区分贸易渠道和金融渠道的传导机制，结合全球价值链和金融开放度的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用两阶段实证方法：第一阶段使用国别结构性向量自回归模型识别美国货币政策冲击并估计动态效应；第二阶段使用跨国回归分析识别驱动溢出效应异质性的结构性特征。
AI.findings: 1) 常规货币政策主要通过贸易渠道溢出，受全球价值链参与度影响；2) 非常规货币政策主要通过金融渠道溢出，金融开放度是关键决定因素；3) 常规紧缩导致货币升值，非常规紧缩导致普遍贬值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分了常规和非常规货币政策的不同国际传导渠道，建立了金融开放度与货币政策自主性之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行提供了应对美国货币政策冲击的政策建议，特别是金融开放度较高的国家需要关注非常规货币政策带来的风险。

title: How Mutual Fund Managers and Investors Respond to U.S.-China Geopolitical Risk
affiliations: University of Connecticut - Department of Finance

detail.title: How Mutual Fund Managers and Investors Respond to U.S.-China Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: This paper examines how mutual fund managers and investors respond to U.S.–China geopolitical risk. I construct a novel bilateral geopolitical risk index from White House press briefings and develop a measure that isolates fund managers’ active reallocation decisions from fund flows and price movements. When risk rises, U.S. managers reduce allocations to Chinese equities, reallocate from Asia high- to low-risk regions, and shift domestic holdings toward firms with lower exposure to China. Chinese managers pull back from local markets but maintain U.S. exposure. These responses are more pronounced after 2018. U.S. mutual fund investors are more sensitive to geopolitical risk than Chinese investors. The findings demonstrate geopolitical risk significantly influences international capital allocation. They also reveal heterogeneous responses across countries and investor types.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美中地缘政治风险对共同基金经理和投资者的影响，发现美国基金经理会减少对中国股票的投资并重新配置资产，而中国基金经理则从本地市场撤资但保持对美国市场的投资。美国投资者对地缘政治风险比中国投资者更敏感。
AI.research_question: 美中地缘政治风险如何影响共同基金经理和投资者的资本配置决策？
AI.motivation: 随着美中关系紧张局势加剧，理解地缘政治风险如何影响国际资本流动和投资决策变得日益重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治风险理论和国际资本配置理论，研究风险感知对投资行为的影响。
AI.method: 构建新颖的双边地缘政治风险指数（来自白宫新闻发布会），并开发衡量基金经理主动重新配置决策的方法，分离资金流动和价格变动的影响。
AI.findings: 当地缘政治风险上升时：1）美国基金经理减少对中国股票的配置，从亚洲高风险地区重新配置到低风险地区，并将国内持仓转向对中国敞口较低的公司；2）中国基金经理从本地市场撤资但保持对美国市场的投资；3）这些反应在2018年后更加明显；4）美国共同基金投资者比中国投资者对地缘政治风险更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了地缘政治风险显著影响国际资本配置，揭示了不同国家和投资者类型的异质性反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和基金经理提供了在地缘政治风险环境下的投资策略指导，帮助理解跨国投资决策的风险管理。

title: Risk as Excuses to Postpone Effort-Provision
affiliations: Nankai University

detail.title: Risk as Excuses to Postpone Effort-Provision
detail.abstract: The future is inherently more uncertain than the present. Existing literature has shown that people act impatiently or in a time-inconsistent manner at least partly because of their aversion to future risk.  While such intuition could be fully captured by standard economic models, the current paper proposes a novel mechanism in which risk preferences interact with intertemporal choices---individuals may use risk as an excuse to postpone effort-provision. In a pre-registered laboratory experiment, participants evaluate risky prospects of workloads for today and those for the next week. Compared to when the valuation decisions involve no intertemporal tradeoff, when they do, individuals act more averse to present risk and less averse to future risk. In other words, they take more present-oriented actions under the veil of risks. Such patterns are more salient for men, for more forward-looking individuals, and for those who do not answer all three questions correctly in the cognitive reflection test (CRT). However, we do not find similar patterns when outcomes are monetary payoffs. By contrast, using a wiggle room task, we are able to find evidence supporting excused-driven information avoidance for both effort and money.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，个体在间接选择中会以风险为借口延迟劳动付出，表现出对当前风险更避免而对未来风险更宽容的时间不一致性行为，这种效应在金钱奖励中不明显。
AI.research_question: 风险偏好如何与间接选择相互作用？个体是否会以风险为借口延迟劳动付出？
AI.motivation: 现有文献显示人们的时间不一致性行为部分因为对未来风险的误差，但标准经济模型无法完全解释这种机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险偏好与间接选择的交互作用理论，借口驱动的信息避免机制
AI.method: 预注册实验室实验，让参与者评估今天和下周的风险性工作负荷前景，使用计算反射测试(CRT)和派生任务
AI.findings: 在间接选择中，个体对当前风险更避免，对未来风险更宽容，由此产生现在偏向性行为；男性、更有前知性和CRT成绩较差的个体这种模式更明显；在金钱奖励中没有发现类似模式
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了风险偏好与间接选择相互作用的新机制，补充了标准经济模型的不足，为时间不一致性行为提供了新解释
AI.practical_contributions: 对于劳动力管理和个人决策行为有实践意义，帮助理解为什么人们在工作任务中容易延迟，而在金钱决策中这种现象不明显

title: Setting the Tree on Fire
affiliations: University of Iowa - Department of Finance, University of Wisconsin-Madison and University of Alabama - Department of Economics, Finance and Legal Studies

detail.title: Setting the Tree on Fire
detail.abstract: Financial reporting standards require property-casualty insurance companies to disclose year-by-year revisions of their estimated future claim payments. These revisions have been a source of inspiration for researchers, providing a unique resource to measure and investigate the opportunistic behavior of managers. The most widely used measure of managerial discretion in this literature is the reserve error-the difference between a firm's estimate of losses reported in the current period and a revised estimate reported in the future. This paper has three main objectives. First, we analyze the conditions necessary for the traditional reserve error estimate (TREE) to cleanly estimate managerial discretion. We find that these conditions are universally violated. Second, we investigate whether the properties of TREE threaten statistical inference about managerial discretion. Through simulation analysis, we find that using TREE leads to biased coefficients and potentially incorrect inferences about managerial discretion. Third, we propose a new measure of managerial discretion, FIRE , that is consistent with insurers' reserving practices and has none of TREE 's weaknesses.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了保险业估侧错误(TREE)作为经理自主权度量的问题，通过模拟分析证明其导致偏差估计和错误推断，并提出了新的量测方法FIRE来更准确地评估经理自主行为。
AI.research_question: 传统保险估侧错误(TREE)在作为经理自主权度量时的有效性和可靠性如何？如何改进这种测量方法？
AI.motivation: 财务报告标准要求财产损失保险公司抓露对未来赔付估计的年度修订，这些修计为研究人员提供了独特资源来测量和研究经理人的机会主义行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于保险估侧理论和经理自主权理论，重点关注估侧错误在衡量经理自主行为中的理论基础和实践适用性。
AI.method: 理论分析TREE测量的前提条件，通过模拟分析验证TREE导致的统计推断问题，并提出新的FIRE测量方法。
AI.findings: TREE测量的前提条件普遍被违反，使用TREE会导致偏差的系数估计和潜在的错误推断，而新提出的FIRE测量方法更符合保险业估侧实践且避免了TREE的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判性地分析了现有估侧错误测量的理论基础，为经理自主权度量方法论做出重要贡献，推动了相关理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更加准确可靠的FIRE测量方法，为保险业实务工作者、监管机构和投资者提供了更有效的经理自主行为评估工具，有助于提高保险业财务报告的质量。

title: Prepare the Umbrella Before It Rains: Transmission and Rescue Strategy of Extreme Climate Shocks via SIRS Model
affiliations: Shandong University of Finance and Economics, Shandong University of Finance and Economics and Shandong University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Prepare the Umbrella Before It Rains: Transmission and Rescue Strategy of Extreme Climate Shocks via SIRS Model
detail.abstract: Extreme climatic events have amplified in both frequency and intensity, exerting substantial impacts on socioeconomic development. In this paper, we investigate the propagation dynamics of extreme climate risks via the SIRS model which can capture the entire transmission process of climate risk contagion by employing simulation analysis. Our findings reveal that climate-induced shocks propagate dynamically through corporate networks, amplifying their systemic impacts. We demonstrate that post-disaster government relief can effectively curtail risk propagation, though its efficacy is contingent upon both intervention intensity and timing. Corporations establishing robust risk-mitigation frameworks prove superior in cost-effectiveness compared to governmental aid. By pioneering the application of SIRS modeling to climate risk transmission dynamics, this work advances theoretical frameworks in climate risk research while offering actionable insights for optimizing post-disaster rescue.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用SIRS模型分析极端气候风险在企业网络中的传播动态，发现政府灾后救援能有效遏制风险传播但效果取决于干预强度和时间点，企业建立风险缓解框架比政府援助更具成本效益

title: Productivity and Wedges: Economic Convergence and the Real Exchange Rate
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - Department of Economics, Keio University and University of Texas at Dallas

detail.title: Productivity and Wedges: Economic Convergence and the Real Exchange Rate

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper explores the relationship between economic growth and the real exchange rate, specifically focusing on the convergence in price levels in Eastern European countries. While these countries have had significant convergence in GDP per capita (relative to the EU average) since the 1990s, convergence in real exchange rates for these countries stalled after the EU crisis. Using a standard theoretical framework, we estimate the main drivers of real exchange rates and show that a combination of productivity growth (Balassa-Samuelson effects) and labor market distortions help explain real exchange rate trends. We develop a structural two-country model that provides a rich decomposition of the long run determinants of the real exchange rate. Simulations based on observed sectoral productivities and labor market wedges show that the model can accurately account for the historical path of Eastern European real exchange rates, both before and after the EU crisis.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨东欧国家经济增长与实际汇率的关系，发现GDP趋同但实际汇率趋同在欧盟危机后停滞，通过结构模型证明生产率增长和劳动力市场扭曲共同解释汇率趋势
AI.research_question: 东欧国家在经济增长趋同的同时，为何实际汇率趋同会在欧盟危机后出现停滞？
AI.motivation: 东欧国家自1990年代以来在人均GDP方面相对于欧盟平均水平显著趋同，但实际汇率的趋同进程在欧盟危机后停滞，这一现象需要理论解释
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于标准理论框架，结合Balassa-Samuelson效应（生产率增长影响）和劳动力市场扭曲理论
AI.method: 构建结构化的两国模型，基于观察到的部门生产率和劳动力市场楔子进行模拟分析
AI.findings: 模型能够准确解释东欧国家实际汇率的历史路径，包括欧盟危机前后的变化，证明生产率增长和劳动力市场扭曲是主要驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了实际汇率长期决定因素的丰富分解框架，深化了对Balassa-Samuelson效应和劳动力市场扭曲共同作用的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解东欧国家汇率变化提供理论依据，有助于预测和应对汇率趋同停滞问题

title: The Aftershock: The Impact of Budget Reductions at the U.S. National Institutes of Health on Research and Innovation
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Medical School, Harvard University - Harvard Medical School and Harvard University - Harvard Medical School

detail.title: The Aftershock: The Impact of Budget Reductions at the U.S. National Institutes of Health on Research and Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or patient data.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study was not a registered clinical trial.

detail.abstract:
Background: In 2025, the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH) faced an unprecedented 40% budget cut proposal. While unusually large, this proposal underscores a persistent problem: the U.S. biomedical research system is vulnerable to funding volatility, yet little is known about how different funding trajectories, such as cuts, stagnation, or subsequent restorations, might shape long-term biomedical innovation.

Objective: To estimate the long-term effects of NIH budget disruptions on biomedical innovation under funding cuts and budget restoration scenarios.

Methods: We developed a simulation model—BRIDGE (Biomedical Research Investment Dynamics and Growth Evaluation)—linking NIH funding to biomedical innovation, measured as the number of FDA-approved novel drugs, while capturing intermediate dynamics in NIH-funded research grants and workforce composition. Model inputs include 47 longitudinal datasets from 1995 to 2024. We simulated scenarios where NIH funding (1) grows with inflation, maintaining today’s purchasing power (baseline); (2) remains flat at 2025 nominal levels (no-increase); (3) is cut by 40% in 2026 and then grows only with inflation from that reduced base (cut); or (4) is cut by 40% in 2026 but is restored to the baseline trajectory starting in 2027 or 2030 (1-year or 4-year restore). Projections are reported through 2050.

Results: BRIDGE’s projections show that funding cuts lead to steep and lasting declines in novel drug development, as well as the research workforce, basic science research, and clinical trials. By 2050, relative to baseline, the cumulative number of FDA-approved novel drugs is projected to fall by 221 (9%, from 1,178) in the cut scenario, 97 (4%) in the no-increase scenario, 109 (5%) in the 1-year restore, and 157 (7%) in the 4-year restore. For the cut scenario, this reduction is equivalent to an estimated $0.53–$2.28 trillion in present-value economic losses (2025 USD), with proportionally smaller losses in the restoration scenarios. Other measures, including the number of principal investigators and NIH-supported basic science publications, also show prolonged disruption under all scenarios. Finally, to test the limits of system recovery, we simulated an aggressive growth scenario in which the current administration implements the sustained cut, but the next administration doubles the NIH budget in 2030. Even then, the cumulative number of FDA-approved drugs does not return to the baseline trajectory until nearly 2066, highlighting the inherent delays in rebuilding research capacity, training, and innovation pipelines, which make early funding cuts especially difficult to reverse.

Conclusion: Large-scale reductions in NIH funding can produce lasting disruptions across the biomedical research ecosystem. Similar inertia across the system means that delayed or partial funding recovery can leave enduring gaps, and later surges cannot readily compensate for earlier cuts. Scientific output is not immediately responsive to financial inputs but must be cultivated, retained, and protected over time. These findings highlight the importance of stable and predictable public investment in science to maintain national research infrastructure, public health, and global competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过BRIDGE模拟模型分析了NIH预算削减和恢复对生物医学创新的长期影响，发现40%的预算削减会导致新药开发、研究队伍和科学产出的持续下降，即使后续恢复资金也难以完全弥补损失，强调稳定科研投资的重要性。
AI.research_question: NIH预算中断（如削减、停滞或后续恢复）如何影响生物医学创新的长期发展？
AI.motivation: 美国生物医学研究系统面临资金波动风险，但不同资金轨迹对长期创新的影响尚不明确，特别是2025年NIH面临40%预算削减提案的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资-创新关联理论，建立资金投入与生物医学创新产出的动态关系模型，考虑研究资助、人力资源和科学产出的中间机制。
AI.method: 开发BRIDGE模拟模型，整合47个1995-2024年的纵向数据集，模拟四种资金情景（基线增长、名义持平、40%削减、1年/4年恢复），预测至2050年的新药批准数量等创新指标。
AI.findings: 40%资金削减导致到2050年累计新药减少221种（9%），造成0.53-2.28万亿美元经济损失；即使后续资金恢复，创新产出仍长期低于基线水平，系统恢复存在显著滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化验证生物医学创新系统对资金波动的非线性响应和路径依赖特性，揭示科研生态系统恢复的惯性特征和时间延迟机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供科学证据，强调稳定科研资金的重要性，警示预算削减的长期后果，支持维护国家科研基础设施和全球竞争力的投资决策。

title: Overlapping Generations Models, Multiplicity of Steady States and Momentary Equilibria, and Economic Fluctuations
affiliations: Royal Holloway, U of London and Center for Macroeconomics at the London School of Economics and the Canon Institute for Global Studies and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance

detail.title: Overlapping Generations Models, Multiplicity of Steady States and Momentary Equilibria, and Economic Fluctuations

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the simplest OLG models with capital accumulation, demonstrating three results that stand in marked contrast to those of the standard model: first, the possibility of multiple steady states; second, the possibility of multiple momentary equilibria under rational expectations; third, one of implications of multiple momentary equilibria is that dynamics may be marked by complex fluctuations (lacking even periodicity), but still within well-defined bounds. We provide quite general conditions (with general utility and production functions) under which in the simplest of OLG models, there can be multiple steady states, multiple momentary equilibria, and complex dynamics. Furthermore, we present a simple illustration of wobbly growth by incorporating credit friction.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文在简单OLG模型中证明与标准模型截然不同的三个结果：多重稳态、理性预期下的多重瞬时均衡，以及复杂波动动态的可能性。
AI.research_question: 在简单的世代交叠(OLG)资本积累模型中，是否存在多重稳态、多重瞬时均衡以及复杂动态行为的可能性？
AI.motivation: 标准OLG模型通常假设单一均衡和稳定动态，但现实经济中观察到复杂的波动现象，需要探索更一般的理论框架来解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世代交叠模型(OLG)理论、资本积累理论、理性预期理论、一般均衡理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用一般效用函数和生产函数，推导模型均衡条件和动态特性
AI.findings: 1) 在一般效用和生产函数条件下，简单OLG模型可能存在多重稳态；2) 理性预期下可能存在多重瞬时均衡；3) 动态过程可能表现出复杂波动（甚至缺乏周期性），但在有界范围内；4) 通过引入信贷摩擦可以说明不稳定的增长模式
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了OLG模型的理论边界，证明在更一般条件下存在多重均衡和复杂动态，为解释现实经济波动提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解经济波动、多重均衡现象以及信贷摩擦对增长稳定性的影响提供了理论依据，对宏观经济政策制定具有启示意义

title: Inside (the) Money Machine

detail.title: Inside (the) Money Machine

keywords: Fiscal Theory of the Price Level

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The key function of banks in the real world is endogenously creating (inside) money. But they do so facing solvency, liquidity and maturity risks and being subject to regulatory and demand constraints. These five aspects, representing the eventual breaks on banks’ money-creation abilities, are tightly and nonlinearly interlinked. Yet, there is no tractable quantitative macro framework that models endogenous money creation while simultaneously addressing these interlinkages. In this paper we develop a tractable macro-banking model trying to fill this gap, emphasizing two key frictions: the capital adequacy constraint (generating a credit risk premium) and the central bank’s collateral base constraint (generating a liquidity risk premium). The model simulations produce conclusions, about both normal times as well as stress episodes, many of which were frequently overlooked. For instance, it shows how – within capital requirements – setting lower risk weights on secured loans may lead to an expansion of unsecured loans. It also reveals subtle interactions between capital and liquidity regulations. The model also creates a certain bridge between a money-centered view of the price level and the fiscal theory of the price level.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个可操作的宏观银行学模型，通过同时考虑资本充足性约束和流动性约束两个关键摸扬，来模拟银行内生创造资金的过程以及其与解约风险、流动性风险等五大因素的复杂交互关系。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个可操作的宏观模型，同时考虑银行内生创造资金的过程以及解约风险、流动性风险、期限风险、监管约束和需求约束这五大因素之间的复杂交互关系？
AI.motivation: 虽然银行在现实世界中的核心功能是内生创造资金，但当前缺乏一个可操作的宏观框架能够同时模拟这种资金创造过程以及解约风险、流动性风险、期限风险、监管约束和需求约束这五大限制因素之间的复杂非线性交互关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行内生资金创造理论、解约风险理论、流动性风险理论、监管宏观谨慎政策理论，以及资金中心视角的物价水平理论与财政物价理论的融合。
AI.method: 建立了一个可操作的宏观银行学模型，重点考虑两个关键摸扬：资本充足性约束（产生信贷风险贵席）和中央银行抵押物基础约束（产生流动性风险贵席），通过模型模拟来分析正常时期和压力时期的各种细微交互效应。
AI.findings: 模型模拟发现了许多以前常被忽视的结论，例如：在资本要求范围内，设置较低的有抵押贷款风险权重可能导致无抵押贷款的扩张；还发现了资本监管与流动性监管之间的细微交互作用；同时在资金中心视角的物价水平理论与财政物价理论之间建立了某种联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个能够同时模拟银行内生资金创造和五大限制因素复杂交互关系的可操作宏观框架，填补了现有理论的空白；在资金中心视角和财政物价理论之间建立了理论联系，推动了物价理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了一个分析工具，能够预测监管政策变化的复杂影响，包括风险权重设置对不同类型贷款的间接影响，以及资本和流动性监管之间的交互作用，有助于制定更有效的宏观谨慎政策。

title: Superstar Firms through the Generations
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Notre Dame - Department of Economics, London Business School and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: Superstar Firms through the Generations

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We present new facts about the largest American companies over the past century. In manufacturing, top firms in the 1910s, 1950s, and 2010s predominantly date back to around 1900. Even as this special generation persists, turnover among top firms has been substantial. In contrast, in retail and wholesale, we do not observe a special generation among top firms. We show in a model of firm dynamics that a special generation can arise from an industrial revolution, through the adoption of a scalable technology and learning-by-doing. Top firm turnover is matched by standard idiosyncratic productivity shocks. Time-varying market size growth rates or entry costs are not sufficient to explain the facts. Among retailers and wholesalers, learning appears absent, so a special generation would be harder to sustain. Our results highlight the potential for lasting nonstationarity among the dynamics of top firms, which can result from the long echoes of technological change.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现美国制造业顶级企业在过去一个世纪中具有特殊的代际持续性，主要起源于1900年左右的技术革命，而零售批发业则没有这种现象。通过企业动态模型分析，表明工业革命带来的可扩展技术和干中学效应是造成这种特殊代际现象的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 美国顶级企业在过去一个世纪中的代际持续性模式及其形成机制是什么？为什么制造业和零售批发业在这方面存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 理解顶级企业长期动态变化模式，探究技术革命如何影响企业代际结构，以及不同行业间企业持续性差异的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业动态理论、工业革命理论、学习曲线理论、生产率冲击模型
AI.method: 历史数据分析（1910s-2010s美国最大企业数据）、理论建模（企业动态模型）、对比分析（制造业vs零售批发业）
AI.findings: 1) 制造业顶级企业在1910s、1950s和2010s主要起源于1900年左右，存在特殊代际持续性；2) 零售批发业没有观察到类似特殊代际现象；3) 工业革命通过可扩展技术和干中学效应产生特殊代际；4) 标准生产率冲击能够解释顶级企业更替
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了企业代际持续性的新理论解释；2) 建立了技术革命与企业动态关系的理论框架；3) 揭示了不同行业企业持续性差异的内在机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业长期战略制定提供历史借鉴；2) 为政策制定者理解产业结构演变提供参考；3) 为投资者评估企业长期价值提供新视角

title: Serial Acquisitions in Tech
affiliations: University of Maryland - Department of Economics, Boston University - Questrom School of Business, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) - Lally School of Management and University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Serial Acquisitions in Tech

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We examine serial acquisitions in the technology sector from 2010 to 2023. Defining serial acquisitions based on a granular S&P industry taxonomy, we find that they account for 24–37% of majority-control tech M&A, with over half completed by public firms. Followon targets in a series are generally larger and older than the initial acquisition, and among public acquirers, starting a series is associated with higher market value and greater innovation value, but not with significant changes in market competitiveness. Among deals with valid transaction values, over half of serial deals exceed the reporting threshold of the U.S. Hart–Scott–Rodino (HSR) Act. However, in below-threshold acquisitions, acquirers primarily target their core business category. Accounting for the cumulative value of a series would, in most cases, keep the timing of HSR review unchanged or modestly accelerate it, but when it does accelerate it, review could occur several deals or years earlier, potentially yielding important benefits in markets with long acquisition sequences. Finally, while Google/Alphabet, Amazon, Facebook/Meta, Apple and Microsoft (GAFAM) stand out from the rest of the sample for more frequent serial acquisitions, some other large acquirers display similar patterns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2010-2023年科技行业的连续收购行为，发现连续收购占多数控股科技并购的24-37%，后续收购目标通常比首次收购更大更成熟。研究还探讨了HSR法案审查门槛对连续收购的影响，以及GAFAM等大型收购方的收购模式。
AI.research_question: 科技行业连续收购的特征、模式及其对反垄断监管（特别是HSR法案）的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解科技行业连续收购的普遍性、特征和模式，以及现有反垄断监管框架（如HSR法案）是否能够有效应对这种收购策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于并购理论、反垄断经济学和战略管理理论，特别是关于连续收购、市场集中度和创新竞争的相关理论。
AI.method: 使用2010-2023年科技行业并购数据，基于S&P行业分类定义连续收购，采用定量分析方法研究收购模式、目标特征和监管影响。
AI.findings: 1) 连续收购占科技并购的24-37%；2) 后续收购目标比首次更大更成熟；3) 公开公司开始连续收购与更高市值和创新能力相关；4) HSR法案审查门槛调整对审查时机影响有限；5) GAFAM等大型公司连续收购频率更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对科技行业连续收购模式的理解，为并购理论和反垄断经济学提供了新的实证证据，特别是关于连续收购对市场竞争和创新的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构（如FTC）提供了政策建议，指出HSR法案在应对连续收购时的局限性，并提出了基于累计价值的审查框架改进方案。

title: Mobile Phones and Gender Norms: Evidence from Afghanistan
affiliations: Cornell University, Georgia Institute of Technology - School of Economics and University of West Georgia

detail.title: Mobile Phones and Gender Norms: Evidence from Afghanistan
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of mobile phone expansion on gender norms in Afghanistan. We combine cell tower data from the country's largest operator with nationally representative survey data on attitudes toward women's education, employment, and leadership. Using lightning strike intensity as an instrument for network expansion, we find that greater mobile access significantly improved attitudes toward women's education and employment, particularly among men. Women's support for female leadership also increased while men's stated views did not change. We explore information and labor supply channels as potential mechanisms driving these effects. We find little evidence for a labor market participation channel, suggesting that information access-both direct and via networks-is more likely to explain the observed attitudinal changes. While we find no downstream effects on women's schooling or employment participation, mobile expansion increased votes for female candidates, the number of women running, and the share elected to office. These results suggest that expanding access to mobile technology can weaken restrictive gender norms even in settings facing strong cultural constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文通过闪电强度作为工具变量，研究发现手机网络扩张显著改善了阿富汗民众对女性教育和就业的态度，特别是男性态度改善明显。虽然未发现对女性实际教育和就业参与的下游影响，但增加了女性候选人的得票率、参选人数和当选比例。
AI.research_question: 手机网络扩张如何影响阿富汗的性别规范？
AI.motivation: 在阿富汗这样文化约束强烈的环境中，了解移动技术普及是否能改变限制性性别规范具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息获取理论和网络效应理论，探讨信息渠道和劳动力供给渠道的作用机制
AI.method: 使用闪电强度作为手机网络扩张的工具变量，结合运营商基站数据和全国代表性调查数据进行分析
AI.findings: 手机接入显著改善了对女性教育和就业的态度（特别是男性），增加了对女性领导力的支持，提高了女性候选人的选举表现，但未发现对女性实际教育和就业参与的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了即使在强文化约束环境下，信息技术仍能通过信息渠道改变性别态度规范
AI.practical_contributions: 为在传统社会中通过移动技术推广性别平等提供了政策依据，显示了信息获取在改变社会规范中的重要作用

title: Openness and Growth: A Comparison of the Experiences of China and Mexico
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis and University of Minnesota

detail.title: Openness and Growth: A Comparison of the Experiences of China and Mexico

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In the late 1980s, Mexico opened itself to international trade and foreign investment, followed in the early 1990s by China. China and Mexico are still the two countries characterized as middle-income by the World Bank with the highest levels of merchandise exports. Although their measures of openness have been comparable, these two countries have had sharply different economic performances: China has achieved spectacular growth, whereas Mexico’s growth has been disappointingly modest. In this article, we extend the analysis of Kehoe and Ruhl (2010) to account for the differences in these experiences. We show that China opened its economy while it was still achieving rapid growth from shifting employment out of agriculture and into manufacturing while Mexico opened long after its comparable phase of structural transformation. China is only now catching up with Mexico in terms of GDP per working-age person, and it still lags behind in terms of the fraction of its population engaged in agriculture. Furthermore, we argue that China has been able to move up a ladder of quality and technological sophistication in the composition of its exports and production, while Mexico seems to be stuck exporting a fixed set of products to its North American neighbors.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了中国和墨西哥在贸易开放后的不同经济增长表现，发现中国在开放时正处于农业向制造业转型阶段，能够实现产业升级和出口质量提升，而墨西哥开放时已错过结构转型期，导致增长停滞。
AI.research_question: 为什么中国和墨西哥在相似的贸易开放度下，经济增长表现却存在巨大差异？
AI.motivation: 中国和墨西哥都是中等收入国家中出口规模最大的两个国家，贸易开放度相似但经济增长表现截然不同，中国实现了快速增长而墨西哥增长缓慢，需要解释这种差异的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kehoe和Ruhl(2010)的分析框架，结合结构转型理论和出口质量阶梯理论，分析不同发展阶段实施贸易开放政策的效果差异。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，通过对比中国和墨西哥在贸易开放时机、产业结构转型阶段、出口产品构成和技术复杂度等方面的差异来解释经济增长差异。
AI.findings: 1)中国在农业向制造业转型阶段开放经济，获得了结构转型红利；2)墨西哥开放时已错过结构转型期；3)中国实现了出口产品质量和技术复杂度升级；4)墨西哥出口产品结构固化，主要面向北美市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了贸易开放与经济增长关系的理论，强调了开放时机与结构转型阶段的匹配重要性，提出了"开放时机窗口"理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定贸易开放政策提供了重要启示，强调应在结构转型阶段适时开放经济，并注重出口产品质量升级和多元化。

title: Non-Cooperative Game-Based Optimization for Microgrid Scheduling Oriented to Vehicle–Grid Coordination
affiliations: Hohai University, Hohai University and Hohai University

detail.title: Non-Cooperative Game-Based Optimization for Microgrid Scheduling Oriented to Vehicle–Grid Coordination
detail.abstract: With the continuous growth in the number of electric vehicles (EVs), their participation in microgrid scheduling has become an important means to enhance renewable energy utilization and ensure system stability. This paper proposes a microgrid scheduling strategy for EV participation based on a general non-cooperative game, in which a twoplayer game model is established between EV owners and microgrid operators, aiming to minimize charging–discharging costs and load fluctuations, respectively. To address the resulting multi-objective optimization problem, an improved Harris Hawks Optimization (IHHO) algorithm—incorporating an adaptive energy factor and a hybrid local search strategy—is developed to obtain the mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method not only effectively reduces the operating costs for EV owners, but also significantly improves microgrid load balancing and renewable energy consumption, achieving both economic efficiency and operational coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于非合作博弈的电动汽车参与微电网调度策略，建立车主与运营商的双人博弈模型，采用改进的哈里斯鹰优化算法求解纳什均衡，有效降低运营成本并提升可再生能源消纳。
AI.research_question: 如何通过博弈论方法优化电动汽车参与微电网调度，实现车主成本最小化和系统负荷波动的平衡？
AI.motivation: 随着电动汽车数量持续增长，其参与微电网调度成为提高可再生能源利用率和保障系统稳定性的重要手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非合作博弈理论，建立电动汽车车主与微电网运营商之间的双人博弈模型。
AI.method: 采用改进的哈里斯鹰优化算法（IHHO），融入自适应能量因子和混合局部搜索策略，求解多目标优化问题的混合策略纳什均衡。
AI.findings: 仿真结果表明，所提方法能有效降低电动汽车车主运营成本，显著改善微电网负荷平衡和可再生能源消纳能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于非合作博弈的微电网调度理论框架，提出了改进的优化算法求解博弈均衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车参与微电网调度提供了实用的优化策略，实现了经济效益与运行协调的双重目标。

title: Causal Inference-Driven Framework for Source Verification: Integrating PMF, Health Risk Assessment, and Spatialized Emission Inventories, and in Multi-source Composite Heavy Metal Soil Pollution
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Ministry of Ecology and Environment and Ministry of Ecology and Environment

detail.title: Causal Inference-Driven Framework for Source Verification: Integrating PMF, Health Risk Assessment, and Spatialized Emission Inventories, and in Multi-source Composite Heavy Metal Soil Pollution
detail.abstract: Soil heavy metal pollution in industrialized regions poses significant health risks and management challenges due to its complex source composition and nonlinear source-receptor relationships. This study establishes a novel framework integrating Positive Matrix Factorization (PMF), health risk assessment, spatialized emission inventories, and Geographical Convergent Cross Mapping (GCCM) to prioritize soil heavy metal pollution control in complex industrial regions. Focusing on a mining city in Yunnan, China, 460 soil samples were analyzed for As, Pb, Cd, Zn, and Ni. PMF identified 4 pollution sources, with health risk assessment highlighting As as the priority pollutant. High-resolution spatialized emission inventories reveal distinct spatiotemporal patterns among different pollution sources, with their emission hotspots showing substantial overlap with soil contamination areas. This indicates a multi-source composite pollution pattern and the presence of complex pollution formation mechanisms in the study area. The GCCM analysis identified unidirectional causal relationships between smelting emissions and soil arsenic (As) concentrations (ρ=0.456, p<0.01), surpassing the effectiveness of Pearson correlation and geographically weighted regression in capturing nonlinear source-receptor linkages. This study demonstrates causal emission-contamination links, enabling accurate, economically scalable soil pollution remediation for industrial regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种整合PMF、健康风险评估、空间化排放清单和GCCM的新框架，通过识别燃炼排放与土壤硅污染间的因果关系，为复杂工业区域土壤重金属污染控制提供了准确且经济可扩展的修复方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在复杂工业区域中准确识别土壤重金属污染的主要源头，并优先重点控制对人体健康风险最大的污染源？
AI.motivation: 工业化地区土壤重金属污染源处复杂、源-污染关系非线性，导致健康风险和管理挑战，需要新方法来优先控制污染。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合正矩矩阵因子解(PMF)、健康风险评估、高分辨率空间化排放清单和地理收敛交叉映射(GCCM)理论，用于处理复杂源污染模式和非线性源-污染关系。
AI.method: 在云南某矿业城市收集460个土壤样品，分析As、Pb、Cd、Zn、Ni各重金属污染物。使用PMF识别污染源，健康风险评伍优先污染物，通过空间化排放清单和GCCM分析源-污染因果关系。
AI.findings: PMF识别4个污染源，As为优先控制污染物。排放热点区与污染区域重叠，显示多源复合污染模式。GCCM证实燃炼排放与土壤As浓度存在单向因果关系(ρ=0.456, p<0.01)，效果超过皮尔透相关和地理加权回归。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种能够够捕捉复杂工业区域非线性源-污染关系的新框架，将GCCM方法应用于环境污染源识别领域，为环境管理提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂工业区域土壤重金属污染控制提供了准确识别主要污染源的方法，能够按照健康风险优先重点控制，实现经济可扩展的污染修复方案。

title: E Pluribus Unum: AI-assisted Consensus Building
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, University of Rome Tor Vergata, Department of Economics and Finance, Students, Independent and Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS)

detail.title: E Pluribus Unum: AI-assisted Consensus Building

declarations.ethicsApproval: The paper uses survey data in anonymous way with the consent of participants whose identity cannot in any case be identified by empirical evidence presented in the paper

detail.abstract: This study explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) to foster political consensus by simulating deliberation among AI-generated virtual citizens. We construct a virtual sample mimicking the Italian population and initiate iterative AI-led debates on politically divisive issuesmigration, environmental transition, and economic inequality. The process yields high-consensus statements among AI personas, which are then validated by administering them to a representative real-people sample. Our findings show that AI-derived statements among virtual citizens increase agreement rates among humans by more than 37 percentage points over initial seed statements, while policies inspired by them raise support by more than 25 percentage points. We find mild evidence that making AI authorship explicit slightly reduces consensus for some demographic groups, revealing a modest AI-aversion effect. Our findings contribute to the debate on pros and cons of AI by showing that the virtual consensus-building framework offers a scalable, efficient alternative to traditional human deliberation, providing actionable insights for policy design and digital democracy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了大型语言模型通过AI生成的虚拟公民进行模拟审议来促进政治共识的潜力。研究发现AI生成的共识声明能够将人类同意率提高37个百分点以上，相关政策支持率提高25个百分点以上，但AI作者身份披露会轻微降低共识。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否通过模拟虚拟公民审议来促进政治共识？
AI.motivation: 探索AI在政治共识构建中的潜力，为传统人类审议提供可扩展、高效的替代方案
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字民主理论、AI辅助决策理论、共识构建理论
AI.method: 构建模拟意大利人口的虚拟样本，进行AI主导的迭代辩论，然后对真实人群样本进行验证
AI.findings: AI生成的共识声明使人类同意率提高37%以上，政策支持率提高25%以上；AI作者身份披露会轻微降低共识
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了虚拟共识构建框架，拓展了AI在政治协商中的应用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策设计和数字民主提供了可操作的见解，展示了AI辅助共识构建的实际可行性

title: Modeling Hidden Variables in Technological Economics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Modeling Hidden Variables in Technological Economics
detail.abstract: Technological markets are often analyzed through visible metrics such as revenue, user growth, and innovation output. However, these indicators fail to capture the latent forces that shape strategic decisions and market behavior. Inspired by Einstein's hidden variable theory in quantum physics, this paper proposes a wave-based model to represent hidden organizational intent and cultural shifts within tech companies. By combining observable growth functions with sinusoidal hidden components, we demonstrate how unexpected market behaviors can be mathematically modeled and philosophically interpreted.

AI.tldr: 本文受爱因斯坦隐藏变量理论启发，提出波动模型来形容科技公司的隐藏组织意图和文化变迁，通过结合可观测量与正弦隐藏分量来建模和解释意外市场行为。
AI.research_question: 如何建立数学模型来描述和预测科技市场中由隐藏组织因素引起的意外行为？
AI.motivation: 现有市场分析指标（如收益、用户增长、创新输出）无法抓取影响科技公司战略决策和市场行为的潜在力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 爱因斯坦隐藏变量理论、波动模型、组织意图理论、组织文化变迁理论
AI.method: 结合可观增长函数与正弦隐藏分量的数学建模方法
AI.findings: 意外市场行为可以通过数学模型进行形容和哲学解释，隐藏组织因素在形成市场行为中起关键作用
AI.theory_contributions: 将物理学隐藏变量理论扩展到经济学和管理学领域，提供分析科技市场潜在动力的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为科技公司提供新的战略分析工具，帮助预测和理解市场中的意外变化和行为模式

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 871/2025
title: Sustainability Assurance
affiliations: Bocconi University - Bocconi Law Department, Bocconi University and University of Washington

detail.title: Sustainability Assurance

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 871/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
A robust literature examines sustainability disclosures by public corporations, but legal scholarship has largely overlooked the role of third-party assurance—or verification—of such disclosures. This is a notable omission given the extensive literature on the auditing of financial statements, a related form of assurance.

This article responds by examining the role of assurance in sustainability reporting. In keeping with the theme of this symposium volume, it draws on US and EU law. Our discussion begins in Part I with sustainability disclosures, focusing on the requirements and practices of public companies. In Part II, we introduce sustainability assurance as well as assurance providers (or sustainability assurers)—a type of green gatekeeper that assures the accuracy of sustainability information. In Part III, we assess the market mechanisms that may constrain assurance providers, arguing that these mechanisms—reputational incentives, for the most part—may fail to prevent false sustainability assurances and will be less effective than those that constrain traditional gatekeepers, including auditors. We also generally examine the strength of primary regulation of sustainability claims. In Part IV, we sketch some considerations relevant to determining how policymakers should respond on the premise that regulation is justified.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了可持续发展报告中的第三方鉴证（验证）作用，指出法律学术研究长期忽视这一领域，与财务报表审计研究形成鲜明对比。文章分析了市场机制对可持续发展鉴证提供者的约束力不足，并提出了政策应对建议。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展报告中的第三方鉴证（保证）在法律监管和市场机制方面存在哪些问题？政策制定者应如何应对？
AI.motivation: 现有法律学术研究主要关注企业可持续发展披露本身，但忽视了第三方鉴证这一重要环节，而财务报表审计已有大量研究，这种研究空白需要填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于守门人理论（gatekeeper theory）和声誉激励机制理论，将可持续发展鉴证提供者视为"绿色守门人"，与传统审计师进行对比分析。
AI.method: 采用比较法律分析方法，结合美国和欧盟的法律框架，通过理论推演和机制分析来探讨问题。
AI.findings: 市场机制（主要是声誉激励）可能无法有效防止虚假的可持续发展鉴证，其约束效果不如传统守门人（如审计师）的约束机制；主要监管对可持续发展声明的监管力度也存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将守门人理论扩展到可持续发展鉴证领域，提出了"绿色守门人"概念，丰富了企业社会责任和可持续发展报告的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监管建议，指出了当前监管体系的不足，并提出了改进方向，有助于提升可持续发展报告的可信度和有效性。

title: Fast Reliable Pricing and Calibration of the Rough Heston Model
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics, Deutsche Bank and Calico Science Consulting

detail.title: Fast Reliable Pricing and Calibration of the Rough Heston Model
detail.abstract: The paper is an extended and modified version of the preprint S.Boyarchenko and S.Levendorski ȋ "Correct implied volatility shapes and reliable pricing in the rough Heston model". We combine a modification of the Adams method with the SINH-acceleration method S. Boyarchenko and S. Levendorskii (IJTAF 2019, v. 22) of Fourier inversion (iFT) to price vanilla options under the rough Heston model. For moderate or long maturities and strikes near spot, thousands of prices are computed in several milliseconds (ms) in Matlab on a Mac with moderate specs, with relative errors 10-4. Even for options close to expiry and far-OTM, the pricing takes a few tens or hundreds of ms. We show that, for the calibrated parameters in El Euch and Rosenbaum (Math. Finance 2019, v. 29), the model implied vol surface is much flatter and fits the market data poorly; thus the calibration in op. cit. is a case of "ghost calibration" (M. Boyarchenko and S. Levendorskii, Quant. Finance 2015, v. 15): numerical error and model specification error offset each other, creating an apparently good fit that vanishes when a more accurate pricer is used. We explain how such errors arise in popular iFT implementations that use fixed numerical parameters, yielding spurious smiles/skews, and provide numerical evidence that SINH acceleration is faster and more accurate than competing methods. Robust error control is ensured by a general Conformal Bootstrap principle that we formulate; the principle is applicable to many Fourierpricing methods. We outline how this principle and our method enable accurate calibration procedures that are hundreds of times faster than approaches commonly used in the industry. Disclaimer: The views expressed herein are those of the authors only. No other representation should be attributed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合改进Adams方法和SINH加速傅里叶逆变换的高效定价方法，用于粗糙Heston模型下的期权定价，计算速度极快且精度高，揭示了先前校准存在的'幽灵校准'问题，并提出了稳健误差控制的保形自举原则。
AI.research_question: 如何在粗糙Heston模型下实现快速准确的期权定价，并解决现有校准方法中的数值误差问题？
AI.motivation: 现有粗糙Heston模型的定价方法存在计算效率低和数值精度不足的问题，导致校准结果不可靠，出现'幽灵校准'现象（数值误差与模型设定误差相互抵消造成虚假的良好拟合）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于粗糙Heston模型，结合改进的Adams数值方法和SINH加速傅里叶逆变换技术，提出保形自举原则作为误差控制的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用改进的Adams方法与SINH加速傅里叶逆变换相结合的计算方法，在Matlab平台上实现高效定价，并通过数值实验验证方法的准确性和效率。
AI.findings: 新方法计算速度极快（数千个价格在几毫秒内完成），相对误差达到10^-4；发现先前校准参数产生的隐含波动率曲面过于平坦，与市场数据拟合差，证实了'幽灵校准'现象的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了保形自举原则作为傅里叶定价方法的通用误差控制框架；建立了SINH加速方法在精度和速度上的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了比行业常用方法快数百倍的精确校准流程；为金融实务提供了可靠且高效的定价工具，避免了虚假的市场拟合结果。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute – Finance Working Paper No. 1086/2025
title: Biodiversity and Earnings News: When Nature Meets Numbers
affiliations: McMaster University - Michael G. DeGroote School of Business, Schulich School of Business, York University, Australian National University - Research School of Accounting and Zhejiang University - School of Management

detail.title: Biodiversity and Earnings News: When Nature Meets Numbers

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute – Finance Working Paper No. 1086/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Finance Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Biodiversity loss is increasingly recognized as a material financial risk, yet its governance implications for capital markets remain underexplored. We examine whether corporate biodiversity exposure (CBE), defined as the extent to which a firm’s polluting facilities are located near conservation-priority areas, impairs the market’s interpretation of earnings news. We argue that CBE generates location-based interpretive frictions that weaken the information content of earnings announcements. Consistent with this prediction, firms with higher CBE exhibit significantly weaker earnings response coefficients, indicating reduced earnings informativeness. Exploiting the staggered expansion of protected areas, a stacked difference-in-differences design establishes causality. The magnitude of this effect varies systematically with governance institutions: it is amplified in institutional settings that heighten ecological and regulatory uncertainty, such as states with weaker species protection, lower biodiversity ratings, non-attainment air quality designations, limited biodiversity-related media coverage, or low population density. In contrast, it is mitigated at the firm level where stronger information environments, supported by biodiversity disclosure, institutional ownership, analyst coverage, media attention, or NGO activism, reduce interpretation costs. Overall, our findings reveal a distinct informational channel through which biodiversity exposure constrains price discovery and underscore the role of governance and disclosure in managing nature-related financial risks.

AI.tldr: 企业生物多样性暴露（CBE）会通过位置性解释摩擦降低盈余信息含量，导致盈余反应系数减弱，这种效应在生态和监管不确定性高的制度环境中更显著，但可以通过信息披露和治理机制缓解。
AI.research_question: 企业生物多样性暴露是否会影响市场对盈余信息的解读？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性丧失日益被视为重要的金融风险，但其对资本市场的治理影响尚未得到充分探索
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置性解释摩擦理论、信息不对称理论、制度理论
AI.method: 采用堆叠双重差分设计，利用保护区扩张的自然实验建立因果关系，分析盈余反应系数
AI.findings: 高CBE企业表现出显著较弱的盈余反应系数，表明盈余信息含量降低；这种效应在生态监管不确定性高的地区更明显，但可通过信息披露和治理机制缓解
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生物多样性风险通过信息渠道影响价格发现的独特机制，拓展了环境风险与资本市场信息效率的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者管理自然相关金融风险提供了实证依据，强调了生物多样性披露和治理机制的重要性

title: Adaptive Management in the Context of Organizational Uncertainty
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Adaptive Management in the Context of Organizational Uncertainty
detail.abstract: In today's volatile business environment, organizations increasingly face uncertainty stemming from rapid technological advancements, shifting market dynamics, and global disruptions. Adaptive management emerges as a critical approach to navigating such uncertainty, emphasizing flexibility, learning, and iterative decision-making. This paper explores the principles of adaptive management and its application in organizational contexts characterized by unpredictability. It highlights how adaptive strategies enable organizations to respond proactively to change, minimize risks, and maintain competitiveness. Through theoretical insights and practical considerations, this study underscores the importance of adaptability as a core managerial competence in the 21st century.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在不确定性环境中适应性管理的重要性，强调其通过灵活性、学习和迭代决策来帮助组织应对变化、降低风险并保持竞争力。
AI.research_question: 适应性管理如何帮助组织在不确定的商业环境中有效应对变化并保持竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 当今商业环境日益动荡，技术快速进步、市场动态变化和全球性干扰导致组织面临前所未有的不确定性，需要新的管理方法来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性管理理论，强调灵活性、持续学习和迭代决策过程的管理理念。
AI.method: 理论分析和实践考量相结合的研究方法，通过理论洞察和实际应用案例来探讨适应性管理的有效性。
AI.findings: 适应性管理策略使组织能够主动应对变化，最小化风险，并在动荡环境中保持竞争力，适应性成为21世纪核心管理能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对适应性管理理论的理解，明确了其在不确定性环境中的理论价值和实践意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了应对不确定性的实用框架和策略，帮助企业在快速变化的环境中制定有效的管理决策。

title: Humanitarian Immigration Programs of the United States
affiliations: University of Oklahoma - College of Law

detail.title: Humanitarian Immigration Programs of the United States
detail.abstract: Millions of vulnerable noncitizens, from all corners of the globe, have benefitted from the United States’ varied humanitarian immigration programs. They have traveled to the United States by air from refugee camps in Africa and walked to the U.S. border from South America to escape persecution and obtain protection from the United States under the programs outlined in Part 1. Within the United States, noncitizen survivors of family violence have fled their abusive households and been protected by the country’s immigration laws discussed in Part 2. The United States has worked to alleviate the suffering of noncitizen victims of sex and labor trafficking as well as noncitizen victims of certain crimes committed within the United States by opening the immigration pathways considered in Part 3. Sometimes, the relief provided by the United States is temporary rather than permanent. For example, noncitizens can come to the United States on a temporary basis for medical treatment unavailable in their home countries, as discussed in Parts 3 and 4. A noncitizen can also be allowed within U.S. borders to pursue a claim for asylum, as addressed in Part 4. Finally, the United States has developed an immigration program with an eye not toward individuals in need of care, but toward countries in crisis. Part 4 details the circumstances under which the United States allows certain noncitizens to remain stateside when their respective home nations simply cannot cope with their return due to natural disaster or war.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了美国为全球各地弱势非公民提供的多种人道主义移民项目，包括难民保护、家庭暴力受害者庇护、人口贩卖受害者救助、医疗临时居留、庇护申请以及针对危机国家的特殊移民计划。
AI.research_question: 美国为弱势非公民提供了哪些类型的人道主义移民保护项目？
AI.motivation: 全球有数百万弱势非公民需要人道主义保护，美国通过多种移民项目为这些人群提供救助和支持。

AI.method: 文献分析和法律条文梳理，将美国移民保护项目分为四个主要部分进行系统阐述
AI.findings: 美国建立了包括难民保护、家庭暴力受害者庇护、人口贩卖受害者救助、医疗临时居留、庇护申请和危机国家特殊计划在内的多层次人道主义移民保护体系
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理和分类了美国人道主义移民保护的法律框架，为相关研究提供了理论分析基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为弱势非公民群体提供了寻求美国保护的明确指引，为政策制定者和实践工作者提供了全面的项目概览

title: A Strange Mathematical Property of the Debt-to-GDP Ratio

detail.title: A Strange Mathematical Property of the Debt-to-GDP Ratio
detail.abstract: Here we'll consider a mathematical curiosity related to the debt-to-GDP ratio. If a reduction in spending were symmetrically reflected by the same amount in debt and GDP, the ratio would decrease or increase depending, respectively, on whether the ratio was less than or greater than one.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了债务与GDP比率的一个数学特性：当支出减少同时等量减少债务和GDP时，债务-GDP比率的变化方向取决于该比率是否大于1
AI.research_question: 债务-GDP比率在支出减少时如何变化？

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了债务-GDP比率变化的一个反直觉数学特性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解财政紧缩对债务比率的影响提供理论依据

title: Moderating Hate or Moderating Rights? The Paradox of the European Approach to Online Hate Speech and Platform Liability
affiliations: Future of Free Speech at Vanderbilt University

detail.title: Moderating Hate or Moderating Rights? The Paradox of the European Approach to Online Hate Speech and Platform Liability

publicationDetails.journalName: CELE Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper critically assesses the European approach to regulating online hate speech through platform liability frameworks, focusing on Germany's Network Enforcement Act (NetzDG) and the European Union's Digital Services Act. It argues that these laws, while aiming to curb online harm, risk infringing on the right to freedom of expression and non-discrimination by delegating content moderation powers to private, profit-driven companies. The paper highlights how tight removal deadlines, legal ambiguity, and reliance on Artificial Intelligence contribute to over-censorship, particularly of lawful but controversial speech. It also examines the unintended consequences of the current regulatory approach in Europe, including the creation of echo chambers and the potential contribution to social unrest. In addition to platform liability legislation, jurisprudence from the European Court of Human Rights also reveals the worrying trend of assigning speech moderation duties to private entities. Ultimately, the paper advocates for the endorsement of Article 20(2) of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, and its accompanying Rabat Plan of Action, as a global benchmark for social media platforms by which to address online hate speech. This rights-respecting framework offers a high threshold for restrictions, ensuring that efforts to counter hate do not undermine democratic values or fundamental freedoms.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了欧洲通过平台责任框架监管网络仇恨言论的做法，认为德国《网络执行法》和欧盟《数字服务法案》虽然旨在遏制网络伤害，但可能侵犯言论自由和非歧视权利，并导致过度审查。文章主张采用《公民及政治权利国际公约》第20条第2款及其《拉巴特行动计划》作为全球标准。
AI.research_question: 欧洲平台责任框架（如德国NetzDG和欧盟DSA）在监管网络仇恨言论时如何影响言论自由和非歧视权利？
AI.motivation: 当前欧洲网络仇恨言论监管将内容审核权力委托给私营营利性公司，存在侵犯基本权利的风险，需要批判性评估和替代方案探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 言论自由理论、平台责任理论、人权法框架（特别是《公民及政治权利国际公约》第20条）
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究（德国NetzDG和欧盟DSA）、欧洲人权法院判例分析、比较法分析
AI.findings: 1）严格的删除期限和法律模糊性导致过度审查；2）AI依赖加剧了对合法但争议性言论的压制；3）当前监管方式可能创造回音室并引发社会动荡；4）私人实体承担言论审核职责的趋势令人担忧
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于人权的替代监管框架，强调《拉巴特行动计划》的高门槛限制标准，为平衡仇恨言论监管与基本权利保护提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的权利尊重型监管建议，倡导采用国际人权标准作为平台内容审核的全球基准，避免民主价值和基本自由受到损害

title: Evaluating Macroeconomic Policy Strategies for Managing Liquidity Surpluses in Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Evaluating Macroeconomic Policy Strategies for Managing Liquidity Surpluses in Africa
detail.abstract: This study explores the effectiveness of macroeconomic policies in addressing liquidity surpluses in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Utilizing a Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) framework, the analysis reveals a significant inverse relationship between surplus liquidity and GDP growth, highlighting the limitations of conventional monetary policy tools in such contexts. The research underscores the importance of targeted government investment in infrastructure, education, and healthcare to stimulate sustainable economic growth while managing inflation. It further advocates for the development of robust financial markets and the integration of monetary and fiscal policy efforts to absorb excess liquidity and maintain macroeconomic stability. By offering actionable insights, this study provides policymakers with strategies to navigate liquidity challenges and enhance long-term economic resilience in SSA.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过GMM方法分析发现撒哈拉以南非洲地区流动性过剩与GDP增长呈显著负相关，传统货币政策工具效果有限，建议通过政府基础设施投资、发展金融市场和财政货币政策协同来管理流动性过剩。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济政策在解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区流动性过剩问题中的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区面临流动性过剩问题，但传统货币政策工具在此类环境中的效果有限，需要探索更有效的政策组合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流动性过剩与经济增长关系的宏观经济理论，采用广义矩估计(GMM)方法框架进行分析。
AI.method: 使用广义矩估计(GMM)框架进行实证分析，考察流动性过剩与GDP增长的关系。
AI.findings: 发现流动性过剩与GDP增长存在显著的负相关关系，传统货币政策工具在撒哈拉以南非洲地区效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家特别是撒哈拉以南非洲地区流动性管理理论，提出了传统货币政策工具局限性的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体策略：政府投资基础设施、教育和医疗，发展健全金融市场，协调货币与财政政策，以吸收过剩流动性和维持宏观经济稳定。

title: Economics of Reconstruction of War-Damaged Public Projects in Sudan
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics , Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics and Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Economics of Reconstruction of War-Damaged Public Projects in Sudan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: It is my interest to research and introduce solutions to the current destruction and reconstruction of my country

detail.abstract:
The paper examines the possibility of applying the Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model as a financing mechanism for post-war reconstruction projects in Sudan, particularly in light of the country’s economic challenges and constraints on the public budget. The question of this paper addresses the extent to which the BOT system can effectively contribute to rebuilding war-damaged infrastructure.

Thus, the study aims to explore the efficiency of the BOT model in supporting infrastructure development, providing financial and technological resources. Moreover, identifying the legal and legislative obstacles that may hinder its implementation in the Sudanese context. Due to the difficulty of obtaining accurate data on the extent of the damages, the researchers designed an estimated matrix based on reports issued by various local and international institutions.

The study employed a descriptive-analytical approach, relying on secondary data and relevant literature at both regional and international levels. The findings indicate that adopting the BOT model could significantly contribute to reconstruction efforts without placing a substantial burden on the national budget, while also enabling technology transfer and creating employment opportunities. The paper recommends prioritizing vital and strategic projects such as roads, bridges, water Plants, power stations, as well as hospitals and healthcare centers.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨BOT模式在苏丹战后重建中的适用性，认为该模式能有效解决资金短缺问题，促进基础设施重建和技术转移，同时减轻国家预算负担。
AI.research_question: BOT模式在多大程度上能够有效促进苏丹战后受损基础设施的重建？
AI.motivation: 苏丹面临严重经济挑战和公共预算限制，需要寻找替代性融资机制来支持战后重建项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建设-经营-转让（BOT）模式理论，基础设施融资理论
AI.method: 描述性分析方法，基于二手数据和相关文献研究，使用本地和国际机构报告构建估算矩阵
AI.findings: 采用BOT模式可显著促进重建工作而不对国家预算造成重大负担，同时实现技术转移和创造就业机会
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了BOT模式在战后重建情境下的理论应用，为发展中国家基础设施融资提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹政府提供具体实施建议，优先考虑道路、桥梁、水厂、电站、医院等战略项目，并识别法律障碍

title: Sign Comparative Statics in Networked Competition
affiliations: Iowa State University and Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Sign Comparative Statics in Networked Competition
detail.abstract: This paper examines the comparative statics of competition games within networks. We introduce a sign function, determined by competitors' relative positions along the shock propagation path, that fully characterizes a non-monotone yet predictable pattern of shock diffusion in acyclic networks. The study underscores intricate strategic relationships, informing friend-foe identification within complex competitive structures. Well-intentioned local policy interventions-such as resolving or limiting competition or breaking up the network-may inadvertently intensify broader competitive tensions. Departing from traditional approaches that rely on closed-form equilibrium solutions, our paper illustrates a new non-monotone comparative static analysis method in games.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究网络中竞争游戏的比较静态学，通过引入符号函数完整描述了无环网络中冲击传播的非单调但可预测模式，揭示了糟糕政策干预可能造成的风险。

title: Axiomatizations of a Simple Condorcet Voting Method for Final Four and Final Five Elections
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Axiomatizations of a Simple Condorcet Voting Method for Final Four and Final Five Elections
detail.abstract: Proponents of Condorcet voting face the question of what to do in the rare case when no Condorcet winner exists. Recent work provides compelling arguments for the rule that should be applied in three-candidate elections, but already with four candidates, many rules appear reasonable. In this paper, we consider a recent proposal of a simple Condorcet voting method for Final Four political elections. Our question is what normative principles could support this simple form of Condorcet voting. When there is no Condorcet winner, one natural principle is to pick the candidate who is closest to being a Condorcet winner. Yet there are multiple plausible ways to define closeness, leading to different results. Here we take the following approach: identify a relatively uncontroversial sufficient condition for one candidate to be closer than another to being a Condorcet winner; then use other principles to help settle who wins in cases when that condition alone does not. We prove that our principles uniquely characterize the simple Condorcet voting method for Final Four elections. This analysis also points to a new way of extending the method to elections with five or more candidates that is simpler than an extension previously considered. The new proposal is to elect the candidate with the most head-to-head wins, and if multiple candidates tie for the most wins, then elect the one who has the smallest head-to-head loss. We provide additional principles sufficient to characterize this simple method for Final Five elections.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了在四名候选人选举中当不存在Condorcet胜利者时的投票规则，提出了一种简单的Condorcet投票方法，并用规范原则来支持这种方法。论文还将该方法扩展到五名候选人的情况。
AI.research_question: 在四名候选人选举中，当不存在Condorcet胜利者时，哪些规范原则可以支持简单的Condorcet投票方法？
AI.motivation: 虽然对于三名候选人的选举已有明确的Condorcet投票规则，但在四名候选人的情况下，很多规则都显得合理，需要找到一种简单且有理论支撑的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Condorcet投票理论，规范投票原则，候选人距离Condorcet胜利者的距离测量
AI.method: 识别相对无争议的充分条件来判断一个候选人是否比另一个更接近Condorcet胜利者，然后使用其他原则来解决当这个条件不够时的问题
AI.findings: 证明了这些原则唯一地定义了四名候选人选举中的简单Condorcet投票方法
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了支持简单Condorcet投票方法的规范原则基础，并将其扩展到五名候选人的情况
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种简单的方法来处理多候选人选举中的Condorcet投票问题，对于政治选举和其他投票场景具有实践价值

title: Do Households React to Monetary Policy?
affiliations: Macau University of Science and Technology - School of Business, The Education University of Hong Kong, Griffith University and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Do Households React to Monetary Policy?
detail.abstract: We study how households understand and respond to monetary policy by exploiting the open auctions of early-stage crowdfunding and inferring individuals' expectations based on their maximum requested interest rates. Using loan listings from Prosper, we find that borrowers adjust their willingness-to-pay interest rates in response to unexpected Federal funds rate (FFR) changes, while anticipated shifts have negligible effects. These responses are more pronounced among high-income, high-credit-score borrowers, large loan applicants, and when Federal Reserve communication is transparent. The responses are highly asymmetric-borrowers sharply lower rates during unexpected easing but resist increasing them during unexpected tightening. The results are robust to alternative specifications, including regression-discontinuity-in-time designs and alternative measures of monetary policy shock. Lenders also respond to policy shocks and counteract borrowers' adjustments. Analysis of Robinhood data shows that retail investors mirror this behavior by reducing equity holdings after surprise rate hikes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析Prosper平台的众筹贷款数据，发现借款人会根据意外的联邦基金利率变化调整其愿意支付的最高利率，而预期内的政策变化影响甚微。高收入、高信用评分借款人和大额贷款申请者对政策变化的反应更明显，且反应具有高度不对称性——意外宽松时大幅降息，但意外紧缩时抵制加息。
AI.research_question: 家庭如何理解和应对货币政策？意外和预期的货币政策变化对个人借贷行为有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭对货币政策的反应机制对于评估政策传导效果至关重要，但现有研究主要关注企业层面，对家庭层面的微观行为反应了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性预期理论和行为金融学，探讨预期内和意外货币政策冲击对个人借贷决策的差异化影响。
AI.method: 利用Prosper平台的公开众筹拍卖数据，通过借款人要求的最高利率推断其政策预期；采用回归间断时间设计和其他货币政策冲击度量方法进行稳健性检验；同时分析Robinhood数据验证零售投资者的类似行为模式。
AI.findings: 1) 借款人仅对意外货币政策变化做出利率调整反应；2) 高收入、高信用评分人群和大额贷款申请者反应更敏感；3) 反应具有不对称性——宽松时降息积极，紧缩时抵制加息；4) 贷款人也会对政策冲击做出反应，抵消借款人的调整；5) 零售投资者在意外加息后减少股票持仓。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了家庭层面货币政策传导的微观证据，揭示了预期内和意外政策冲击的差异化影响，丰富了理性预期理论在家庭金融决策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者提供了家庭对政策反应的实际证据，有助于改进政策沟通和传导机制设计；为金融机构理解客户行为提供了 insights。

title: Knowledge Management as a Catalyst for Innovation in Dynamic Environments
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Knowledge Management as a Catalyst for Innovation in Dynamic Environments
detail.abstract: In an era marked by rapid technological change, knowledge has emerged as a critical organizational asset, and effective knowledge management (KM) has become essential for sustaining innovation. This paper examines the intersection of knowledge management and innovation, exploring how structured knowledge processes-creation, sharing, and application-drive innovative capabilities within firms. Drawing from organizational theory and innovation management, the study emphasizes the strategic role of KM in enhancing adaptive capacity, fostering collaboration, and generating novel solutions. It concludes that organizations that integrate KM with innovation strategies are better equipped to navigate complexity, harness employee creativity, and maintain long-term competitiveness.

title: Manufacturing Citizens - An Analytical Report on the Chinese Communist Party’s System of Ideological Indoctrination and Political Socialization
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Manufacturing Citizens - An Analytical Report on the Chinese Communist Party’s System of Ideological Indoctrination and Political Socialization
detail.abstract:
This report seeks to provide a comprehensive account of how the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has constructed a systematic and hierarchical ideological apparatus designed to shape the thoughts and behaviours of its citizens over the long term. From the moment a person is born, they are embedded in an environment meticulously engineered to convey and reinforce a particular worldview. This ideological system is not the result of any single leader’s will—nor could it be. Rather, it is the product of an institutional structure forged through intense emotional mobilisation and sustained by the coordinated efforts of multiple actors.

Within this framework, individuals are not merely passive recipients of ideology—they often become active agents in its reproduction. Over time, the system has evolved into a highly efficient, self-perpetuating mechanism, one capable of adapting and repairing itself, while steadily narrowing the space for independent thought.

This report does not set out to analyse a single event. Instead, it offers a general framework for understanding the CCP’s ideological structure and long-term goals. It is intended as a resource for governments, research institutions, and policy think tanks seeking a deeper and more systematic grasp of the Party’s logic—both in its domestic governance and international conduct.

To date, few studies have combined the CCP’s textbooks, official documents, organisational structure, data and policy analysis, and key historical events into a single analytical framework. Building on this foundation, this report integrates policy analysis, data research, and other methodologies to produce a coherent, well-structured, and broadly applicable narrative that offers an in-depth examination of the mechanisms and characteristics of the Chinese Communist Party’s ideological operations.

Ultimately, the purpose of this report is to clarify the underlying system and logic, rather than to deliver definitive judgments. It is the readers themselves who should draw their own conclusions, and they should not look to this report for either positive or negative verdicts.

AI.tldr: 本报告系统分析了中国共产党如何构建层级化的意识形态装置来长期塑造公民思想行为，揭示了这是一个通过情感动员和多方协调形成的制度性结构，而非个人意志产物。
AI.research_question: 中国共产党如何构建系统化、层级化的意识形态装置来长期塑造公民的思想和行为？

AI.theoretical_framework: 意识形态建构理论、制度分析框架、组织行为理论
AI.method: 政策分析、数据研究、文本分析（教科书和官方文件）、历史事件分析、组织结构研究
AI.findings: 中共构建了高效自维持的意识形态机制，个体不仅是被动接受者更是主动再生产参与者；该系统具有自适应和修复能力，不断压缩独立思考空间。

title: Extreme Events in Corporate Bond Spreads
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Extreme Events in Corporate Bond Spreads
detail.abstract: The market value of corporate bonds was equivalent to around a third of global GDP as of 2024. It represents a key asset class for professional and private investors. However, it is subject to high volatility and is very sensitive to rare but extreme events, such as the financial and Covid-19 crises. We study the extremal behaviour of corporate bond spreads in the United States and in the Euro Area across different rating segments and sectors. We base our study on three decades of daily data. We control for financial and macroeconomic variables that are likely to affect spreads. Our approach uses three different methods from Extreme Value Theory (EVT). It focuses first on the marginal distributions of corporate bond spreads, then models the bivariate tail dependence structure of cross-regional and cross-market corporate bond spreads and finally on the distribution of corporate bond spreads over time, capturing their volatility dynamics as well as their heavy tails. During crisis periods, the degree of dependence is surprisingly high, suggesting a contagion effect. Our fitted models show that more standard approaches would massively underestimate the probabilities of rare events and that the combination of dynamic volatility modelling with EVT is robust and well suited for extrapolating risk measures beyond the maximum level of corporate bond spreads observed in the historical data.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用极值理论分析美国和欧元区公司债券利差的极端行为，发现危机期间依赖度极高，传统方法会严重低估罕见事件概率，动态波动率建模与EVT结合能有效外推风险度量。
AI.research_question: 公司债券利差在极端事件下的行为特征是什么？跨区域和跨市场的尾部依赖结构如何？
AI.motivation: 公司债券市场规模巨大但波动性高，对金融危机和疫情等极端事件敏感，需要准确评估其极端风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（EVT），包括边际分布分析、二元尾部依赖结构建模和时间序列波动动态建模。
AI.method: 使用三种EVT方法：边际分布分析、二元尾部依赖结构建模、时间序列波动动态和厚尾分布建模，基于30年日度数据，控制金融和宏观经济变量。
AI.findings: 危机期间依赖度异常高，存在传染效应；传统方法严重低估罕见事件概率；动态波动率建模与EVT结合能有效外推风险度量。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了极值理论在公司债券市场的应用，提供了跨区域和跨市场尾部依赖的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理提供更准确的风险评估工具，帮助更好地应对极端市场事件。

title: Endogenous Quality in Social Learning
affiliations: University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics, University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics and National Research University – Higher School of Economics (HSE University)

detail.title: Endogenous Quality in Social Learning
detail.abstract: We study a dynamic reputation model with a fixed posted price where only purchases are public. A long-lived seller chooses costly quality; each buyer observes the purchase history and a private signal. Under a Markov selection, beliefs split into two cascades-where actions are unresponsive and investment is zero-and an interior region where the seller invests. The policy is inverse-U in reputation and produces two patterns: Early Resolution (rapid absorption at the optimistic cascade) and Double Hump (two investment episodes). Higher signal precision at fixed prices enlarges cascades and can reduce investment. We compare welfare and analyze two design levers: flexible pricing, which can keep actions informative and remove cascades for patient sellers, and public outcome disclosure, which makes purchases more informative and expands investment.

AI.tldr: 研究固定价格下的动态声誉模型，发现信念会分裂为两个信息级联区域（行动无响应且投资为零）和一个内部投资区域。投资政策呈倒U型，产生早期解决和双峰两种模式。信号精度提高会扩大级联区域并可能减少投资。比较了灵活定价和公开结果披露两种设计杠杆的效果。
AI.research_question: 在固定价格动态声誉模型中，购买历史公开而质量信号私有的情况下，卖家的质量投资行为和买家的购买决策如何相互作用？信念和信息级联如何影响市场效率？
AI.motivation: 理解在信息不对称的市场中，声誉机制如何影响长期质量投资决策，以及信息结构（如信号精度、信息公开程度）对市场效率的影响，为平台设计和监管政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态博弈理论和不完全信息下的声誉模型，结合信息级联理论和贝叶斯学习过程，分析长期卖家与短期买家的策略互动。
AI.method: 构建动态博弈模型，使用马尔可夫完美均衡分析，通过数值模拟和比较静态分析研究不同参数下的均衡特征和福利影响。
AI.findings: 1) 信念分裂为两个信息级联区域和一个内部投资区域；2) 投资政策呈倒U型；3) 出现早期解决和双峰两种模式；4) 信号精度提高会扩大级联但可能减少投资；5) 灵活定价可以消除级联，公开披露能扩大投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了动态声誉理论，揭示了信息级联在质量投资中的作用机制，提出了投资政策的倒U型特征和双模式现象，丰富了不完全信息下的学习理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计提供了两个重要杠杆：灵活定价策略可以保持行动的信息性，公开结果披露可以提高购买信息含量，这些都有助于改善市场效率和促进质量投资。

title: The Impact of Daily Avocado Consumption on Weight Management, BMI Regulation, and Blood Glucose Control: A Systematic Evidence-Based Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author declares no conflict of Interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Author declares no funding was received or used for this work.

detail.abstract: Avocados have gained increasing attention for their potential role in promoting metabolic health. This systematic evidence-based review critically evaluates the impact of daily avocado consumption on weight management, body mass index (BMI), and blood glucose regulation. Drawing on randomized controlled trials (RCTs), cohort studies, cross-sectional analyses, and meta-analyses published between 2018 and 2024, the review synthesizes findings from peer reviewed literature. Results indicate that avocados may enhance satiety, support healthy body composition, and improve glycemic outcomes, particularly when consumed as part of balanced diets that replace less nutritious foods. While effects are modest and context-dependent, avocados represent a promising dietary component in strategies targeting obesity and type 2 diabetes. Avocado consumption, Weight management, Body mass index (BMI), Glycemic control, Metabolic health, Type 2 diabetes

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了2018-2024年间关于牛油果摄入对体重管理、BMI和血糖调节影响的研究，发现牛油果可能通过增强饱腹感、改善体成分和血糖结果来促进代谢健康。
AI.research_question: 每日摄入牛油果对体重管理、身体质量指数（BMI）和血糖调节有何影响？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营养学和新陈代谢理论，探讨牛油果中的营养成分（如健康脂肪、纤维）如何通过饱腹感机制和血糖调节途径影响代谢健康。
AI.method: 系统性证据回顾，综合随机对照试验（RCTs）、队列研究、横断面分析和荟萃分析等研究方法。
AI.findings: 牛油果可能增强饱腹感、支持健康体成分并改善血糖结果，特别是在替代营养较差食物的均衡饮食中效果更明显。效果虽适度且依赖具体情境，但牛油果在肥胖和2型糖尿病管理策略中具有潜力。

title: Our Housing Crisis of Indecision

detail.title: Our Housing Crisis of Indecision
detail.abstract:
Our national housing policy is clearly not working. Despite billions of dollars in housing subsidies and dozens of federal, state and local laws aimed at addressing the housing crisis, millions of Americans continue to struggle with the high cost of housing and the persistent problem of racial and class segregation. Where have we gone wrong? The problem is that our housing policy contains many conflicting goals, and policymakers attempt in vain to accommodate all of them while refusing to set priorities or recognize tradeoffs. We try to make housing more affordable by subsidizing low-income housing, but spend far more encouraging people to plow all their savings into expensive homes, which only incentivizes them to oppose affordable housing. Policymakers adopt regulations to expand supply and increase affordability, but then undermine the efficacy of such regulations by including poison pills to protect neighborhoods against unwanted change. Meanwhile, the courts have weakened our housing laws through meager and ambivalent interpretations, as they are hesitant to wade into difficult policy questions in the absence of clear guidance from policymakers. At the same time, policymakers' equivocation empowers obstructionist NIMBYs who exploit housing policy's incoherence to preserve a status quo of segregation and inequality. 

This housing crisis of indecision stems from a combination of intractable interest-group conflict and a longstanding cultural and political obsession with the centrality of the home. We expect housing policy to do all the things that, in a different political culture, a public sphere would do-not only to provide our shelter, but provide for our retirement, job opportunities, social networks, schools, and so on. Ironically, our housing policy could do much more if we asked it to do a little bit less. Drawing inspiration from the recent "abundance" movement and promising reforms in states like California, this Article argues that housing policy could actually make significant headway if it prioritized removing restrictions on consumers' housing choices and stopped trying to be everything to everyone.

AI.tldr: 美国房地产政策失败的根源在于政策目标冲突、不敢优先级化或承认权衡，导致政策内部矛盾、法院解释薄弱、NIMBY阻碍者利用政策不协调性维持离散不公平状态。解决之道是优先解除对消费者房地产选择的限制，而不是让房地产政策承担过多功能。
AI.research_question: 美国房地产政策为何失败？如何才能有效解决房价高昂和离散问题？
AI.motivation: 虽然投入数十亿美元补贴和制定众多法规，但美国人仍面临房价高昂和种族/阶层离散问题，需要找到政策失败的根本原因和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策矛盾理论、权衡理论、利益集团冲突理论、政策不协调性理论
AI.method: 对美国房地产政策进行批判性分析，检视政策目标冲突、法院解释问题、NIMBY现象等多重因素
AI.findings: 房地产政策失败的核心原因是政策制定者尝试同时实现多个相互冲突的目标（如提高可购性但又保护现有社区）而拒绝设定优先级或承认权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"房地产政策冲突理论"，识别政策内部相互冲突的目标如何导致政策失败，以及政治文化对住房功能过度期待的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策改革方向：优先解除对房地产供给的限制，减少政策目标的复杂性，向加州等地的"丰富运动"学习，重点关注扩大消费者选择权而非让房地产承担过多社会功能

title: Integrated Energy Management for Mission-Critical Environments: A Review of Market-Based Trading Mechanisms and Renewable Integration for Enhancing Operational Continuity and Sustainability
